tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor spyi dang bye brag gi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor spyi dang bye brag gi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor spyi dang bye brag gi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

bdag nyid tha mal spyi gtsug tu// ye shes 'od lnga'i thig le'i dbus// rin chen seng ges btegs pa'i khrir// ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rnam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po// gsal 'tsher nam mkha'i mdog can gyi// phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnol thabs 'dzin// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan dang*// phyag zhabs gdu bu ska rags 'phyangs// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs ldan// zhal mdangs 'dzum pa'i nyams dang bcas// mtshan dpe'i sku mchog lham me ba// skyabs gnas kun 'dus dam pa la// phyag 'tshal mchod pa rgya mtsho 'bul// nyes bshags dge la yi rang ngo*// zhing 'dir chos ston bzhugs gsol 'debs// 'gro kun byang lam thob phyir bsngo// rang byung lhan skyes don dam pa// ji bzhin rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po che// bka' drin gsum ldan rin po che// drin can rje la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa dag pa dang*// rang sems skye med don rtogs nas// snang srid chos kyi sku ru 'char// mchog gi go 'phang thob byin rlobs// pha gcig dam pa rje btsun// rgyal dbang sku bzhi'i dbang phyug /ngan song 'jigs skyob mgon po// drin can bla ma mkhyen no// pha gcig phrin las bzhi ldan// ye shes skad cig 'pho ba'i// thugs rje'i byin rlabs gter 'dzin// drin can bla ma mkhyen no// bdag 'dra las ngan sems can// nyam thag skyabs med mgon med// nyon mongs g.yang las thar ba'i// drin can thugs rjes drongs shig /ces mos gus kyi 'dun pa rtse gcig pas rgyang 'bod kyi tshul du lan ci nus byas la/ de nas byin rlabs kyi dbang bzhi len pa ni/ bla ma'i sku dang gsung dang thugs// ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi// 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang 'phros// gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi rdzogs// slar yang mos gus gsol btab mthus// dgyes tshul dang bcas 'od du zhu// chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin tu// spros med ngang la mnyam par bzhag

/ ces ci gnas su bzhag / bdag ni skye ba tshe rabs kun tu yang*// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i sgor zhugs bla ma mchog /'bral med brnyes pa gsum gyis gus mchod cing*// blo 'das phyag rgya chen po 'grub gyur cig /nyon mongs chu bor spyod pa'i 'gro ba rnams// rab dkar dge ba'i gru rdzing la brten nas// byang chub sems gnyis skya bas rgyud bskul te// myang 'das chen po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di'ang 'phags nor bdun gyis phyug pa mchog sprul bde chen rab 'phel nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor spyi la 'jug pa'i khyer bde zhig bskul ngor si tu ho thog thu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos shing yos khrums zla'i yar tshes la bris pa 'gro rnams zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la 'god par gyur cig /bkra shis/// / ༈ rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng*// ngo bo bla ma rnam pa rdo rje 'chang*// rtsa brgyud rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// chos skyong rgya mtshos bskor nas bzhugs par gsal// phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod dang nongs pa bshags// yi rangs bskul gsol dge ba byang chub bsngo// bdag sogs 'gro rnams 'di bzung snying po'i bar// skyabs gsol thugs rjes bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā ra hūm̐/ ci nus bzlas mthar/ mthar ni bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// dbyer med gcig 'dres ma bcos ngang du bzhag /dge des skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du// dam pas rjes bzung sku bzhi mngon gyur shog / ces si tu pas rnam gling dgon par bla sprul bzhed ngor spel ba dge/// / ༈ spyi bor pad nyi zla gdan steng*// rdo rje 'chang dbang chos kyi rje// nam mkha'i mdog can rdor dril bsnams// zhabs zung rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// lha rdzas dar gyi na bzas mdzes// rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs// ye shes 'od lnga'i klong du gsal// sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi dpal che// rigs rnams khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// bka' drin mnyam med bla ma mkhyen// skye zhing skye bar rjes 'dzin te// bla med rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog

/spyi bo'i bla ma 'od zhu nas// dbyer med chu la chu bzhag ltar// rang sems ma bcos lhug par bzhag / ces rtogs ldan dpal ldan phrin las nas bskul ltar/ si tus dpal 'dzong gnas mchog nas bris pa maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ rang lus tha mal spyi bo ru// bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po// sku mdog sngon po phyag gnyis kyis// rdor dril bsnol thabs longs sku'i chas// yongs rdzogs 'od lnga'i klong du gsal// dkon mchog 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// dbang bzhi rdzogs thob sgrib bzhi dag /sku bzhi'i go 'phang yongs thob nas// bla med byang grol myur thob shog / ces bstan dbang nas bskul ngor si tus spel/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan drug shog /dge'o/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dkon mchog kun 'dus bzhugs/ spyi bor pad zla'i gdan gyi steng*// bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas dang ldan// de la dkon mchog rtsa gsum gyi// lha tshogs dpag med bskor bar gsal// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi// phyag 'tshal mchod bshags rjes yi rang*// bskul zhing gsol 'debs bsngo bar bgyi// rang byung lhan skyes phyag rgya che// snying po'i don rtogs byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā ra hūm̐/ zhes bsnyen cing*/ mthar ni skyabs yul rang la thim// dbyer med chu la chu bzhag ltar// ma bcos spros med ngang du bzhag /dge des rang gzhan sangs rgyas shog / ces sngags 'chang karma rnam rgyal ngor spel/// / ༈ rang nyid tha mal spyi bo ru// pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad pa// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang steng*// rigs kun gtso bo bla ma mchog /rnam pa rdor sems sku mdog dkar// phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan dang*// phyag zhabs gdu bu rin chen brgyan// dar li'i stod g.yogs smad g.yogs gsol// zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs// thugs kar hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas bskor// sku las bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgyun// bsil ba bde ba'i rang bzhin can// babs pas rang lus gang bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra sa twa

sogs yi ge brgya pa dang drug pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ kye mgon po/ bdag ni 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te// sku gsung thugs dang gang 'gal ba'i// nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag /dag tshangs dbugs dbyung mdzad du gsol// gsol btab mthu las sdig sgrib rnams// dud khu sol khu'i rnam par thon// rang lus shel sgong lta bur gyur// spyi bo'i bla ma 'od zhu nas// dbyer mi phyed pa rang la thim// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la bzhag /dge 'dis mkha' mnyam ma rgan rnams// sangs rgyas go 'phang thob phyir bsngo// ces pa'ang dbon sprul karma 'byung gnas kyi thugs bzhed bzhin si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos 'dzi sgar bkra shis chos gling du spel ba sarba mad+ga laṃ// ༈ // spyi bor dri med zla rgyas steng*// hrīḥyig dmar po'i 'phro 'du las// ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rnam pa bcom ldan snang mtha' yas// dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// mnyam bzhag lhung bzed tshe bum 'dzin// na bza' chos gos zhabs rdor skyil// mtshan dang dpe byad yongs rdzogs pa// 'od dang 'od zer klong du gsal// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ yig las// 'od 'phros bde chen zhing khams nas// bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes pa// dpag med spyan drangs rang thim gyur// slar yang thugs 'od 'phros pa las// dbang lha rigs lngas dbang bskur zhing*// rigs bdag rnam snang rgyas gdab gyur// thugs kar zla steng hrīḥyig dmar// de mthar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor// phyogs dus rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// kun gyi thugs rje dngos grub rnams// snang mtha'i skur gyur rang la thim// phyi snod nang bcud 'gro ba rnams//lha yi ngo bor bsgyur ba dang*// rigs drug sgrib sbyang byang chub kyi// lam bkod khyer so gsum ldan ngang*// oṃ ā mi dhe wā hrīḥ ci nus bzlas mthar/ rgyal kun thugs rje'i gter chen// pad+ma gsung gi dbang phyug

/sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mgon// dbyer med dpal ldan bla mar// snying nas dad pas gsol 'debs// bdag dang 'brel thogs sems can// nub phyogs bde ldan zhing du// gang gi zhal mthong lung thob// phyir mi ldog bar byin rlobs// ces bla ma rgyang 'bod smon lam dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las ye shes lnga'i// ngo bo oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ sngon po// swā ser hā ljang 'phros pas bdag lus kyi// gnas lngar thim pas phung khams sdig sgrib bsal// dbang bzhi thob cing bla ma 'od zhu nas// dbyer med gcig 'dres snang srid chos thams cad// gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor bzhag / ces ci gnas nyams bskyang la/ mthar dge rtsa byang chen bsngo/ de ltar gdan sa bar pa'i sgrub chen phrin las phun tshogs ngor si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba sarba mad+ga lam/ shu bham/// / hrīḥ snang srid chos rnams gzod nas mtshan bral ngang*// snying rje chen po'i rol rtsal 'gag med mdangs// gsal stong 'od phung yi dam lhar gsal ba'i// spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// rnam pa gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas mchog /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar cha lugs yongs su rdzogs// sku dang ye shes dbyer med lhun grub kyang*// gnyis 'dzin snang yul bag chags dag pa'i phyir// thugs las 'od 'phros pad+ma 'od zhing nas// ye shes spyan drangs dam ye gnyis med gyur// hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// pad+ma ge sar sdong po la// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ ཿ zhes tshar bdun nam gsum dang*/ gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐/

zhes thod phreng rtsal sngags gang 'grub bzla/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma yi// rdo rje bzhi yi byin rlabs 'od zer tshul// 'phros nas rang gi gnas bzhir thim pa'i mod// gnas skabs rnam bzhi'i sgrib pa dag nas kyang*// sku bzhi'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag par gyur// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs te// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /brjod/ ces karma'i dad pa'i gsos su spel/// / ༈ mar mi dwags gsum gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs/ kye ma/ gzung 'dzin ma rig 'ching ba'i drwa ba la// 'thum pa'i rang gzhan sems can snying re rje// da ni nges don snying po'i gsang lam mchog /rang byung ye shes gnas la 'bad par bya// dngos kun chos rnams stong nyid chen po'i ngang*// snang ba'i rtsal las ma 'gag dkyil 'khor shar// mdun mkhar lnga ldan 'ja' 'od 'thibs pa'i klong*// pad nyi zla gdan gsum gsal dbus ma la// dgyes mdzad he ru ka dngos lo tsā che// chos kyi blo gros dge bsnyen cha lugs can// rab brjid gzi 'bar zil gnon phyag rgya mdzad// g.yas su rje btsun mi la thos pa dga'// ras dkar bla gos sems nyid ngal gso'i tshul// rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs tam bu ra bzhin sgrog /g.yon du zla 'od gzhon nu rab byung chas// dbu la sgom zhu mnyam bzhag phyag rgya can// mi rtog ting 'dzin zab mo don la gnas// gzhan yang steng 'og bar mtshams thams cad du// chos longs sprul dang bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs// yi dam ḍā ki dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// dam can chos srung la sogs skyabs gnas rnams// sprin ltar gtib bzhin rab tu gsal bar gyur// ces gsal btab nas/ kye ho/ dus gsum rgyal kun gyi gong bu// gcig bsdus thugs rje yi gter chen// byin rlabs bum bzang gi bdag nyid// rje btsun bla ma rang mkhyen no// gtan med 'khrul 'byams kyi sems can// chos med dred po la gzigs dang*// ngan song 'khor ba yi 'dam las// nus mthu'i lcags kyu yis drongs shig

/bdag sogs mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba// skyabs med mgon bral la dgongs mdzod/ bde chen thar mchog gi zhing du// myur du 'dren par rang byin rlobs// ces gsol 'debs rgyang 'bod tshul du tshar kha shas dang*/ mthar/ snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor de thams cad// 'od zhu gtsor thim de yang rang la thim// bla ma rang sems dbyer med gnyug ma'i ngang*// ma bcos spros pa kun bral klong du bzhag / mthar dge bsngo sogs bya'o// ces pa'ang si tu pas/ dad dam ldan pa dbu dar rgyas ngor spel ba dge'o/// / ༈ grub chen karma pak+shi'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so// snang srid 'khor 'das chos thams cad// 'dzin med blo 'das phyag rgya che'i// rang mdangs ma 'gags gsal ba'i ngang*// spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// o rgyan chen po'i ngo bo nyid// rnam pa dpal chen he ru ka /grub thob rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug mchog /karma pak+shi gzi 'od 'bar// dmar smug zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi// zil gnon phyag rgya zhabs rdor skyil// chos gos rnam gsum zab ber gsol// zhwa nag khyung gshog dbu la mdzes// spyan gsum 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'khyil// khro 'dzum ag tshom zur gsum nag /ye shes lnga ldan thig le'i dbus// snang la rang bzhin med par gsal// gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas// rtsa gsum lha yi thugs rje bskul// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs thim// dbang lhas dbang bskur mchod cing bstod// rigs bdag pad 'byung rgyas gdab gyur// thugs kar hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor// spro bsdus sgrib sbyang rgyal kun gyi// ye shes chen po thob par gyur// oṃ āḥshri mān ma hā gu ru karma pak+shi sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ dus gsum mnyam med shākya'i// rgyal pos byin rlabs lung bstan// sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang*// zhes grags sangs rgyas gnyis pa// pad 'byung dbyer med nyid du// lung zin bstan 'gro'i mgon po// dus gsum mkhyen pa nas bzung*// bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rje'i// bar du skyes rabs phreng ba// gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo// chos kyi bla ma mkhyen no// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas bslad pa'i// 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di lta'i// ma dag sems kyi cho 'phrul// rig stong rtsa bral chen po// rang gsal rang grol ngang du// ka dag dbyings su zlog cig

/oṃ āḥkarma pak+shi hūm̐/ gsol btab mthu las deng nas bzung*// ma nor lam ston bla ma dang*// theg chen gsang sngags dam pa'i chos// spyod pa'i skal ba ldan gyur cig /lta log chos ltar bcos pa'i bdud// dam nyams 'dres khyer dred po yis// nam yang bslu bar ma gyur cig /gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang*// dgongs pa mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin par// dbyer med gcig tu 'dres par gyur// snang grag rtog ba'i don thams cad// bla ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs su shar// 'khor 'das dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs// 'bras bu sku gsum thob phyir bsngo// rtsa gsum bde legs rab dga'i char// srid gsum kun tu khyab gyur cig

/skyabs che bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel gyi dgongs bzhed ltar gar dbang rin po che'i bka' phebs par si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos 'og min karma nas spel ba mad+ga laṃ/ dge'o/// / ༈ thun bzhi'i sgom rim nyung bsdus grub gnyis 'bras ster bzhugs so// na mo gu ru karma ye/ mi bskyod rgyal ba'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi las// byung ba'i nyams len zab lam rmad byung ba// thun bzhi'i don bsdus bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig /spel bgyi mkha' 'gros bka' yi gnang ba stsol// spyi bor mkha' dbyings 'ja' 'od zer gyi klong*// ye shes mkha' 'gro dmar mo ḍā bhan bsnams// gcer bu skra grol rgyan spang spyan gsum ldan// dkar 'dzin chu 'dzin rab rgyas bde ba che'i// gar gyi rol pas rtse bzhin rnam mang pos// sku yi bkod pa nyi zer rdul ltar 'tshubs// de dbus rtsa ba'i bla ma karma pa// chos gos rnam gsum zhwa nag gser gdangs can// phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnol 'dzin zhabs skyil krung*// chos dbyings don dam skye med lta stangs can// gsol btab tsam gyis mi bzod gdung ba yi// dad dang mos gus dag snang dungs se dung*// byin rlabs dngos grub char bzhin thibs se thib// dkon mchog 'dus pa'i ngo bor lham mer gsal// kyai/ snang stong sku la grags stong gsung*// bde stong thugs la gsol ba 'debs// gsang gsum rdo rje'i byin phob la// dbang bskur bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod// phyogs dus rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams// kun kyang bla ma'i sku la thim// rigs dkyil khyab bdag nges par shar// ye shes mkha' 'gro ljang ser dmar// dkar nag sngo khra ḍā ru dang*// bhan+dha bsnams shing gar stabs 'khyug /nyon mongs sdig sgrib rtsad nas bsal// dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag gi// nongs pa bshags so dag tshangs stsol// gsol btab mod la mkha' 'gro rnams// rim bzhin gtso mo'i sku la thim// de nyid rang thim mkha' 'gror

gong gi phag mo dmar mo/ mchan/ gsal// rtsa ba'i bla ma skad cig gis// 'khor lo bde mchog dpa' gcig /mchan/ skur gyur nas// rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs// chos 'byung phyag rgya spyi bor mdzad// bde ba'i nyams ldan gar stabs g.yo// rang nyid mkha' 'gror gsal pa yi// bdud rtsi'i mchod 'bul ye shes me// 'bar zhing 'od kyis spyan drangs nas// snying gar 'di skabs rlung bum can nam bar rlung bzung*/ mchan/ pad nyir bzhugs par mos// de yi dpral mgrin thugs lte bar// oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ sngon po// hoḥser sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i// ngo bor rab tu gsal bar gyur// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i spyi dpal// rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel byed// yang dag nges pa'i lam mchog ston pa'i// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje mkhyen no// lan gsum mam bdun bton la/ karma pa mkhyen no// ci nus bgrang*/ dkon mchog kun 'dus mkhyen no// dwags po bka' brgyud mkhyen no// bdud 'dul rdo rje mkhyen no// skyabs gnas gcig chog mkhyen no// kye ma drin chen bla ma// rigs kun khyab bdag chen po// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang dngos// dran mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so// phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes// 'gyur med lhan skyes ngo bo// myur du rtogs par byin rlobs// dus gsum dge tshogs thams cad// 'gro ba'i don du 'bul bzhes// rje btsun khyed rang lta bur// snying nas byin gyis rlobs shig / ces brjod la snying ga'i bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang dang dbyer med du mos/ rang lhar gsal ba de yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du 'ja' yal ba ltar rdzogs rim lta ba'i ngang la re zhig mnyam par bzhag / rdo rje can dngos bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so// kar brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so// thugs rje byin rlabs gter chen la gsol ba 'debs so// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so// tshe gcig rten thog 'di nyid du// nges pa'i don mchog zab mo'i lam// sbyangs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin nas// bla med sgrub pa snying po yi// gegs med lhun gyis grub gyur nas// phyag rgya chen po 'grub par shog

/ ces dang*/ gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// de ltar thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mdor bsdus 'di bzhin drung 'tsho ba dge slong nor bus bskul ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba 'gro rnams zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par gyur cig// / ༈ thun min bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs/ mchog gsum ngo bo dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang karma pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir skal ba dang ldan pa dag gi spyod yul du thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom par spro na/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ bdag dang ma gyur 'gro ba rnams// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma la// rtag par skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// rdzogs sangs go 'phang la 'god phyir// smon dang 'jug ba'i sems bskyed nas// tshad med 'gro sgrol dam bca'o// lan bdun nam nyer gcig /gnyis pa bskyed rim rnal 'byor ni/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sa sbyangs nas/ gzung 'dzin snang ba 'di kun rang bzhin gyi// stong pa'i rang mdangs de las ma g.yos ngang*// rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal mdun gyi mkhar// ye shes lnga ldan 'od klong dkyil 'khor dbus// gyad dang seng chen gyis btegs rin chen khrir// ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng*// de dbus rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// rtsa ba'i bla ma byams chen mi pham mgon// dngos snang rje btsun dharmā ka ra mchog /zhwa dmar gser mdangs cod pan dbu la gsol// dkar gsal bgres nyams phyag gnyis chos 'chad rgyas// ut+pal sdong bus btegs pa'i ral pod bsnams// chos gos rnam gsum zhabs gnyis rdor skyil bzhugs// de yi dpral bar pad nyi zla steng du// ma 'ongs bskal bzang drug pa seng ge sgra'i// rnam 'phrul dpal ldan dus gsum kun tu mkhyen// bgres tshul zhwa nag cod pan phyag byang chub// mchog gi rgya can ngur smrig rnam gsum bklubs// rdor skyil gyis bzhugs mgrin par pad+ma dang*// nyi zla'i steng du 'das pa'i sangs rgyas ni// rat+na aṅga sprul bsgyur gar gyi dbang*// dkon mchog yan lag pad rag cod pan mdzes// phyag gnyis bgrang phreng chos gos gsum ldan gsol// zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung bzhugs thugs ka ru// pad nyi zla steng snying po don brgyud kyi// byin rlabs nges thob pad+ma nyin byed dbang*// dge slong cha lugs dbang zhu mthong grol can// rdo rje dril 'dzin skyil krung dang bcas gsal// gtso bo'i spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// rigs bdag rdor 'chang zla 'od gzhon nu'i tshul// sgom zhwa gsol zhing 'dul 'dzin cha byad kyi// mnyam bzhag nor bu bsnam zhing zhabs rdor skyil// de ltar sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid gsal// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs// dus gsum rgyal dang dam chos 'phags dge 'dun// rgyud bzhir 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// ye shes chos skyong las dang 'jig rten gyi// dam can bka' yi srung ma mthu rtsal can// kun kyang bkra gsal lam mer sprin ltar gtibs// gsol btab tsam gyis bzod med mos gus 'bar// tha mal snang ba gang shar stong nyid dang*// snying rje zung 'jug bde gsal mi rtog ngang*// snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor rol par shar// so so'i gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar po// hūm̐ mthing mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros// 'og min chos dbyings pho brang bde ba che// rang rig ngo bo dag pa rab 'byams kyi// lha tshogs spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

gsum pa spyan 'dren ni/ oṃ/ sku lnga'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das// āḥ rnam grol lam mchog ston pa'i bdag /hūm̐/ zab zhi spros bral 'dus ma byas// hoḥ dbyings nas brtser dgongs 'dir gshegs gsol// bdag gzhan 'gro rgyud nyon mongs kyi// dra ba rtsad nas gzhom pa'i phyir// ye shes thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// mchog thun grub pa'i bdud rtsi'i char// byin rlabs dbang bzhis smin pa dang*// rgyud bzhi grol bar mdzad du gsol// bzhi pa mchod 'bul ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer las// sprul pa'i rdo rje lha mo ni// gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos sogs// phyi yi mchod pa bcu drug dang*// dam rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// bla med nang gi mchod pa dang*// gsang ba bde stong dbyer med ngang*// zung 'jug bde chen mchod pa 'bul// de ltar mchod bya mchod byed rnams// gnyis med rtogs pas bskang zhing bshags// yi ge brgya pa brjod la// bdag gzhan rgyud kyi nyes pa gang mchis bshags shing*/ bla ma rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi 'o rgyun lta bu spros nas rang lus ltems kyis gang nas/ de'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag par mos la/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor rtse gcig mos pas/ karma pa mkhyen no// ci nus bzla/ drug pa bla ma rgyang 'bod gsol 'debs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// chos brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas// 'dren pa tshogs zhing gi mnga' bdag mchog /ma rigs drug sems can gzigs su gsol// mkha' khyab chos sku yi rang bzhin la// bde ba che longs spyod yongs rdzogs pa// gang 'dul gyi sprul bsgyur ston pa po// bdag 'gro drug thugs rjes skyong du gsol// 'jig rten gyi zhen 'dzin mtha' med 'di// blo a 'thas 'khrul snang shes bzhin par// mi rtag dang nges 'byung mos gus kyis// lus rten 'dir rgyud grol byin gyis rlobs// snang srid kun skye med klong yangs par// rang byung gi rig pa rang grol ngang*// lhan skyes kyi ye shes mngon gyur nas// rje btsun gyi rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs//

de nas bdun ba dbang bzhi'i byin rlabs bskul ba/ kye ho/ pha gcig drin chen bla ma// don brgyud byin rlabs gter chen// deng bdag rdo rje sems dpa'// myur 'grub rgyud smin grol mdzod// mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad// thugs rje'i rol pas skyong bzhin// gang 'dir mngon byang chub pa'i// go 'phang bde blag stsol cig / brgyad pa dbang len pa dngos/ de ltar gsol btab thugs brgyud bskul ba'i mthus// skyabs gnas rgya mtsho 'dus zhal nges pa yi// bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'od zhu nas// rigs kun khyab bdag gtso bo'i sku la thim// de yi gsang gsum ye shes rdo rje bzhi'i// byin rlabs bum gsang sher ye bzhi pa'i don// rnam pa oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing ga /hoḥljang 'od zer dang ni bdud rtsi'i rgyun// rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob// rgyud smin sgrib dag lam bzhi 'byongs pa dang*// sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon gyur byin gyis rlobs// bla ma dgyes zhal mdangs bcas 'di skad du// gzhi nas ma bcos ye nas lhun grub la// tha mal rang lugs chen por bzhag pa na// skye 'chi med pa nam mkha'i klong yangs su// 'pho 'gyur med pa chos sku'i lus mthong 'gyur// ces pa'i zab don bka' gsang gnang thob nas// byams chen zhi ba'i dbyings las rjes dgongs te// 'od zhu bdag thim dbyer med bde chen ngang*// ma bcos spros kun bral ba'i klong du bzhag / ci gnas su nyams len bskyangs la mthar bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par yang bya'o// ces pa'i rnal 'byor don tshan brgyad pa 'di'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis/ bam steng grub pa'i dbang mchog gi// sprul gar sngon smon legs smin pa// gu ṇa'i mtshan can bzhed skong ched// bkod dges 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /mad+ga laṃ/ dza yan+tu/// / ༈ bla ma rgyang 'bod dang gsol 'debs dngos grub yongs 'du zhes pa bzhugs so//

a hoḥ rang sems 'khrul pa rgya 'byams kyi ngang nas// skabs shig snang ba ye cha las 'phros pa'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa de dran byung*// rdo rje 'chang dngos su nges shes rnyed byung*// 'jur bur bcings pa'i rjes shes kyi ngang nas// rnam rtog thol byung du gtad med 'phros pa'i// dran mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma gsal byung ngo*// rdo rje 'chang= sems dus gsum gyi spros pa rgyun bcad nas// shes thog tu rig pa gnas pa'i tshe na// gshis kun khyab ngo bo bla ma dran byung ngo*// rdo rje= mgon khyod kyi bka' drin rjes su skyong ba'i// lam 'bras bu'i nyams len gnad du bsnun pas// sku bzhi yi dbang phyug bla ma dran byung ngo*// rdo rje= snang srid kyis bsdus ba'i chos rnams thams cad// chos dbyings ye stong mtha' bral gyi ye shes// skye med ngo bo bla ma dran byung ngo*// rdo rje 'chang dngos su nges shes rnyed byung*// su kha sid+dhi/ a hoḥ gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs so// byin rlabs thugs kyi klong nas stsol cig /pha gcig sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang mkhyen no// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes smin grol stsol cig / ces rgyang 'bod dar drag la yun ring ba sems mos gus kyi snang ba 'gyur nges byas la mchog gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams la rtag 'grus su 'bad pa cher spro bar rigs so// de yang dam tshig bkod pa'i rgyud las/ mtshan dang dpe byad ldan ba'i lha// bskal ba 'bum du bsgoms pa las// bla ma dran ba 'bum char min// bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa sa ya las// bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gcig lhag /ces sogs phan yon mtha' yas bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// mad+ga lam kurban+tu/ shu bham/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor snang srid dag pa rab 'byams nam mkha' ye dwangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// shrī ma hā gu ru karma kwa ya na maḥ tshad med byams pa'i zla snang gis// sgrib gnyis rab rib mun pa sel// rnam grol lam mchog gsal ba'i gnyen// 'gro mgon dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// gang la bsten na 'khor mtsho las// sgrol byed byang chub gru gzings 'di// nges 'byung blo yis bskul bas na// ring min thar ba'i grong 'jug nges// de la 'dir dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i rang gzugs dpal ldan karma pa chen po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom rim zhig spel ba ste/

de yang bdag cag gi ston pas mdo rgyud drang nges kyi theg pa rnams las bla ma mchod ba mgrin gcig bsngags pa'i gnas su gsungs shing*/ khyad par rje mthon mthing dang pad+ma rā ga'i cod pan 'chang ba gru 'dzin bdag po'i phreng ba 'dzin ba rnams ni gsar rnying du ma nas lung gis zin pa'i chos kyi rgyal po nges pa nyid du mngon sum tshad mar grub cing*/ des na bcos min shugs 'byung mos gus tsam gyis rang sems chos skur 'char ba'i lam zab mo gcig chod kyi gdams pa bstan te/ gdod nas grub pa'i gnas sam rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas lta bur bla ma'i sku brnyan dang phyag zhabs kyi rjes bkram la/ tshogs gnyis bsod nams spel ba'i rten 'brel du phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon mchod rdzas ji snyed pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal nang mchod bdud rtsi thabs shes kyi rdzas mchog tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad rnams 'du bgyid la/ rang nyid bde dgyes sogs yi dam gang rung bskyed la dang po nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/

oṃ āḥbigh+nan gyis bsangs/ oṃ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ dngos kun stong par gyur pa'i ngang*// rlung dkyil sngon po gzhu dbyibs can// yam̐ yig ba dan mtshan pa'i steng*// me dkyil dmar po zur gsum 'bar// ram̐ yig mtshan pa de steng du// kam̐ las mi mgo'i thod sgyed gsum// a las mtshan ldan ka pā la// yangs shing rgya che phyi dkar la// nang dmar thabs shes mtshon pa yi// dbus su mu las dri yi chu// shar du bi las dri chen dang*// lho ru ra las rak+ta bskyil// nub tu shu las byang sems dkar// byang du ma las klad pa ste// bdud rtsi rnam lnga slar yang ni// dbus su na las mi yi sha// shar lhor go las ba glang dang*// lho nub ku las khyi yi sha /nub byang da las glang chen dang*// byang shar ha las rta yi sha /bdud rtsi dang ni sha chen lnga// yi ge so sos rgyas btab bo// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas// hūm̐ gi dbyibs can rlung spros pas// rlung g.yos me bskyod thod rdzas khol// dam tshig bdud rtsi'i 'od klong las// oṃ āḥhūm̐ spros ye shes kyi// zag med bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas// byin rlabs dam ye dbyer med pa'i// mtha' klas ye shes rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod bas byin brlabs la/ de nas sngon 'gro'i gtor ma'ang gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ kha kha khā hi sogs lan bzhi brjod la/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i dbang gis ni// zhing skyong mthu chen brgyad rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis sogs// dkyil 'khor bsgrub la mngon phyogs pa'i// ma lus 'khor dang yang 'khor rnams// 'dir gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzang*// lnga ldan dag pa'i bdud rtsi yis// sbyangs spel bsgyur ba'i 'dod yon rnams// bzhes nas rnal 'byor mthun rkyen spel// nad gdon zhi dang dpal 'byor rgyas// mos pa rnam bzhis dbang sdus la// log 'dren bar chad rkyen ngan sol/

mdor na yid la gang bsam pa'i// 'dod don lhun gyis grub par mdzod// gang dag lta bar mi dbang ba'i// gdon bgegs 'byung po phyir dengs shig /bka' las 'das na chos nyid kyi// bden pas thal bar brlag ta re// oṃ sum bha ni drag tu brjod/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus par// rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer las// rdo rje'i rwa gur ye shes me'i// srung ba'i 'khor los gtams par gyur// badz+ra rak+sha rak+sha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐// ces srung 'khor bsgoms la/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ nang mchod kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod snod du// hūm̐ yig dpag med 'od du zhu ba las// rdo rje'i mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas rol mo rnams// lha rdzas rmad byung zag med bde ba che// kun tu bzang po'i smon lam las grub bzhin// mchod pa'i sprin gyis rab 'byams dbyings gang ba// rgyal rnams dgyes pa skyed pa'i rang bzhin gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wad+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐/ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag gzhan mar gyur mkha' khyab rnams// deng bzung snying po byang chub bar// ston mchog zhi ba chags bral ba// 'phags tshogs dge 'dun bdag nyid can// dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// byin rlabs rtsa ba brgyud par bcas// yi dam dkyil 'khor rab 'byams lha// dngos grub 'byung gnas dam pa dang*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog /thugs rje'i gter mnga' dkon mchog gsum// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// skyabs su mchi'o bdag byin rlobs// lan bdun nam nyer gcig brgya tsam brjod/ 'gro rnams 'khor ba'i duḥkha las// sgrol phyir bdag nyid zab mo'i lam// 'khod nas gzhan phan sems bskyed kyis// kun kyang rnam grol thob par bgyi//

lan gsum sems bskyed la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan// sdug bsngal rgyu dang bral gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang spangs pa yi// btang snyoms chen por gnas gyur cig / ces lan gsum tshad med bsgoms la/ de nas bla ma'i dkyil 'khor bskyed ba'i rim pa ni/ oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā sogs/ zhes dngos snang 'dzin pa'i bag chags thams cad don dam stong nyid ye shes chen po'i dbyings su sbyangs la/ chos rnams dmigs med stong pa'i ngang nyid las// bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa// sgo bzhi rta babs chos 'khor gdugs ri dwags// drwa phyed mda' yab 'dod snam rin po che// sna tshogs rgyan dang phyogs mtshams kun tu yang*// ba dan rnga yab gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs// gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med 'phro// steng 'og shar sngo lho ser nub dmar ba// byang ljang dbus dkar phyi rim rdo rje yi// rwa ba dang ni 'od zer 'bar ba can// dbus su pad sdong yal ga lngar gyes pa'i// dbus mar pad dkar 'dab ma bcu gsum pa// ze'u 'bru ge sar rgyas pa'i lte ba la// mi 'jigs bzhi dang ldan pa seng ge'i khri// lha klu mi yi bsod nams las grub pa'i// rin thang bral ba'i reg bya du mas brgyan// dri med dwangs gsal chu shel cha rdzogs steng*// sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bo rigs dkyil bdag /rje btsun bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje 'chang*// dkar gsal zhal gcig bgres tshul dbu skyes dkar// spyan gnyis don dam skye med klong du gzigs// mthong grol zhwa nag gser mdangs khyung gshog can// nor bu rin chen du mas rgyan mdzes pa// rigs bdag mi bskyod brda mtshon dbu la gsol// phyag gnyis bde stong dbyer med rdo rje dril// bsnol 'dzin sku la chos gos rnam gsum dang*// za 'og ber gsol zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung*// g.yo med drang po'i lus gnad sangs kyis bzhugs// g.yas g.yon rim bzhin skyes rabs gser gyi phreng*// mtha' skor pad 'dab bcu gsum so so'i steng*// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang dang po'i dbus// dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa bgres nyams ldan// dbu skyes rab dkar spyan gnyis bar snang gzigs// phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag dpal be'u zhabs rdor skyil// gnyis par grub chen karma pak+shi ni// smug nag ag tshom zur gsum spyan lta stangs// zil gnon phyag rgya zhabs gnyis rdor skyil bzhugs// gsum par sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje ni// dkar gsal mi'u thung gzugs la spyan hrig ge// chos 'khor phyag rgya zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung*// bzhi par 'dzam gling rol pa'i rdo rje ni// zhal dkyus ring zhing mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag rgyas// 'khor lo 'dzin zhing zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bzhugs// lnga par de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan dpes brgyan// skyabs sbyin phyag na rin chen phreng ba 'dzin// zhabs gnyis bzang po'i stabs bzhugs drug par ni// mthong ba don ldan sgeg nyams smin ma 'khyugs// rdo rje dril 'dzin pad+ma'i skyil mo krung*// bdun par chos grags rgya mtsho dkar smug brjid// chos 'chad me tog nor bu 'dzin zhabs gnyis// sems skyil gyis bzhugs brgyad pa mi bskyod rgyal// sku bong ring zhing phyag zhabs mthil bstan nas// byin rlabs stangs stabs kyis bzhugs dgu par ni// dbang phyug rdo rje dkar gsal phyag gnyis kyis// sa gnon mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa bsnams// rdor skyil gyis bzhugs bcu par bzo sbyong mchog

/badz+ra dharmā dhā tu bgres nyams can// mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag pad dkar sdong bu 'dzin// sems skyil gyis bzhugs bcu gcig rgyal ba'i dbang*// ye shes rdo rje mnyam bzhag mi g.yo zhabs// rdor skyil bzhugs shing bcu gnyis mnyam med 'dren// byang chub rdo rje gzhon tshul zhi ma khro// skyabs sbyin mnyam bzhag yid bzhin nor bu 'dzin// rdor skyil gyis bzhugs kun kyang dbu la ni// zhwa nag gser mdangs gsol zhing chos gos gsum// zab ber lhab lhub skur gsol de dag kyang*// ngo bo gcig la rnam pa du mar sprul// gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro ba'i skyabs su bzhugs// bcu gsum mdun dbus zhwa dmar cod pan can// dpal ldan mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho ni// sku sha rab rgyas spyan gnyis dbyings su gzigs// phyag gnyis thabs shes ngo bo rdor dril 'dzin// zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// chos gos rnam gsum ber chen zlum gsol zhing*// thabs mkhas gang 'dul der snang ston cing bzhugs// rgyab phyogs steng gi pad+ma nyi ma'i steng*// khyab bdag rdor 'chang mthon mthing rdo rje dril// bsnol 'dzin rang 'od yum 'khyud longs sku'i chas// yongs rdzogs rin chen rgyan ldan zhabs rdor skyil// g.yas phyogs pad+mar zla steng sgrol ma dkar// spyan bdun phyag g.yas mchog spyin g.yon ut+pal// dar dang rin chen rgyan ldan rdor skyil bzhugs// g.yon phyogs pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i steng*// o rgyan chen po pad zhwa phod ka dang*// chos gos gsol zhing rdo rje thod pa bsnams// kha ṭ+wām̐ dkur bsten rdor skyil lham mer gsal// mdun phyogs 'og gi pad+mar nyi ro'i steng*// ber can rang byung rgyal mo 'khril sbyor rol// rngams shing zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan gsum 'bar// gnyis ka'ang gri thod 'dzin cing ber nag gsol// khro bo'i chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs bzhugs// lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐// gdod nas lhun grub 'gyur med ngo bos mtshan// de ltar dkon mchog kun 'dus karma pa// sku yi bkod pas zhing khams yongs la khyab// rab 'byams zhing rnams ma lus sku la rdzogs// gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer 'phros// mi mngon chos dbyings gnas nas rtsa gsum gyi// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bskyed pa dang 'dra ba// bu yug 'tshubs bzhin mdun mkhar spyan drangs gyur//

zhes brjod la byin 'bebs pa ni/ steng dag pa 'og min zhing khams nas// rigs kun gyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang*// sangs rgyas dang byang sems gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur la byin chen dbab tu gsol// g.yas po ta la yi gnas mchog nas// dus gsum gyi rgyal yum sgrol ma dkar// lha yi dam zhi khro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur la byin chen dbab tu gsol// g.yon dpal ri pad+ma 'od zhing nas// mchog grub pa'i spyi mes pad+ma 'byung*// 'khor rig 'dzin ḍā ki gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur la byin chen dbab tu gsol// dbus rang sems snang stong pho brang nas// rje karma pa yi skyes rabs phreng*// bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur la byin chen dbab tu gsol// 'og dam tshig gnyen po'i dur khrod nas// dpal ma hā kā la re ma ti// bka' chos skyong rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur la byin chen dbab tu gsol// rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ oṃ shrī mān gu ru maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ ces spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ dam ye gnyis med du bstims la/ slar yang gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// rang bzhin gnas nas dbang lha spyan drangs te// rigs lnga yab yum la sogs de bzhin gshegs// dgongs pa mdzad dang shis brjod me tog 'thor// rin chen bum bzang bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis// dbang bskur chu lhag yar lud rigs lnga po// sprul sku'i rnam pas so so'i dbu brgyan gyur// ces dbang bskur rgyas gdab dang*/ de nas mchod pa'i bye brag rnams rim bzhin 'bul ba ni/ mtha' yas 'gro khams rgya mtsho na// dri med mchod yon ji snyed pa// rnam dag mos blos 'bul lags na// bzhes nas smin grol dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

mtha' yas 'gro khams rgya mtsho na// rgyun 'bab zhabs bsil ji snyed pa// rnam dag mos blos 'bul lags na// bzhes nas smin grol dngos grub stsol// sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ pā d+yaṃ= mtha' yas 'gro khams rgya mtsho na// rab mdzes me tog ji snyed pa// rnam dag mos blos 'bul lags na// bzhes nas smin grol dngos grub stsol// puṣ+pe= mtha' yas 'gro khams rgya mtsho na// bdug spos bsung zhim ji snyed pa// rnam dag mos blos 'bul lags na// bzhes nas smin grol dngos grub stsol/ dhū pe= /mtha' yas 'gro khams rgya mtsho na// snang gsal 'od zer ji snyed pa// rnam dag mos blos 'bul lags na// bzhes nas smin grol dngos grub stsol// ā lo ke= mtha' yas 'gro khams rgya mtsho na// byung ba'i dri bzang ji snyed pa// rnam dag mos blos 'bul lags na// bzhes nas smin grol dngos grub stsol// gan+dhe= mtha' yas 'gro khams rgya mtsho na// zhal zas sna tshogs ji snyed pa// rnam dag mos blos 'bul lags na// bzhes nas smin grol dngos grub stsol// nai wi d+ye= mtha' yas 'gro khams rgya mtsho na// rgyud mangs bye brag ji snyed pa// rnam dag mos blos 'bul lags na// bzhes nas smin grol dngos grub stsol// shab+da= / mchod rol bya/ 'jig rten rab 'byams zhing rnams na// rdo rje gzugs sgra dri ro reg /rmad byung yid 'ong mchod pa rnams// 'bul bzhes dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// oṃ badz+ra ru pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rin chen 'khor lo dpal be'u pad+ma dang*// rgyal mtshan gdugs bzang bum pa dung dkar po// gser nya bkra shis rmad byung rtags brgyad 'di// bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul// gser gyi 'khor los mnga' dbang bsgyur// bsam 'phel nor bu dgos 'dod 'byung*// btsun mo rin chen bde stong ster// khyim bdag zas g.yang dpal 'byor brjid// khyu mchog stobs bcu'i rtsal chen rdzogs// cang shes rdzu 'phrul thar lam drongs// dmag dpon bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal// rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun po// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// rgyal kun thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// rgyal ba nyid dang dbyer med shog

/gang zhig 'jig rten 'di'am gzhan// dpal 'byor srid zhi'i longs spyod kyi// mchod pa'i sprin phung zad med par// rgya chen bskal par 'phro gyur cig / spro na yan lag bdun pa bton la/ de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sogs yig brgya brjod/ zhing khams yang dag gser gyi sa gzhi brdal// rdo rje'i ri yi khor yug ra bas bskor// dbus su ri dbang rgyal po mchog rab mtho// gling chen lus 'phags 'dzam gling ba lang spyod// sgra mi snyan dang gling g.yog rol mtsho sogs// rin chen sa 'dzin yongs 'du sa brtol ljon// 'dod 'jo'i ba mo ma rmos 'bru sna tshogs// rgyal srid sna bdun gter chen bum pa bzang*// mchod pa'i lha mos yongs bskor nyi zla gsal// kun khyab gdugs dkar mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgrengs// gzhan yang khams gsum phyi snod nang bcud kyi// longs spyod phun tshogs phra rab rdul bye snyed// grangs med mngon par bkod legs maṇ+ḍal 'di// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// dpa' po mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams la// gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas bdag rgyud smin grol byin gyis rlobs// oṃ maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ sa gzhi spos chus

sogs dang*/ dngos dang yid sprul rgya mtshos drangs pa yi// dgos 'byung nor bu'i maṇ+ḍal 'di phul bas// byang chub lam la bar chad dang bral zhing*// srid zhir mi gnas rnam grol mchog thob shog /sku gsum yongs rdzogs bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// sogs kyang brjod nas/ phyag 'tshal mchod bshags yi rangs bskul gsol 'debs// bdag lus longs spyod dus gsum dge rtsa 'bul// chos dbyings myang 'das chen por bsngo bar bgyi// ma rnams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog / ces phyi yi mchod pa phul nas/ nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ bdud rtsi mtheb srin gyis mchod la/ rdo rje 'chang chen yum gyur 'phags ma dang*// gu ru pad+ma dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen// grub chen karma pa dang rang byung zhabs// rol pa'i rdo rje thub chen de bzhin gshegs/ mthong ba don ldan chos grags rgya mtsho dang*// mi bskyod rdo rje dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhabs// chos dbyings rdo rje ye shes rdo rje mchog /byang chub rdo rje bdud tshogs 'dul rdo rje// mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho la sogs pa// rtsa bar brgyud pa'i mchod 'os rab 'byams dang*// ma hā kā la bka' sdod dam can tshogs// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bul grub gnyis stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod la/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje lha mo bcu drug po// rgyan ldan mtshar sdug mdog sna tshogs// pi waṃ gling bu rnga chen dang*// rdza rnga la sogs thogs pa dang*// bzhad dang sgeg pa glu gar mkhan// me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri// gzugs dang ro bcud reg bya ma// chos dbyings bde stong lha mo'i tshogs// yid 'ong mchod pa spro bzhin du// dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra bī ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ de bzhin thog mtha' 'dra bar/ waṃ she= mṛ daṃ gi= mu rañje= hā s+ye= lā s+ye= gīrti= nṛ t+ya= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= dī paṃ= gan+dhe=

oṃ rū pa badz+re= rā sa= spar+she= dharmā dhā tu badz+re bar brjod/ zhes 'bul/ mchod bya mchod byed thams cad kyang*// rang byung rig ba'i rtsal las gsal// dngos snang 'dzin med de bzhin nyid// blo 'das chen po'i ngang du rol// ma hā dz+nyā na shun+ya tā pū dza hoḥ zhes de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa chen po'o// de nas bstod pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hrīḥ spros bral rang byung bde ba che// don dam 'gags med thugs rje'i mdangs// sgyu 'phrul drwa bas zhing kun khyab// rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod// smra bsam blo 'das pha rol phyin// mnyam nyid ngang nas gang 'dul ston// dus gsum rgyal kun skyed pa'i yum// 'phags ma sgrol mar phyag 'tshal bstod// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i spyi dpal mchog /gdod ma'i sangs rgyas he ru ka/ 'chi med grub pa'i gter chen po// pad+mā ka rar phyag 'tshal bstod// bskal bzang zhing 'dir sangs rgyas stong*// ma 'ongs rnam 'dren drug pa ni// seng ge zhes byar 'tshang rgya ba'i// zab mo'i thugs bskyed ldan la 'dud// gang zhig rnam 'phrul du ma yi// chu zla'i gar gyis brtse ba can// 'gro la mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i gnyen// gang 'dul der snang ston der 'dud// chos nor dbang bsgyur 'dzam bu'i gling*// byang phyogs bsil ri'i ljongs 'di ru// spyan ras gzigs dang dbyer med par// gcig gyur 'brel tshad don ldan 'dud// mthon mthing cod pan phreng ba 'dzin// dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa nas// bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i bar// skyes rabs bcu gsum drang nges kyi// mdo rgyud rgya mtshor gsal la 'dud// sangs rgyas dngos las lhag pa yi// bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin// rigs dang dkyil 'khor yongs kyi bdag /rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rjer 'dud// sngon bsags legs byas smin pa'i mthus// kun rdzob snang ngor zhal mthong zhing*// smin grol chos kyi bdud rtsis tshims// thugs kyis byin brlabs rjes bzung 'dud// de las byung ba'i lam zab mo// kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po zhes// don dam rang rtsal snang cha las// snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor shar// mnyam nyid mkha' klong ye dag pa'i// stong nyid ye shes chen po ru// grag stong brjod med bstod pas bstod// gsal stong ngang du phyag 'tshal bstod// snying rje'i dbyings las khros pa'i tshul// nyon mongs bdud bzhi tshar gcod pa'i// ye shes mgon po ber yab yum// bka' sdod tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems lha// rab 'byams rdul snyed grangs 'das kyang*// karma ka yi ngo bor gsal// bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa// ye shes chos skyong ber nag can// dkon mchog kun 'dus karma pa// bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*// skye dang tshe rabs 'bral med shog

/ ces rang dang sems can thams cad lus gaṅgā'i klung bye snyed du sprul nas phyag 'tshal bar dmigs nas nges 'byung skyo shas drag po'i sgo nas 'bad par bya'o// de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ spro na dang por phung po gsum pa'i mdo bton la thal mo sbyar phyag 'tshal zhing*/ kyai/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po deng bdag sogs mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la dgongs su gsol lo// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas thog med dus ring nas da lta'i bar du bsags pa'i nyon mongs pa lnga'i dbang du gyur pa'i mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa bslab bya dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa dang ltung ba'i tshogs ci dang ci mchis pa thams cad 'dun pa drag po'i sgo nas mthol lo bshags so// mi 'chab bo// mi sbed do// phyin chad nges par sdom lags so// ces lan gsum brjod/ oṃ sa ma ya/ āḥs ma ya/ hūm̐ sa ma ya/ oṃ shrī mā na karma ka sa twa sa ma ya sogs/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ ci nus brjod mthar/ bla ma chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo kun gyi zhal nas/ kye hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag go zhes gnang ba byin par gyur/ de ltar dag tshangs dbugs dbyung dngos su thob bar bsam mo// de nas bla ma rgyang 'bod la 'jug ste/ mos gus tshad ma rgyud la skye ba'i rnal 'byor pa dag gis 'di ltar bsgom mo// ༈ //bla ma'i sku las byung ba'i byin rlabs ril bu khar bcug la/ spyi bor sgom zhwa bcings/ bla gos phrag par gzar chos gos kyi grwa lag g.yon gyis dkur bsten/ g.yas thal mo phyir bstan gyis dku g.yas bsten la ngag tu/ bla ma dam pa dran byung ngo*// rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen por gsal byung ngo*// rnam dag gi zhing khams rgya mtshor 'byams klas song ngo*// 'od zer bzod med du 'bar song ngo*// snod bcud thams cad zhu song ngo*// rdo rje 'chang bdag la dbab par mdzod// bdag la ngal gso bar mdzod//

ces brjod cing 'don sgom drag tu byas pas ye shes 'dren pa'i mos gus bskyed mi thub na/ ḍā kiṇ+ḍahoḥ bla ma nam dran pa na lus rnam snang chos bdun lag pa gnyis sa gnon byas la steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar/ lus gyi nang stong seng du bsgoms nas sked skor byas rim nas rnam shes 'gags/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems zla gdan du gyur ba la bla ma ci 'dra kho na bzhugs su gsol ba bsgoms nas sked skor drag tu byas pas bla ma stong chen du zhu nas zla dkyil gyi thig le dmar bo yungs 'bru tsam la shes ba gtad/ 'di ni 'od gsal bskyed pa'i mos gus 'dren thabs yin no// rnam shes ye shes su 'pho bar byed ba'i phyir yin na/ gzhan gong dang 'dra ba la/ spyi bor thal byung gi nam mkhar bla ma ye shes kyi me 'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i zhabs g.yon pa'i mthe bong gi 'od zer gyis rang sems 'od gsal snying ga nas thig le dmar po sran chung tsam pa de rang dbang med par bsdus nas bsgom zhing drag sbyor bya ba dang*/ ye shes phyag chen stsol med du ma skyes na le lan thams cad nga dbyangs can bzang po la bsdos shig /de ltar mi bskyod rgyal bas gsung bzhin 'di ni thun mong min pa'i rdo rje'i bka' la tshad bzung lhur len gyis mos gus skyed cig / rje rdo rje 'chang chen man chad nas// bdud 'dul ba'i rdo rje yan chad kyi// bka' brgyud pa'i grub thob bla ma'i tshogs// deng bde chen 'khor lor rtag bzhugs la// nged skal ldan bu rnams bskyab tu gsol// las nyon mongs 'khor ba'i 'dam du byings// chos bla ma'i dkor gyis rang rgyud bsregs// bdud bzhi yi chu bos khyer la nye// ngan song gi g.yang sar lhung nges ba'i// ma rig pa'i mun pas bsgribs pa yi// bdag mkha' khyab sems can snying rjes dgongs// duḥkha las myur du bskyab tu gsol// dus snyigs ma lnga bdor skyes pa yi// skal med rnams dge ba ring du bsrings// mi dge ba'i las kyi khur chen non// bdag sems can la brtse bas bzung du gsol// las 'phro dang ldan nam snyam pa yi// rje dngos kyis bslab sdom dam tshig nod// 'phral mos blo bsgyur yang rkyen ma chags// rang byas las rang smin nga re 'gyod// phyi dbyibs legs zhi dul tsam yod rung*// nang dug lnga'i rnam rtog rgyas pa yis// nyes ltung gi char pa rgyun mi chad// sdig chen bdag thugs rjes da gzigs shig

/bla ma la sangs rgyas 'du shes bral// gnas gdan sar zhing khams mi mthong ba// mched grogs la dag snang mi 'byong ba// rgyud dred por thugs rjes da gzigs shig /dus lnga bdo'i yang mthar 'khor ba yi// srid bzung gi 'gro ba mchis so cog /skal ba dang rigs chad kyi dbang gis ni// rje khyed dang ma mjal snying rje'i gnas// kye ma kye hud thugs rjes 'dor ram ci// dad mos gus drag pos rgyud rlan pa'i// las skal bar ldan rnams byin rlabs kyi// lam bzang por dkri bar mdzad du gsol// lar sems kyi cho 'phrul bag chags kun// zad med kyi chu bo'i rgyun 'di bzhin// rang byung la rang yal mkha' 'dra ba// skye 'gags dang gnas med kyi ngang nyid du// brjod med pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya che// dpal kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa'i don// bka' brgyud pa gshegs shul lam zab mo// de mngon sum rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// ces snang ba 'gyur nges bya'o// bka' brgyud pa 'di mos gus byin rlabs kyi brgyud ba yin pas bcos min dag snang sbyang ba gal che bar gda'o// 'di skabs rje mi bskyod rgyal bas mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs thun bzhir rtag par 'don zhing*/ 'dir spro na bde stong ma/ zung 'jug ma/ rdo rje 'chang chen ma/ dngos kun ma sogs dang*/ karma pa na rim dang*/ zhwa dmar bcu pa'i gsol 'debs bcas bya zhing*/ bsdu na yang rdo rje 'chang chen ma/ karma pa bcu gsum dang zhwa dmar bcu pa'i gsol 'debs bcas bton la/ de nas bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi sku las 'od zer 'phros nas rtsa ba'i bla mar thim pas de las byin rlabs 'od zer lnga ldan du phyogs bcur 'phros nas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub char bzhin du babs nas dbyer med du thim pas phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig

/ ces bsam la/ oṃ āḥmā ra da ma ka badz+ra hūm̐ swā hā/ skyes rabs thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin la yin bzhin du gtso bo'i bsnyen pa gang 'grub bya'o// steng rdo rje 'chang la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra dhṛkra hūm̐ swā hā/ g.yas sgrol mar dmigs la/ oṃ tā re sogs/ g.yon o rgyan rin po cher dmigs nas/ badz+ra gu ru sogs/ 'og mgon po lcam dral la dmigs nas/ oṃ ma hā kā la ma hā kā lī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ces so sor gang 'grub bzla'o// de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni/ thog mar tshogs rdzas rnams/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la bsangs sbyangs spel bar bya'o// na mo thabs shes bde stong gnyis med kyi// zab mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'dod yon bzang*// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ldan zag med kyi// ye shes chen por sbyangs spel bsgyur byas 'di// byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma dngos grub kyi// 'byung gnas yi dam phrin las chos skyong ba// dam can rgya mtsho la sogs mchod 'os la// 'bul phyir kun kyang dbyings nas sku bskyod cig /pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ hūm̐/ gnas 'og min nges pa lnga ldan zhing*// mchog kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan pa// rigs kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang*// tshogs 'khor lor rol phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas po ta la yi zhing khams nas// 'gags med kyi thugs rje'i rang bzhin can// rgyal kun gyi yum gyur sgrol ma dkar// tshogs 'khor lor rol phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas sprul zhing dpal ri pad+ma 'od// sgyu 'phrul gyi rol pa'i gar rtsed mkhan/ dpal pad+ma 'byung gnas he ru ka /tshogs 'khor lor rol phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas 'gyur med yongs grub 'dod ma'i gshis// gshis kun khyab rang snang klong yangs nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// mthon mthing gi cod pan 'chang ba po// skyes rabs kyi phreng ba bcu gsum dang*// gnas bde chen pad+ma bkod pa nas// tshe 'od snang mtha' yas rnam par 'phrul// dpal mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho sogs// rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// byin rlabs kyi sprin phung thibs se thib// dngos grub kyi char rgyun si li li// tshogs 'khor lor rol phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas dur khrod 'jigs rung rtsub 'gyur tshal// bskal me 'bar rlung nag 'tshub dkyil nas// rdo rje ber rang byung rgyal mo sogs// tshogs 'khor lor rol phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas dkyil 'khor gzhal yas nyams re dga'// rdzas mchod pa gzi ldan dang re spro// rnal 'byor rnams rdo rje'i dam re gtsang*// phyi snod dang nang bcud byin gyis rlobs//

ces spyan drangs la/ de nas tshogs phud rim bzhin spros la gtor ma gsos nas yang nang mchod ltar gyi byin rlabs byas la gtor bsngos ni/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ pad skor dang rdor thal kha phye bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍāk+kī ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ lan gsum/ na mo rat+na gu ru i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ chos sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje btsun ār+ya tā re/ o rgyan pad+ma badz+ra/ te lo pradz+nyā bha dra/ nā ro dz+nyā na sid+dhi/ mar pa dharma ma ti/ mi la hā s+ye badz+ra/ snyi sgom puṇ+ye rat+na/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon dar ma grags/ spom brag pa bsod nams rdo rje/ grub chen karma pak+shi/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ 'dzam gling rol pa'i rdo rje/ rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ rje btsun rin chen bzang po/ kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan/ ban sgar 'jam dpal bzang po/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho/ grub chen bkra shis dpal 'byor/ 'jigs med dbyangs can bzang po/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag /rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje/ gar dbang dharme shwa ra/ rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje/ dpal ldan ye shes snying po/ mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ rgyal dbang bodhi badz+ra/ 'jam mgon dharmā ka ra/ rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje/ mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho la sogs pa grub pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i bka' brgyud rin po che'i snying po don gyi drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog /rje btsun rnal 'byor ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho la sogs pa yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

ye shes kyi mgon po ma hā kā la rdo rje ber nag po can/ 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug lha mo rang byung rgyal mo la sogs pa ye shes dang las dang 'jig rten gyi dregs pa chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud rnams dang*/ dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po/ yum chen si na ra ma/ las mkhan bdud dmag stong sde'i tshogs rnams dang*/ dam can skyes bu chen po/ mched zla sum brgya drug cu/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho tshogs kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ de ltar dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'bul ba'i mthus byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsol cig /zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thogs pa med pa'i sgo nas rnal 'byor skyong zhing khyad par bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin rnams srung skyob g.yel ba med par ji ltar bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /

ces 'bul lo// de nas phyogs skyong rnams la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi dang*/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ ha ha sogs nas pheṃ bar brjod/ hūm̐/ dam tshig sogs nas/ 'grub par mdzod/ bar brjod la/ de nas sgrub pa po rnam tshogs la rol zhing thabs shes kyi rdzas 'dzin bzhin du/ kyai/ bde stong rten 'brel zab mo'i rang bzhin can// longs spyod tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgyes par rol// zhes drangs la/ len pa pos/ hoḥ thabs shes ngo bo byin rlabs kun 'byung gnas// gnyis 'dzin ye dag dri med e ma hoḥ zhes brjod nas rol bar bya'o// de nas phud lhag la bdud rtsis bran la/ a kā ro sa byin gyis rlabs/ gang dag dkyil 'khor gnyen po'i mu khyud la gnas pa'i 'khor gyi bka' nyan bran g.yog dam tshig gnyen po'i gdung sems can lhag ma'i gtor ma dbang ba rnams la phud lhag bshal chu'i mchod pa 'bul lo// bstan ba rin po che bsrung ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i phrin las rnam bzhi myur du 'grub pa dang*/ 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cing ji ltar bcol pa'i las rnams g.yel med du sgrub bar mdzod cig /sarba uts+tshi ṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa si kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lhag ma phyi rol du phul/ de nas rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa gso bran legs par byas nas/ rgyas par na gong gi mchod pa byin rlabs dang phyi mchod tshan gnyis bcas/ bsdu na sngags mchod tsam dang bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan khyod kyi thugs rje'i nyi ma chen pos srid pa'i mkha' la khyab// gang zhig ma rig nyon mongs sgrib gnyis mun stug drwa ba gzhom pa yi// mtha' yas zab mo'i stobs mnga' gdul bya rgya mtsho'i 'dam skyes pad+mo'i gnyen// ji ltar 'dud do byams pa'i 'od zer bdag blo kun tu gsal bar mdzod// zhes brjod/ bzod gsol ni/ deng 'dir dkyil 'khor bsgrub la nongs pa yi// lta sgom ting 'dzin bzlas brjod g.yel ba dang*// mchod rdzas 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur nyams pa sogs// nyes pa gyur rnams bzod gsol dag tshangs stsol//

rten 'brel snying po dbyangs gsal byed sbrel bar lan gsum brjod la/ de nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi len pa'i mos gus drag pos 'di skad do// bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin blo yis sogs tshar kha shas brjod la thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs shing gsan du gsol// mos 'dun gdung bas rgyal rnams mchod bskul na// skal ldan bdag rgyud smin grol byin rlabs kyi// char chen dngos grub dam pa myur du stsol// de yi ngang nas phyi rim dkyil 'khor dang*// skyabs yul bla ma'i lha tshogs ma lus kun// 'od zer ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla mar thim// dkon mchog kun 'dus dpal ldan rigs kun bdag /dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas mdzod spu nas// 'od zer dkar po rang gi dpral bar thim// lus kyi sgrib dag sku mchog bum dbang thob// bskyed rim bsgom par dbang zhing sprul sku 'grub// mgrin pa'i gnas nas 'od dmar zer 'phros te// rang gi mgrin thim ngag gi sgrib dag nas// gsung mchog gsang ba'i dbang thob rtsa rlung la// bsgom par dbang zhing longs sku 'grub par 'gyur// thugs ka'i gnas nas 'od sngon zer 'phros te// rang gi snying gar thim pas yid sgrib dag /thugs mchog sher dbang thob cing snyoms 'jug la// bsgom par dbang zhing chos sku 'grub par 'gyur// gnas gsum 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ga 'phros// rang gi sgo gsum la thim sgrib tshogs dag /bzhi pa'i dbang mchog thob ste phyag rgya che// bsgom par dbang zhing ngo bo nyid sku 'grub// de nas nges ba don gyi byin rlabs pa// bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim// dbyer med gcig 'dres mtsho la char babs bzhin// mi phyed rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo gyur// ces ci gnas su mnyam bzhag byas la ngo bo bskyang bar bya'o// de'i ngang nas lus gsal stong*/ ngag grag stong*/

sems bde stong gi ngang nas spyod lam la 'jug go /de nas bsngo smon ni/ gcig chod lam gyi mthar thug bsgrubs pa yi// dge bas bdag gzhan khams gsum sems can kun// rang byung ye shes de nyid gnas mthong nas// sku lnga'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog / de nas shis pa'i me tog char du bsnyil la/ oṃ shrī shrī shrī swa sti/ sngon tshe rdzogs ldan bskal bzang bstan pa la// skye rgu'i dpal yon bde legs dgung la bsnyegs// kun kyang zhi ba chos kyi bdud rtsi yis// tshad med sgrol bzhin deng yang bkra shis shog /ji ltar srid 'di'i shis pa'i yon tan rnams// rnal 'byor dpon slob yid la 'dod 'jo ba'i/ dpag bsam rkang 'thung ljon bzhin rtag brtan zhing*// tshogs gnyis 'bras bu mngon par phyug gyur cig /gang zhig 'khor ba'i 'ching pa ring spangs nas// rgyal ba'i zhing khams bkod pa lhun grub tu// rnam dag snying po'i don rab ston pa'i phyir// bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje rgyal po dang*// gnyis med zung du 'brel ba'i mched lcam rnams// rtag tu 'bral med phun sum tshogs pa yi// tshom bu gcig gi ngang du sangs rgyas nas// 'gro khams yongs sgrol chen po'i bkra shis shog / gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod sogs kyang spro na bya'o// de ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas karma pa bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rje'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchod phreng gis brgyan pa zhig dgos zhes dad brtson gyis nye bar phyug pa dge slong bsod nams dbang rgyal gyis sa spyod gsung gi gnas mchog dpal karma'i dgon nas bskul ba'i ngor mthon mthing cod pan 'chang ba bcu gsum pa dang*/ rā ga'i cod pan 'chang ba bcu pa bcas rtsod dus kyi rdo rje 'chang nyid du nges pa'i blo can/ rgyal ba gnyis kyis rjes su 'dzin pa si tu sprul sku pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gyi gtsug lag tu bkod pa 'gro rnams thar pa'i rgya mtshor chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dpal la spyod nas dpal ldan bla ma chen po'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/sarba mad+ga laṃ/ su dza yan+tu/// / ༈ bla ma'i mchod chog nam mkha' ye dwangs kyi smin dbang dang bskang bshags lhan thabs su bsdebs pa bzhugs so// gu ru dharma kā ya na maḥ 'dir bla sgrub mchod pa dang 'brel ba'i spros med don gyi dbang bzhi len pa ni gzhung du gsal na'ang*/ spros pa la dga' ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi ngor gsang sngags bla med lugs kyi smin dbang gis rgyud brlan pa'i gdams pa spel ba bya ste/ de'ang dang po bshams bkod la/ bum stegs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang rgyun 'bab chus sum gnyis bkang pa'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la kha rgyan dang*/ dung chos/ gzungs rdor sogs bshams/ gzhan yang dbang rdzas kyi rigs dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming dbang gi rdor dril/ thod pa bdud rtsi dam rdzas kyis gtams pa/ gzungs ma'i tsakli/ dam chu/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu'i chas sogs dang nye bar mkho ba rnams kyang 'du bgyid cing*/ las bum yang gang bder bzhag /slar dgos rgyu'i sngon gtor zhig kyang bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du g.yon nas brtsams te nang mchod/ cang te'u/ rdor dril/ nas bzed rnams bkod la/ gnyis pa gzhung ltar gyi gdon bya rnams mthar chags su bton te mdun bskyed bsnyen pa bcas zin nas bum pa bdud rtsis bsangs zhing*/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā sogs dang*/ chos rnams mi dmigs stong pa nyid du gyur// bh+rūm̐ las rin chen bum pa mtshan rdzogs kyi// dbus su pad sdong yal ga ltar gyes pa'i// sogs mdun bskyed ji bzhin la/ mi mngon chos dbyings gnas nas rtsa gsum gyi// dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes sems// spyan drangs bum lhar gnyis su med par thim// rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ oṃ shrī mān gu ru maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dbyer med du gyur par mos la dbang bskur ba ni/

slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// dbang lha spyan drangs khrus gsol zhing*// chu zhabs gyen brten rigs lnga yis// rgyas gdab lha rnams rang thim gyur// gzhung ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ mtha' yas zhing khams rab 'byams kyi// dag cing dri med mchod pa'i rdzas// sna tshogs blo yis blangs nas su// dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar zla steng hūm̐// de mthar sngags phreng 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun// babs pas bum pa gang zhing slar 'od 'phros// bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib kun dag gyur// par bsams la sngags tshan lnga po so sor bzla'o// mthar dung chos kyi chu bum bar phul la/ oṃ shrī mān gu ru maṇ+ḍal ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā// zhes mchod yon 'bul zhing*/ bum lha 'od zhu dag byed lha chur gyur// puṣ+pe sogs nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ de nas gzungs rdor las bum khar spo nas las lha bskyed pa ni/ bigh+nān gyi sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ las bum dbus su pad nyi'i steng*// bgegs mthar byed pa sku mdog mthing*// rdo rje zhags bsnams khro chas rdzogs// thugs kar hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng gsal/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān sogs nyer gcig brjod la mthar bum chu'i bsang gtor bcas/ bsrung dang bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// khro rgyal 'od zhu bum chur gyur// par mos la/ gsum pa bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang len pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal bzhin par/ mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams kyis dbang gi bya ba mdzad par dmigs la/ las bum gyi khrus/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ bar dang*/ gzhung gi maṇ+ḍal/ zhing khams yang dag sogs nas/ sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ bar gyis phul/ de nas gsol ba gdab ba ni/ kyai/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin// dkyil 'khor kun bdag he ru ka

/bdag la smin byed zab mo'i dbang*// rgyud grol thugs rjes bzung du gsol// 'di rigs lan gsum mam re res 'thus so// slob dpon gyis/ kye hoḥ 'dir tshogs rigs ldan gyi// rdo rje slob ma khyed rnams nyon// gsang sngags dbang bzhi'i lam zab mo'i// snod dang ldan pa'i las can dag /zhugs kyi de bas skal dman rnams/ blta bar mi dbang dengs par rigs// de'i lan du/ e ma/ bdag cag nges par 'khor ba las// thar 'dod byang chub sems bskyed cing*// gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig rnams// nam yang mi spang srog ltar bsrung*// zhes zhu'o// de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ hoḥ gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// deng nas 'jug go dam med la// smra bar mi rung dam bca' bzung*// de phyir tha tshig ngo bor 'tshal/ /slob mas/ badz+ra sa ma ya rak+ṣaḥ brjod la dam chu blud/ de nas gzhung ltar gyi sngon gtor byin gyis brlabs la bsngo zhing 'bul te srung 'khor bcas zin nas/ kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems bskyed phyir// snying gar zla steng rdo rje rtse lnga bsgom// oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+taṃ ut+pā da yā mi// lan gsum snying gar rdo rjes reg la/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ ye shes dbab phyir gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bka' brgyud bla ma dpa' bo rnal 'byor tshogs// ye shes chos skyong rnams kyis bdag byin rlobs// lan gsum/ de nas dbang gi gzhi 'god pa'i don du dmigs pa ni/ sngar bskyed pa ji ltar slar yang slob ma'i don du gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun mkhar gzhal yas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa// sgo bzhi rta babs sogs mthar chags su bton la/ rab 'byams zhing rnams ma lus sku la rdzogs// bar dang*/ bdag nyid gzhan la dbang bskur dus khyed rang brjod lhar gsal thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// slob dpon thugs rgyud bskul zhing slar 'od 'phros// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bde chen rdo rje'i dbyings// zag med thugs dam rgyud bskul 'og min dang*// rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes spyan drangs te// mtsho la char babs lta bu slob ma la// sib sib thim pas dbyer med ro gcig gyur//

gu gul dang spos bsreg cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ steng dag pa 'og min sogs kyis byin 'bebs shing dbyangs dang bcas/ dbang bskur la byin chen dbab du gsol// bar dang*/ oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dhṛkra de wa ḍāk+kī nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra dz+nyā na badz+ra ā we sha ya ā be sha ya a a aḥ lan kha shas brjod cing snang ba 'gyur nges su byin phab/ de nas ngo sprad rdo rje'i glu blang ba/ ltos shig rang sems snang ba'i rtsal// ma skyes mi 'gags brjod ba bral// blo 'das bde chen gnyug ma'i gshis// gsal la der 'dzin med par skyongs// ye shes brtan phyir rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ dbang dngos gzhi'i don du/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gsol gdab ni/ e ma/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dpal tshogs// bdag la dgongs mdzod dbang bzhi yi// chu bo chen pos rgyud smin cing*// grol ba mngon gyur byin rlobs mdzod// lan gsum/ de nas dbang rdzas rnams rim bzhin thogs la/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// drangs pa'i dbang lha rigs lngas dgongs pa mdzad// sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i// me tog 'thor zhing mchod pa'i lha mos mchod// khro bo khro mos srung ba'i las mdzad cing*// rigs kyi yum lngas phyag na bum pa bzang*// ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud bkang 'dzin pa dang*// rin chen prog zhu cod pan dar chun 'phyangs// rtse mo dgu pa'i rdo rje 'od 'bar ba// dril bu grag stong rang sgra sgrog pa dang*// ming gi dbang mchog rdo rje dril bu sogs// bsnams nas dbang mchog dam pa sbyin par bya// dang po bum pas dbang bskur ba ni mgor bzhag la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ bar dang*/ bum chu btung gzhug la/ oṃ badz+ro da ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ bum chus bsang gtor yang bya zhing*/

de nas prog zhu thogs la/ longs spyod yongs rdzogs dbu rgyan dbang*// rin chen dpal dang ldan dbang bskur// oṃ āḥmu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ spyi bor bcings la/ oṃ badz+ro da ka sogs chu dbang sngar ltar dang*/ rdo rje'i dbang ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rdo rje// chos bdun yon tan ldan par shog /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣañca hūm̐/ lan gsum du rdo rje gsor/ oṃ badz+ro da ka sogs dang*/ dril bu thogs la/ theg chen chos kyi sgra dbyangs kyis// 'khor ba dong sprugs dbang thob shog /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñcā mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dril bu bkrol/ oṃ badz+ro da ka sogs dang*/ ming dbang ni/ bder gshegs kun gyis dbugs dbyung zhing*// lung bstan ming dbang mchog thob shog /oṃ badz+ra sa twa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñcā mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta shrī he ru ka zhes bya ba'o//

rdor dril spyi bor bzhag nas bkrol/ oṃ badz+ro da ka sogs sngar ltar chu dbang yang bskur/ de ltar chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming dbang bskur bas nyon mongs lnga// rnam par dag cing phung lnga gnas 'gyur nas// ye shes lnga thob rigs lngas rgyas gdab gyur// de ltar rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba yis// lus sgrib dag nas bskyed rim bsgom par dbang*// 'bras bu sprul sku'i sa bon rgyud la smin// de nas mchog dbang gong ma rnam gsum ched du/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇ+ḍal phul la gsang dbang ni/ ka pā la dam rdzas kyis bkang ba spyi bo dang mgrin par bzhag ste/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bde stong rang bzhin gyi// thabs shes byang sems rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// bdud rtsi btung la/ a hoḥm hā su kha a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ de ltar gsang dbang thob nas ngag sgrib byang*// rdzogs rim bsgom dbang 'bras bu longs sku 'grub// de nas sher dbang ni/ rig ma'i tsakli gtad la/ dkyil 'khor pa las gzungs ma mtshan ldan spros// slob mar snyoms zhugs dga' bzhi'i ye shes myong*// de ltar sher ye'i dbang thob sdig sgrib dag /bde stong bsgom dbang 'bras bu chos sku 'grub// de nas bzhi pa tshig dbang ni/ slob ma rnams lus gnad bcas la/ slob dpon gyis/ snang srid 'khor 'das chos thams cad// sems las gud du ma grub cing*// spros bral nam mkha'i rdo rje che// yang dag ye shes ngo bor gsal// ces ngo sprad/ phyag chen la bsten bzhi pa'i dbang bskur thob// sgo gsum sgrib dag ngo bo nyid sku 'grub// de nas slob dpon du bsgrub pa'i dbang gi don du/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob ma slar yang badz+ra sa twa gsal// rang 'od yum 'khyud dbang lha bum pa'i chus// ji ltar bcom ldan bltams tshe khrus gsol bzhin// dri med lha chus deng 'dir dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐//

zhes bum dbang bskur zhing btung du'ang bcug /rdor dril gtad la/ hūm̐ dang āḥlas byung ba'i rdo rje dril// bsnol thabs su 'dzin la/ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe āḥ dkrol la/ gsang gsum dam tshig brtan zhing deng phyin chad// 'gro ba'i slob dpon dam par dbugs dbyung ngo*// lung bstan pa ni/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril dang bcas/ g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar 'dzin/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ kye/ deng nas sangs rgyas sras su gyur// sems can don chen bla med spyod// ma 'ongs byang chub bdud rtsi brnyes// chos 'khor sgyur rgyal mchog tu 'gyur// de nas dbang gi rjes ni/ slob mas/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// gang gi drin las zab lam gyi// smin grol deng thob rtsa ba dang*// yan lag dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung*// lan gsum dang*// gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ zhing khams yang dag nas/ sangs rgyas myur thob shog / bar tshang ma brjod la phul/ slar yang*/ deng bzung snying po byang chub bar// rdo rje can zhabs tshe rabs su// mi 'bral bsgrubs pa'i mchod pa yis// bsnyen cing thugs rjes skyong gyur cig / lan gsum sogs kyis gsol ba snying nas gdab bar bya zhing*/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// sogs kyang brjod par bya'o// de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang rjes kyi bya ba rnams gzhung bzhin bya'o/// / ༈ de nas thugs dam bskang mchod spro na/ 'chad 'gyur ji bzhin bskang rdzas mchod pa'i bye brag rnams gang 'byor 'du byas la/ mar me rnams spar zhing spos bsreg /nang mchod sbreng*/ gzhung gi tshogs phud 'bul ba'i 'dod gsol gyis/ bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod cig / ces pa'i mthar rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs kyis gzi byin bskyed cing*/ rnal 'byor pa rnams lta sgom dang ldan pas dad pa'i sems kyis drangs nas/ gdung ba'i nga ros bskul ba'i dbyangs dang bcas 'di skad do//

hūm̐ hrīḥ 'gyur med spros bral bde chen klong*// rang byung lhun grub 'od gsal ba// dngos kun sna tshogs mnyam nyid ngang*// 'khor 'das ka nas dag pa'i dbyings// kun bzang brdal khyab chen po'i mdangs// don dam ye shes dkyil 'khor lha// gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// kun rdzob sgyu ma'i snang cha las// sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pas// mos gus gdung bas bskul lags na// chu zla'i gar gyis brtse ba yi// thugs rje bri gang dang bral ba// rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams rnams// 'gro ba'i don du sku bskyod la// bla med gsang chen rol pa yi// he ru ka gnas dur khrod kyi// gzhal yas tshogs khang 'bar ba 'dir// gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa rnams// gzhung bzhin ji ltar bkram nas su// tshar du dngar ba'i dam tshig rdzas// gdod nas rnam dag ra sa ya// ma hā pañca a mṛ ta// tshe gal ba liṃ ri ltar brjid// thabs shes dbyer med rgyan dang ldan// dmar chen rak+ta'i rgya mtsho bskyil// rba rlabs phreng ba chal chil g.yo// ga ṇa tsakra zag med kyi// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can// rdo rje'i mchod yon zhabs bsil ba// chu dang thang skyes spos ngad ldang*// snang zhing gsal byed dri yi chab// bshos gtsang rgyud mangs rol snyan sgrogs// gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos dang*// rdo rje lha mo bcu drug sogs// mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar stabs bsgyur// bde stong mchod pas dgyes bskyed cing*// stong gsum 'jig rten snang srid zhing*// ri dbang lhun po gling chen bzhi// gling phran khor yug mu khyud mdzes// nyi zla bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad// rgyal srid nye ba'i rin chen bdun// rtse mor chos bzang lha'i pho brang*// longs spyod dpal 'byor phun tshogs rnams// bkod legs phyur bur spungs nas su// phyi nang gsang ba'i bskang mchod rdzas// kun bzang rnam thar las lhag pa// dngos 'byor yid kyis mngon sprul nas// dad dang mos blo rnam dag pa'i// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho yis// drangs pa'i mi shigs nā da'i sgra// mtha' yas zhing khams rgyas 'gengs pas// bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang*// 'og min ston pa chos kyi sku// gdod ma'i mgon po ye sangs rgyas// badz+ra dha ra'i thugs dam bskang*// rnam grol thar mchog lam ston gsol// po ta la yi ri bo nas// tshe dbang yid bzhin dpal ster yum// ār+ya tā re'i thugs=

/rdo rje'i chos bdun ldan byin rlobs// mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od zhing du// 'chi med grub brnyes o rgyan rje// pra wa ka ra'i= /mi 'gyur rtag brtan tshe dngos stsol// yongs rdzogs thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'dzin// dus gsum kun mkhyen karma ka /dharma kīrti'i= /shes bya thogs pa med byin rlobs// snang srid zil gnon rdzu 'phrul can// gdul dka' mthar byed dpa' bo che// chos kyi bla ma'i= /khams gsum dbang sgyur mthu stobs stsol// mkhyen rab ke lā sha ri'i ngogs// gzhan stong smra ba'i gdong lnga pa// rang byung rdo rje'i= /mi 'jigs spobs pa thob byin rlobs// lung rigs dpung tshogs yan lag bzhis// log lta'i rgol pa spa bkong ba'i// 'dzam gling chos grags= /phyogs las rnam rgyal blo gros stsol// mtshan dpe rang bzhin lhun gyis grub// rtsol med 'gro don rgyun mi chad// de bzhin gshegs pa'i= /'brel tshad rdzogs sangs rgyas byin rlobs// theg gsum mthar thug zab mo'i don// legs bshad chos kyi rgyal thabs 'chang*// mthong ba don ldan= /sgrib bral lhan skyes ye shes stsol// thugs rje'i 'od dkar zhi bsil gyis// nyon mongs gdung sel sman gcig pu// rang byung mtsho skyes= /gnas lugs mngon gyur byin gyis rlobs// zab gsal ngo bo nyid dbyings las// ji lta ji snyed thams cad mkhyen// dbyangs can dga' ba'i= /shes rab gsum gyi snang ba stsol// e wam̐ zung 'jug rol ba'i klong*// bde stong mi phyed rdo rje can// mi pham chos dbang= /skye 'gags gnas bral byin gyis rlobs// kun khyab 'gyur med mkha' yangs por// bde chen drwa ba sdom pa'i gar// chos dbyings rdo rje'i= /mi rtog ting 'dzin rgyud smin stsol// srid mtsho sgrol ba'i ded dpon che// yang dag ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid// dz+nyā na badz+re= /las nyon 'khrul 'khor bzlog byin rlobs// srid zhi'i dgos 'byung dpag bsam dbang*// don gnyis phun tshogs char 'bebs pa// bo dhi badz+re=

/byang chub snying bor dbugs dbyung stsol// rigs dkyil khyab bdag 'khor los sgyur// nges don rdo rje slob dpon mchog /bdud las rnam rgyal= /dbang bzhi ye shes thob byin rlobs// longs sku nges pa lnga ldan bdag /gar dbang rdor 'chang rnam par 'phrul// chos grub rgya mtsho'i= /phyag rgya chen pos rgyud grol stsol// sgrub pa'i srol gtod bstan pa spel// rtsod ldan 'gro ba'i don spyod pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i= /dag snang phyogs med 'byong byin rlobs// gsang mchog dgyes pa'i rol pa na// bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med kyi// yi dam lha tshogs= /mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol// snang stong rtsa rlung thig le dang*// 'du 'bral med par gnas zhing skyong*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i= /bde gsal nyams rtogs 'char byin rlobs// dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang nas// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral tshogs// dam can srung ma'i= /las bzhi'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod// de ltar ye shes dkyil 'khor ba'i// rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtsho rnams// bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang*// 'gal rkyen bar chad rbod gtong zlog /hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo rtsa ba gsum// mi mngon phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs pa'i// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rnams// deng 'dir gsan cing dgongs bar mdzod// bdag sogs 'khrul blo gzung 'dzin dbang*// bag chags brtas pas nongs gyur pa// so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi// rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams pa// khyad par rdo rje rgyal po la// log lta pha mar ma gus dang*// snod min rnams la gsang sgrog sogs// nyams chag bskang ngo dag tshangs stsol// 'khor 'das gnyis chos thams cad kun// ye nas ma bcos spros mtshan dben// rnam dag bde chen gnyug ma'i gshis// rang rig skye ba med pa'i klong*// bskang dang bshags bya ma grub kyang*// chos nyid 'od gsal rdzogs pa che// dbyer med ma hā mu dra'i mdangs// chos can rten 'brel rang bzhin las// 'da' dka' rdo rje'i bka' gsang gnyan// spyod pa'i rnal 'byor mched rnams kyis// rmad byung dam rdzas tshogs 'khor lo'i// bskang mchod bla med phul ba'i mthus// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can gyi// dam tshig nyams chag byang gyur cig

/las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /'khor ba dong nas sprugs gyur cig /kun bzang mkha' klong dbyings su bskang*// chos nyid ngang du sor chud shog /sa ma ya a a āḥ de nas zhing skyong ba rnams dang mkha' 'gro'i gtor 'bul gtang*/ tshogs la longs spyod pa/ lhag ma dang rjes chog byin rlabs bsdu ba sogs kyang bya'o// de ltar smin dbang dang skong bshags kyi rim pa 'di dag zab lam spyod pa'i skal ba can rdo rje'i slob ma mtshan ldan dge slong karma bkra shis pa'i bzhed ngor/ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i mtshan gyi byin rlabs thob pa'i si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa tshul 'dir 'brel tshad snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du rang grol phyag rgya chen po mngon du thob par gyur cig /sarba thā mad+ga laṃ bha wan+tu/// / ༈ bla sgrub yid bzhin kun stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swa sti/ 'dir dpal ldan karma pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i sgrub pa pos/ dben pa'i gnas su/ rten gsum gyi drung du mchod pa ji snyed tshar du dngar ba bshams par bya'o// de'ang dang po yon tan zur tsam brjod na/ rdo rje gdan bzhi las/ dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod pa bas// bla ma'i ba spu nyag gcig mchod// de ni bsod nams khyad par 'phags// ces dang*/ drin dang ldan pa'i bla ma de// spyi bo'i gtsug gam snying gi dkyil// yan lag mthil sogs gang bsgom pa// sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan ni// gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur// ces sogs rgyud lung du ma nas bsngags pa'i yul du mdzad pa ltar mos pas yar gzhal tsam du ma yin par/ bcos min gyi dad gus gdung shugs dang bcas pas kun nas bslang pas tshul 'dir 'jug pa la thog mar skyabs yul rnams mdun mkhar lam gyis gsal btab la/ na mo// skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las gcig bsdus rdo rje 'dzin// rtsa ba'i bla mar deng bzung snying po'i bar// bdag sogs skyabs mchi thugs rjes bzung du gsol// ma gyur sems can don phyir bla ma bsgrub// kun kyang byang chub thob par sems bskyed do//
