ces skyabs 'gro sems bskyed lan gsum dang*/ de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa ni/ snang srid chos kun dmigs med ngang*// stong dang snying rje'i rtsal snang las// rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// gsal ba'i spyi bor pad dkar dang*// nyi zla'i steng du rgyal kun gyi// ye shes gcig bsdus 'khor lo'i mgon// ngo bo dpal ldan karma pa// rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje la// rnam pa bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*// nam mkha'i mdog can longs sku'i chas// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// thabs shes rdor dril bsnol stabs 'dzin// zhabs gnyis rdor skyil 'od lnga'i klong*// sgrub brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor// kun kyang mtshan dpe lham mer gsal// chos dbyings dgongs pa skye med ngang*// don dam gzigs pa'i lta stangs can// dran tsam nyid nas mos gus 'bar// bzod med gdung shugs drag po yis// gsol btab tsam gyi byin rlabs myur// myur ba'i stobs kyis bdag rgyud la// ye shes mngon sum ston ba yi// thugs rje'i 'od zer kun tu khyab// snying nas gsol 'debs dus la bab// kye/ snang stong sku la grag stong gsung*// bde stong thugs kyi rang bzhin can// rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum phyag 'tshal// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs// kye/ rang byung snang stong pho brang nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan 'dren na// gnam sa bla 'og mchog gsum dang*// rtsa gsum lha tshogs sprin ltar gtibs// dngos grub char 'bebs 'ja' 'od 'tsher// dad dang gdung bas gsol btab pas// thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs gsol// mos ba'i bu la byin gyis rlobs// de ltar byin 'bebs nas mchod pa 'bul ba yan lag bdun pa ni/ phyag 'tshal mchod cing mi dge bshags// yi rangs chos 'khor bskor gsol 'debs// dge bas 'gro drug sangs rgyas kyi// go 'phang thob pa'i phyir bsngo'o// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid kyi// dngos po kun gyi mchod pa'i tshogs// zhing khams rab 'byams rgyas 'gengs pa// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// oṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/
de nas rje zla 'od gzhon nu'i gsung las byung ba 'di'ang byin rlabs kyi khyad du brjod par bya ba ni/

bla ma rin po che bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa dang*/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa thams cad da lta nyid du dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'dug sa 'di nyid du dag par byin= thun gcig po 'di nyid ngang la dag par byin= bla ma rje btsun rin po che bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i rgyud 'di dag par byin= rgyud 'di rnam par grol bar byin= da lta nyid du dag par byin= 'dug sa 'di nyid du dag par byin= thun 'di nyid la dag par byin= bla ma rje btsun rin po che bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i rgyud la ting nge 'dzin phyin ci ma log pa mchog tu gyur pa skye bar mdzad du gsol/ da lta nyid du skye bar byin= 'dug sa 'di nyid du skye bar byin= thun 'di nyid kyi ring la skye bar byin= bla ma rje btsun rin po che bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i rgyud la ye shes phyin ci ma log pa mchog tu gyur pa bskyed par mdzad du gsol// da lta nyid du skye bar byin= 'dug sa 'di nyid du skye bar byin= thun 'di nyid la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces pa rnams so sor lan gsum re brjod la/ karma pa mkhyen no// zhes ci nus dang*/ de nas rje dus gsum mkhyen pas mdzad par grags pa/ bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin blo yis thong bar byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// chos min rnam rtog 'gag bar byin gyis rlobs// rang sems skye med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul pa rang sar zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// snang srid chos skur rtogs par byin rlobs// ces kyang brjod par bya'o// spro na rgyang 'bod mdor bsdus ni/ skyabs dkon mchog 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// mgon drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la// dus 'di nas mthar thug sangs rgyas bar// bdag mgon med sems can bskyab tu gsol// gnas 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal mtshor// byings pa yi skyabs med rnams bsgral du gsol// gdod rang chas su grub pa'i gnyug ma'i sems// don mngon gyur gyi rtogs pa'i gdeng thob shog

/pha bka' brgyud kyi bla ma dgongs su gsol// chos theg chen gyi lta sgom rnam dag par// tshul ji bzhin shes rab kyi mig thob nas// gnad ma nor sbyangs goms kyi mthar son shog / de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus par na/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen ma ti'i zhabs// sa ra ha dang klu sgrub sha ba ri// mai tri mar mi dwags po dus gsum mkhyen// ras chen rgyal sras pak+ṣi o rgyan rje// rang byung g.yung ston rol rdor mkha' spyod dbang*// de bzhin gshegs ba rin chen bzang don ldan// 'jam dpal bzang po gu shri mtsho skyes zhabs// sangs rgyas mnyan pa mi bskyod dkon mchog 'bangs// dbang phyug rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug dang*// chos dbyings rdo rje ye shes snying po dang*// ye shes rdo rje chos kyi don kun 'grub// byang chub rdo rje chos kyi 'byung gnas mchog /bdud 'dul rdo rje chos grub rgya mtsho'i sde// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bka' srung la// gsol 'debs rang byung rig pa rang grol ngang*// lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur byin gyis rlobs// de nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi blang ba'i rim pa ni/ dran chog rgyal po bla ma rin po che// skal ldan smin grol dbang bzhi bskur gsol 'debs// skyabs yul thams cad rtsa ba'i bla mar thim// dgyes pa dang bcas dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad// bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar 'phros// rang gi dpral thim lus kyi sgrib pa dag /bum dbang thob cing bskyed rim snang stong lhar// bsgom par dbang ba'i sprul sku 'grub par 'gyur// mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros// rang gi mgrin thim ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob rdzogs rim rtsa thig rlung*// sgyu lus gsal stong bsgom dbang longs sku 'grub// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros// rang gi snying khar thim pas yid sgrib dag

/sher ye'i dbang thob dga' bzhi ye shes kyi// bde stong bsgom dbang chos kyi sku 'grub 'gyur// slar yang 'od zer dkar dmar mthing 'phros nas// sgo gsum la thim cha mnyam sgrib pa dag /dbang bzhi thob cing phyag rgya che bsgom dbang*// ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan karma pa// bdag nyid pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur rtag bzhugs nas// byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes bzung la// gsang gsum rdo rje'i byin rlabs deng 'dir stsol// de ltar gsol btab bla ma 'od zhu nas// rang thim gcig 'dres phrin las rab 'byams kun// bsgrub par nus pa rdo rje slob dpon dbang*// thob cing bdag rgyud bla ma'i sku gsung thugs// dbyer med ngang la ma bcos rang babs su// spros kun bral ba ci gnas mnyam par bzhag / ces pa'i tshig don ltar rang sems ngo bo bskyang la/ mthar/ bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge gang mchis// 'gro kun gdod ma'i bder gshegs rdo rje 'chang*// go 'phang thob phyir yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// de ltar smon lam rnam dag 'grub gyur cig / ces pa'ang dad gsum gyi lhag blo dang ldan pa dge slong 'byor ldan gyis bskul ltar si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos sa zla'i dkar phyogs bzang po gnyis par bkod pa 'brel bcas sangs rgyas karma ka'i go 'phang la reg par gyur cig /maṅga lam/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub mchog stsol bzhugs so// rang mdun ye shes lnga yi 'od kyi klong*// rin chen seng ges btegs pa'i khri steng du// dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs karma pa// 'jigs bral rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rje ni// sku mdog dkar gsal phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag /zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// sku la chos gos rnam gsum lhug par gsol// mtshan dpe'i gzi byin rab gsal lhang nge ba// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i dpal du shar// mchog gsum rgyal ba rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po bka' brgyud kyi// grub thob rgya mtsho nyin mor byed ltar gsal// mchog dang thun mong grub gnyis stsol mdzad pa// rgyud sde bzhi yi yi dam rab 'byams rnams// dri med cha shas yongs rdzogs 'od dkar bzhin// dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char rgyun si li li// chos dbyings ye shes ngang las grub pa'i lha// ma hā kā la rdo rje re ma ti// dam can bka' sdod chos kyi srung ma rnams// char sprin dang mtshungs bzod dka'i gzi byin ldan// gzhan yang phyi nang bar chad kun sel ba// gnas gsum dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams kyi// ḍā ki dpa' bo rgyu skar phreng bzhin gsal// sna tshogs phrin las nam mkha'i glog ltar 'khyug

/de ltar skyabs yul ngo bo mchog gsum dang*// rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i mdun// bdag gis gtso byas rigs drug pha ma'i tshogs// gdung shugs drag bos phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// nyes bshags rjes su yi rang chos ston 'tshal// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi// mi phyed rtse gcig snying nas gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas kun 'dus karma pa mkhyen no// karma pa mkhyen no// zhes mos gus kyi 'dun pa dang ldan pas mang tsam brjod nas// 'phags pa snying rje'i rang gzugs 'gro ba'i mgon// spyan ras gzigs dngos rgyal mchog karma pa// 'jigs bral bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje la// rnam kun gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// tshe gcig dam chos zab mo phyag rgya che'i// gnas lugs don rtogs sgyu lus chos skur 'char// rten thog 'di ru 'ja' lus sku 'grub nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang yongs thob shog /mthar ni skyabs yul bla ma'i sku la thim// rtsa ba'i bla ma rang sems gnyis med 'dres// dbang bzhi mchog thob sgo gsum sdig sgrib dag /snang grag rtog gsum bla ma'i dkyil 'khor grub// bdag cag skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du// rigs kun khyab bdag badz+ra dhā ra dang*// dbyer med dpal ldan bla mas rjes bzung ste// ma hā mu dra'i go 'phang thob gyur cig / de ltar 'jig rten zhing 'di'i ston mchog dpal karma pa'i gsol 'debs bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di yang gter chen rol pa'i rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul pad+ma bstan 'phel gyi dgongs bzhed ltar/ si tu'i ming can gyis kun dga' zhes pa shing pho stag gi lo cho 'phrul can gyi yar tshes la dpal gyi mtshur phu'i gtsug lag tu bris pa'o/// / ༈ rang nyid tha mal spyi bor pad+ma dkar// 'dab rgyas de steng zla dkyil dri med dbus// rgyal kun phrin las bdag po karma ka /rje btsun bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje mchog

/sku mdog dkar gsal mtshan dpe'i rgyan rnams rdzogs// zhwa nag gser mdangs rin chen rgyan spras gsol// spyan gnyis don dam chos nyid dbyings su gzigs// chos gos rnam gsum na bzas kun tu bklubs// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas pad dkar 'dzin// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' 'od gtibs pa'i klong*// gsal stong sgrib med sku ru gsal bar gyur// steng 'og bar mtshams 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong*// bka' brgyud rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho dang*// rgyud sde rab 'byams yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs// chos kyi srung ma ma mgon lcam dral dang*// dam can gtum rngam drag shul ldan pa'i tshogs// sna tshogs sku dang cha lugs cir yang sgyur// me rlung 'tshubs ma'i nang du mngon sum gsal// de ltar skyabs yul dkon mchog rtsa gsum la// bdag sogs sems can rnams kyi lus rdul snyed// grangs med du mar sprul te rtse gcig pa'i// sgo gsum dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing*// kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod// mi dge nongs pa'i las gyur mthol lo bshags// gzhan phan byang chub spyod la rjes yi rangs// chos 'khor rgyun chad med par bskor bar bskul// dad dang mos pa'i blo yis gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum bsags dge myang 'das rgyu ru bsngo// zhen log nges 'byung drag pos rgyud brlan cing*// gdod nas don dam lhan skyes ye shes kyi// 'od zer snang bas ma rig sgrib pa'i tshogs// mun pa'i dra ba rtsad nas gzhil ba dang*// sems nyid chos sku'i ngo bo gnad mthong zhing*// sku bzhi'i ngo bo mngon du gyur nus pa'i// skyabs yul dam pas myur bar byin rlobs shig /karma pa mkhyen no// ci nus brjod mthar/ 'phags pa snying rje'i rang gzugs// rgyal mchog phyag na pad+mo// spyan ras gzigs dngos dam pa// gru 'dzin phreng ba rim byon// bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rje// thugs bskyed gting mtha' yas pas// bskal par mchog gi sprul sku// rgyun mi chad par ston pa'i// 'gro drug skyabs gnas gcig pu// rje btsun khyed rang mkhyen no// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i sems can// nyon mongs 'khor ba'i 'dam las// myur du sgrol bar byin rlobs// stan thog 'di ru byin rlobs// brtse ba chen pos byin rlobs// ye shes 'pho bar byin rlobs// mthar ni skyabs yul thams cad 'od zhu nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i skur thim de nyid kyi// sku las 'od zer dkar dmar sngo ser ljang*// 'phros te rang lus la thim slar yang ni// dgyes pa dang bcas 'od du ltem gyis zhu// dbyer med gcig 'dres chu la chu bzhag ltar// dus gsum rtog pa ma lus rgyun bcad nas// ma bcos so ma'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag

/dge 'di bdag gzhan sems can kun// spyan ras gzigs dbang sku thob nas// rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprug gi// phrin las tshad med 'grub gyur cig / ces pa'ang dad gsum mngon mtho rje stod mdzod pa shākya dar rgyas kyis bskul bzhin karma'i gdan sar sa zla'i dus chen la si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba dza ya/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sangs rgyas lag gtad ye shes rang 'bar bzhugs/ oṃ ma hā shū ṇ+ya ta sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ spyi bor pad dkar 'dab stong dri med steng*// chu shel dbang po cha shas yongs rdzogs dbus// dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi dpal 'khor lo'i mgon// 'phags pa'i sar gnas byang chub sems dpa' mchog /rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje zhal gcig pa// phyag gnyis sa gnon mnyam bzhag tshe bum bsnams// chos gos rnam gsum zab ber zlum gsol zhing*// dbu la mthong grol zhwa nag gser mdangs mdzes// spyan gnyis chos nyid don dam dbyings la gzigs// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung g.yo med ngang*// 'od dang 'od zer zer thag kun tu 'phro// bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs// yi dam dpa' bo ḍā ki chos srung ma// char ltar bab cing dngos grub byin chen 'bebs// mos gus gsol btab tsam gyis snang srid zhing*// dag pa bla ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgyur nus pa'i// gdung shugs drag po'i dbyangs kyis bskul lags na// thugs rje can gyi bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// bdag rgyud ye shes bde chen rang 'bar nas// gzung 'dzin 'ching ba ma lus dbyings su dag /stan thog 'di ru mchog dngos thob nus pa'i// mi 'gyur don gyi byin rlabs 'pho dbang stsol// ces bskyed dang 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ de nas/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so// bka' brgyud kun 'dus ngo bo la gsol ba 'debs so// rgyal dbang karma pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so// rab 'byams zhing kun sku yis khyab pa la gsol ba 'debs so// sku dang zhing khams tha mi dad pa la gsol ba 'debs so// chos dbyings ye shes ngang nas thugs rjes gzigs shig

/bdag sogs sems can ngan song g.yang las sgrol cig /mi rtag skyo shas nges 'byung rgyud la skye bar gyur cig /skyes nas dam pa'i chos kyi skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /nyams len tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang chen 'grub par gyur cig /karma pa mkhyen no// ci nus bgrang mthar/ chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs// sprul sku pad 'byung sku gsum 'dus pa'i dpal// byams mgon seng ge la sogs bskal bzang gi// 'dren pa rnams kyi thugs rje'i nus mthu rtsal// kun 'dus sangs rgyas phrin las rol pa 'chang*// gang der snying nas gsol 'debs bdag rgyud kyi// ma rig dbang gyur dug lnga'i sdig sgrib tshogs// sdom gsum 'gal ba'i las bgyis mthol lo bshags// phyin chad kun rtog rkyen gyis mi ldang bar// byin gyis rlobs shig bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon// ngan song rigs drug skye sgo bcad du gsol// rnam dag bde ba can du lam sna drongs// gdod ma'i gnas lugs mngon gyur byin gyis rlobs// dpal ldan bla ma'i gnas bzhir rdo rje bzhi'i// ngo bo sna tshogs 'od 'phros rang gnas bzhir// thim pas dbang bzhi thob cing sgrib bzhi dag /sku bzhi thob cing dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal gyi// byang chub bar du 'du 'bral med pa yi// dbugs dbyung rdo rje'i gsung gi gnang ba bcas// 'od dkar ltems kyis zhu nas rang lus thim// bde gsal mi rtog rang byung rig pa'i mdangs// byar med blo 'das bde ba chen po'i ngang*//

zhes mnyam bzhag dang bcas nyams len ngang la dar cig bzhag /mthar/ dge 'di'i 'gro ba ma lus rdo rje sems// sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bsngo ba dang*/ zab lam rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i dge tshogs mthus// stan thog 'di ru bde ldan zhing bgrod cing*// mkha' mnyam ma gyur kun kyang srid zhi la// mi gnas byang chen 'dren pa'i dpal gyur cig / ces pa'i smon lam mdor bsdus dang*// gzhan yang smon lam gang shes bya'o// de ltar khang gsar karma 'chi med rgya mtsho nas kho bo'i rnal 'byor zhig nan gyis bskul yang*/ rang gis gzhigs 'brel gyis rgyal mchog bcu gsum pa zhal mthong gsung gi bdud rtsi thob pa'i sangs rgyas dngos snang rgyal ba'i lung zin nyid du tshad mar grub pa mchog de'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi dgos khyad che ba'i ched du byas te/ dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro rnams mgon de'i thugs rjes skyong bar gyur cig// / ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang snang rnam dag gzhal yas khang gi dbus// rang sems bde gshegs snying bo'i snang ba'i cha// yi dam gdan gsum tshang ba'i skur gsal ba'i// mdun mkhar 'ja' 'od zer klong seng khri dang*// pad dkar zla steng rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /spyan ras gzigs dngos rje btsun karma pa// bdud 'dul rdo rje zhwa nag gser mdangs can// bgres tshul rab byung cha lugs phyag sa gnon// mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum 'dzin zhabs rdor skyil// zla ba'i rgyab yol dang bcas lham mer zhugs// gzhan yang rtsa bar brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam ḍā ki chos skyong sprin ltar gtibs// dran tsam bde chen ye shes phyag rgya che'i// nyams rtogs yon tan rgyud la bskyed nus gsal// kye hoḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang*// lung rtogs dam chos rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas che// tshogs mchog dge 'dun kun gtso rigs dkyil bdag /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol//

zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥmā ra da ma ka badz+ra hūm̐/ ces pa'i sngags kyang bzlas mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje can// srid pa'i 'jigs las sgrol ba pos// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol btab pas bla ma yi// rdo rje bzhi yi sa bon 'od// gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob// bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// rang sems ma bcos so ma'i ngang*// yengs med de yi ngo bo skyong*// bla ma chos sku'i rang zhal mjal// lhun grub gdod ma'i gnas thob gyur// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dpal ldan bla ma 'grub gyur sogs brjod/ ces khra 'gu dgon blo gros nyi ma'i sprul sku'i bzhed ngor dge// / ༈ mdun mkhar pad dkar zla steng karma pa// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi 'dzum mtshan dpe rdzogs// phyag gnyis sa gnon mnyam bzhag zhabs rdor skyil// snang bzhin gsal stong lhun grub sku ru bskyed// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bdud 'dul rdo rje mkhyen// gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od 'phros rang la thim// dbang bzhi mchog thob sku bzhi mngon grub shog / ces karma bkra shis ngor spel/// / ༈ rang nyid lhar gsal spyi bor pad zla'i steng*// bka' brgyud rgya mtsho yi dam lha rab 'byams// chos skyong kun 'dus ngo bo rdo rje ber// dbyer med dharmā ka ra thams cad mkhyen// zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'chad zhabs skyil krung*// chos gos rnam gsum dbu la mthong grol gsol// rab gsal ston zla'i steng du lham mer gsal// skyabs gsum spyi mes nyid du nges byas nas// phyag 'tshal mchod bshags yi rangs bskul gsol 'debs// dge kun 'gro rnams byang chub thob phyir bsngo// deng bzung bla med byang chub snying po'i bar// bde chen 'khor lor 'du 'bral med pa ru// bsnyen pa'i gsol 'debs bdag rgyud smin grol gyi// ye shes mchog gi lam zab dbang mchog stsol// oṃ āḥdharmā ka ra hūm̐/

ces pa'ang ci nus bzlas mthar byin rlabs bsdu ba/ bzod par gsol ba/ dug gsum sgrib pas 'thums pa yi// bslab pa gsum dang 'gal ba rnams// mi 'chab mi sbed mthol zhing bshags// slan chad mi bgyid dam bca' bzung*// dag tshangs sgrib par mi 'gyur ba'i// mgon pos dbugs dbyung stsal du gsol// bla ma dgyes bcas 'od zhu nas// rang thim sgo gsum dri ma dag /sku gsum 'bras bu mngon gyur te// dbyer med ngang du mnyam par bzhag / mthar bsngo smon bya/ zhes pa'ang gnas mdo chos rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ si tu pas spel ba bkra shis kyi snang bas khyab par gyur cig// / ༈ rang gi spyi bor zla ba'i steng*// skyabs gnas kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung*// ngo bo ye nas grub pa la// rnam pa pad+ma'i mtshan 'chang ba// bkra gsal lam mer rab byung chas// zag med bde stong dbyer med pa'i// rdor dril bsnol 'dzin 'od klong du// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor yongs 'dus shar// badz+ra gu ru bzla/ rje btsun pad+ma'i rnam rol// gang shar rang byung nyid grub// gsol 'debs bdag rgyud byin rlobs// gnas skabs mthar thug nyes tshogs// bar chad sel zhing sems nyid// ka dag gdod ma'i ngo bo// rang zhal mthong bar byin rlobs// gang khyod bstan 'gro'i dpal du// 'tsho brtan mi 'gyur rdo rje'i// rang bzhin bzhugs gsol byin rlobs// bla ma'i sku las 'od 'phros pas// gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob// rgyud bzhi smin cing sku bzhi 'grub// dbyer med rdo rje 'chang thob shog / ces pa'ang bslab gsum ldan ba grub dbang bla ma pad+ma dbang drag gis bzhed ngor si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyi spel ba dge'o/// / ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang snang rnam dag gzhal yas khang gi dbus// rang sems bde gshegs snying po'i snang ba'i cha// yi dam gdan gsum tshang ba'i skur gsal ba'i// spyi bor seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dran chog 'khor lo'i mgon// snang srid zil non pad+ma rgyal po'i tshul// mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs// dran tsam bde chen ye shes rdzogs pa che'i// nyams rtogs yon tan rgyud la bskyed nus gsal// kye hoḥ

rab 'byams rgyal ba kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang*// lung rtogs dam chos rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas che// tshogs mchog dge 'dun kun gtso rigs dkyil bdag /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// ces dang*/ oṃ āḥpad+ma de wen+d+ra sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ ces pa'i sngags kyang bzlas mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje can// srid pa'i 'jigs las sgrol pa pos// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol btab pas bla ma yi// rdo rje bzhi yi sa bon 'od// gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob// bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// rang sems bla ma'i ngo bor shar// bcos ma'i mos gus ma yin par// bla ma chos sku'i rang zhal mjal// lhun grub gdod ma'i gnas thob gyur// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dpal ldan bla ma 'grub gyur sogs brjod/ ces dad gsum mngon mtho bla ma sku dga'i bzhed ngor si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis spel ba dge// / ༈ rang lus snang stong lhar gsal spyi bo ru// rigs kyi bdag po theg mchog rdo rje dang*// pad+ma nyin byed gtsug lag chos kyi rgyal// rdo rje drag po'i sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol// bla med bla ma rdo rje can rnams gsal// de la gsol btab mos gus byas pa'i mthus// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis// byin rlabs dbang bskur bdud rtsis rgyud smin nas// sku bzhi mngon 'gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol// bla ma 'od zhu rang thim dbyer med gyur// blo 'das phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bzhag /dge bas bdag gzhan byang chub che thob shog / ces gling thog karma dngos grub ngor spel/// / ༈ hrīḥ ཿrang snang rnam dag rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// rang lus dag pa lha yi skur gsal ba'i// spyi bor seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// rgyal kun 'dus gzugs pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// dbyer med drin chen ad+ga kā ra'i zhabs// gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i cha lugs su// bag bro brjid chags dran pas bde chen gyi// ye shes rtsol med rgyud la bskyed nus gyur// bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin blo yis thong par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul pa rang sar dag par byin gyis rlobs// snang srid chos skur 'char bar byin gyis rlobs//

ces dang*/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs grangs mang brjod cing*/ gsol 'debs snying po badz+ra gu ru bzla/ mthar ni bla ma'i sku yi gnas bzhi nas// 'od 'phros gnas bzhir thim pas sgrib bzhi dag /dbang bzhi thob cing sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'grub// bla ma 'od zhu rang dang dbyer med 'dres// rang sems skye 'gags gnas dang bral ba'i ngang*/ brjod bral lhan skyes bde stong zung 'jug pa// bsam 'das bla ma chos sku'i klong yangs su// bdag dang 'brel kun mngon par sangs rgyas shog / ces karma bsod nams kyi bzhed skong du si tus spel/// / ༈ bskal bzang 'dren pa stong rtsa 'byon pa las// bzhi pa bcom ldan shākya thub pa yi// rgyal bstan byang phyogs ljongs 'dir spel ba'i phyir// 'gro mgon bla ma rdo rje rgyal po zhes// don dam bde chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i dpal// stong nyid shes rab yum dang mnyam par sbyor// bde dang stong pa'i ye shes gzi 'od 'bar// skad cig dran pas lhan skyes phyag rgya che// mngon sum rgyud la skyed nus rdo rje'i sku// snying dbus lnga ldan 'od klong gsal bar gyur// dpal ldan phag mo gru yi nags khrod na// skal ldan gdul bya mang po smin mdzad cing*/ bsam gyis mi khyab cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston// 'gro mgon rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// chos min rnam rtog 'gags par byin gyis rlobs// rang sems skye med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul pa rang sar zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// snang srid chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// tshar kha shas rgyang 'bod tshul du bton la/ bla ma yab yum rjes su chags pa'i mes// ltem gyis zhu ba rang gi rtsa dang rlung*// thig le dang bcas rnam par dag pa'i khams// mi phyed rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med gyur// skye ba 'di nas rigs bdag mi 'chol zhing*//

sogs brjod/ ces pa'ang skal ldan karma'i mtshan can bzhed skong ched du spel ba dge// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bde chen lam gyi snang byed rab gsal skal ldan bgrod pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pad+mā kā ra ye// mtha' yas yon tan rin chen kun 'byung gnas// rnam dag rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho cher// 'jug 'dod don gnyis snying po'i nor bu mchog /skal ldan byang chub gru rdzing 'dir zhugs kye// de yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang gsum ye shes rol pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi drang dang nges pa'i chos tshul du mas 'gro rnams kun mkhyen kyi go 'phang mngon du ston pa'i dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso mchog dpal he ru ka'i skur bzhengs nas smin grol gyi sar bkod pa'i gang 'dul thabs gyis skyong ba'i/ ji ltar chu klung zla gzugs bzhin// sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul gar rtsed ston// ces pa ltar 'dir ni bla med nges pa'i don gyi yang snying gcig tu dril ba rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zab mo mchog gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i mngon par rtogs pa tho tsam bkod pa ste/ rab tu gong ma dag gi byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub gnas sam/ dben zhing nyams dga' byin chags pa'i gnas su gtsang sbra byi dor legs par byas la/ dkon mchog gi rten bkram la mchod ba'i yo byad sna tshogs pa dang*/ khyad par thabs shes kyi rdzas nang mchod la sogs pa rgya cher bshams la/ gzhan yang bkod pa rab tu mdzes pas brgyan par bya ba sogs mdor na tshogs gnyis bsod nams kyi zhing du mos par yo byad kyi rnam pa du ma mdun du brdal bar bya'o// de nas thog mar rang nyid lha yi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab ba ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ ram̐ kam̐ rnams las rlung me thod sgyed kyi steng du āḥlas thod pa dum bu gcig pa rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/

dpral ba rang la bstan pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba de'i dbus su mu/ shar du bi/ lhor ra/ nub tu shu/ byang du ma ste bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ slar yang dbus su na/ shar lhor go/ lho nub tu ku/ nub byang du da/ byang shar du ha ste sha lnga po slar yang yig 'bru de dag gis mtshan par gyur ba dang*/ rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas hūm̐ gi dbyibs can gyi rlung g.yos pas me spar thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ ma dag pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ steng du oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ sngon las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhi can du gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa yang gong ltar bya zhing*/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsa ub+dad a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i daṃ pa liṃ gṛ h+nan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu ya thai bam̐ ya thai ṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhūñja tha dzi gha tha pi pa tha ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sad su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sā hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan bzhir brjod la/ hūm̐/ gang dag bla med dkyil 'khor 'dir// mngon par 'dud pa'i zhing skyong brgyad// mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis sogs// ma lus 'khor tshogs ji snyed pa// 'dir bshams mchod rdzas 'dod yon rnams// dgyes dgur tshim par longs spyod rol// yang dag byang chub bsgrub pa la// bar chad nad gdon zhi bar mdzod// tshe dpal 'byor pa'i dbang dang ldan// brtan g.yo'i srid bcud ma lus sdud// mngon spyod las kyi dngos grub sogs// phrin las thogs med sgrub par mdzod// ces dang*/ deng 'dir gnod cing 'tshe ba yi// bsam sbyor log ltar gyur pa rnams// skad cig nyid la phyir dengs shig

/hūm̐ hūm̐/ sum bha ni sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu bar med rdo rje'i rwa ba drwa ba gur dang bla re phyi rol ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bas srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bas kun nas kun tu gtams par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ces srung 'khor bsgoms la/ de nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni bdud rtsi bran la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān gyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa'i snod yangs par hūm̐ yig gi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar ba las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a warta ya ho/

lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra khaṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ naiwi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ces byin gyis brlabs la/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas dam pa'i chos// tshogs mchog bla na med pa'i mgon// bdag nyid chen po rdo rje can// dpal ldan bla ma rin po che// rtsa ba brgyud par bcas rnams dang*// yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha// chos skyong rgya mtsho tshogs bcas la// bdag ni rtag par skyabs su mchi// lan bdun nam nyer gcig brjod/ sems bskyed ni/ gzhan phan snying rjes kun bslang ste// bla ma bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi// go 'phang dam pa bsgrub nas ni// 'gro sgrol byang chub sems bskyed do// lan gsum dang*/ skabs 'dir sbyang bya sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma rnams sbyong byed gnyen po rten gyi stobs khyad par du 'phags pa bla ma dang rdo rje sems dpa' dbyer med du sgom bzlas kyi rim pa bstan pa ni/ rang gi spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i gnas steng du// pad dkar zla dkyil steng du hūm̐ dkar las// bla ma he ru ka dpal dpa' po che// rdo rje sems dpa' rigs kun bdag po mchog /sku mdog dkar po zla ba'i rgyab yol can// longs sku mtshan dpe'i cha rdzogs zhal gcig pa// phyag gnyis rdor dril 'gying bag tshul du bsnams// dar dang rin chen rgyan spras zhabs rdor skyil// pang du rdo rje snyems ma mdog dkar g.yas// gri gug g.yon pas thod chang 'dzin pa 'khril// gnas gsum sku gsum ngo bo yig 'brus mtshan// 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes pa// spyan drangs dbyer med thugs kar zla dkyil dbus// hūm̐ dkar mtha' mar sngags phreng bskor bar gyur// sku yi cha las bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgyun// dkar zhing bsil ba reg na bde ba 'bab// sdig sgrib ma lus byang zhing dag gyur nas// rang lus 'od du gsal ba de yi ngang*// oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya

sogs yi ge brgya pa dang*/ yig drug bzlas pa'i mthar/ kye ho/ bdag ni nyon mongs ma rig dbang*// sgrib pa'i drwa bar 'thums pa yi// dam tshig nyes pa'i tshogs kun bshags// dag tshangs dbugs dbyung mdzad du gsol// ces gsol bas/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yis// bu khyod nongs pa byang ngo zhes// gnang ba thob pa'i mod nyid du// 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur// dar gcig nyams len bskyangs la/ 'gro kun bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal rgyu dang bral bar shog /bde bas rtag par nyer 'tsho zhing*// chos rnams mnyam nyid rtogs par shog / lan gsum gyis tshad med bzhi bsgom la/ de nas mdun mkhar bla ma'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa gsal btab pa ni/ mdun bskyed rten rnams bsangs sbyangs la/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ gis chos thams cad stong nyid ye shes rdo rje rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid de kho na'i ngo bor sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi mkha' dbyings su// sngon gyi smon lam tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i stobs// chos dbyings rang bzhin bsam mi khyab pa dang*// sangs rgyas zhing sbyang dag pa'i sbyor pa'i mthus// bdag sogs mos pa'i rten 'byung lhag bsam gyis// gnas 'dir thar pa chen po'i pho brang mchog /zhing khams bkod pa yon tan lhun grub par// phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin ldan gyur cig /de dbus pad sdong yal ga lngar gyes pa'i/ dbus su dri med pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad// ge sar ze'u 'bru de steng seng ge'i khrir// ma chags skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i gdan// rang bzhin 'od gsal chu shel nya gang steng*// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rnam par rol// gsang gsum mi bzad rgyan 'khor lnga yi bdag /'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug dngos snang ba// rje btsun bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje ni// bgres nyams zhwa nag gser mdangs khyung gshog gsol// dbu skyes rab dkar lta stangs dbyings su gzigs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa sa gnon dang*// g.yon pas mnyam bzhag 'chi med bum pa bsnams// chos gos rnam gsum zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung*// ting 'dzin bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od zer gyis// khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprug cing bzhugs// shar gyi 'dab steng glang chen btegs pa'i khrir// pad zla'i steng du 'od snang mtha' yas mgon// rigs drug khyab bdag zhwa dmar cod pan can// mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho sku sha rgyas// phyag gnyis thabs shes rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// chos gos rnam gsum za 'og ber chen gsol// zhabs gnyis rdor skyil gzi byin rab tu 'bar// 'brel tshad don dang ldan zhing lham mer bzhugs// lho yi 'dab steng cang shes btegs pa'i khrir// pad zla'i steng du thugs rje chen po'i 'phrul// bka' drin mnyam med dpal ldan 'brug pa mchog

/bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta sku mdog dkar// dbu la sgom zhwa rin chen sprin dpung mdzes// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin pad dkar g.yon mnyam bzhag /chos gos rnam gsum rdo rje skyil mo krung*// phan bde'i char gyis rtag tu skyong bzhin bzhugs// nub kyi zla steng rma byas btegs pa'i khrir// pad zla'i steng du byams chen shes rab gnyen// kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas bgres nyams ldan// dbang rtags cod pan rwa ga'i mdangs dang ldan// phyag gnyis chos 'chad ral gri pusti kaḥ /chos gos rnam gsum zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung*// 'gro rnams mkhyen brtses yang dag sar bkod phyir// bshad sgrub phrin las snang ba rgyas par bzhugs// byang gi 'dab steng khyung chen btegs pa'i khrir// pad zla'i steng du mtsho skyes rnam par rol// grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan dpa' bo mchog /rdo rje gtsug lag dga' ba'i dbang po'i sde// bgres tshul dbang zhu pad+ma zur brgyad gsol// phyag gnyis rdo rje sdigs mdzub dril dkur brten// me kha li ljang bla gos ngur smrig bklubs// zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bde stong ye shes rgyas// shar lho'i 'dab steng rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khrir// pad zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// rdo rje drag po phrin las 'dus pa rtsal// dkar smug dbu la pad+ma mthong grol gsol// phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu mkha' la gdengs// g.yon pas phur pa 'dril zhing lcags sdigs 'phro// phod ka chos gos zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs// log 'dren bgegs tshogs zhi ba'i rngams zer 'phro// lho nub 'dab steng rin chen mtshan pa'i khrir// pad zla'i steng du sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin// tshe dbang mgon po 'chi med dpal dar mchog /smug nag pad+ma kha 'bus dbang zhu can// phyag gnyis rdo rje thod chang 'gyings bcas bsnams// rdo rje'i gsang gos dang ni bla gos bklubs// zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// tshe bsod ye shes rgyas pa'i dngos grub 'du// nub byang 'dab steng pad+mas mtshan pa'i khrir// pad zla'i steng du gar dbang rdo rje 'dzin// chos skyong rnam par rgyal ba sku bong mtho// dbu la dwags zhu gsol zhing phyag gnyis kyi// chos 'chad mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas glegs bam 'dzin// sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum dang ldan// zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// srid zhi'i brtan g.yo ma lus dbang dang ldan// byang shar 'dab steng rgya gram mtshan pa'i khrir// pad zla'i steng du sgrub brgyud phrin las kyi// byed por dbang bskur nor bu bsam 'phel dbang*// bgres pa'i nyams ldan bsgom zhwa dbu la gsol// bsam gtan ngang du ting 'dzin phyag rgyar ldan// chos gos rnam gsum rdo rje skyil mo krung*// gnyis 'dzin bar chad stong nyid ngang du bstims// de ltar dbus phyogs bla ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal// rgyab phyogs steng gi pad+ma ge sar steng*// nyi zla'i gdan la dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog

/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag zhabs rdor skyil// g.yas phyogs pad steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gangs ri'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pad+ma// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rgyan ldan zhabs rdor skyil// g.yon phyogs pad+ma ge sar nyi zla'i steng*// 'chi med gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas ni// pad zhwa gsol zhing rdo rje thod pa bsnams// kha ṭ+wām̐ phod ka chos gos zhabs rdor skyil// mdun phyogs 'og gi pad+ma nyi ro'i steng*// ye shes mgon po ber nag rang byung rgyal// gnyis ka'ang gri thod 'dzin cing 'khyud stabs kyis// dar nag ber gsol rdzu 'phrul drel rta chibs// rtsa gsum lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi// gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing mtshan// de las 'od zer phyogs bcu'i zhing du 'phros/ rab 'byams dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje bskul// kun kyang bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes sems// mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig spyan drangs nas// thugs rje'i byin rlabs dngos grub gtib par gyur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru badz+ra sa ma dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ pheṃ pheṃ/ ces brjod la spyan 'dren pa ni/ steng dag pa chos dbyings pho brang nas// dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas// mchog dngos grub sprin phung thibs se thib// gnas 'dir byon byin chen dbab tu gsol/ g.yas po ṭa la yi zhing khams nas// dpal longs sku thugs rje chen po'i mgon// mchog dngos grub sprin phung thibs se thib// gnas 'dir byon byin chen dbab tu gsol// g.yon dpal ri pad+ma 'od zhing nas// rje sprul sku gu ru thod phreng rtsal// mchog dngos grub sprin phung thibs se thib// gnas 'dir byon byin chen dbab tu gsol// dbus mi 'gyur gdod ma'i gshis kyi ngang*// rang byung gi gsal la stong pa yi// sems snang stong dbyer med bde ba che// don dbyings dang ye shes pho brang nas// dran chog gi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gtso// rigs kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// thugs brtse ba chen pos bzung slad du// mchog dngos grub sprin phung thibs se thib// gnas 'dir byon byin chen dbab tu gsol// 'og dam tshig gnyen po'i gzhal yas nas// dpal ma hā kā la lcam dral tshogs// phrin las kyi glog 'od khyugs se khyug

/gnas 'dir byon phyi nang bar chad sol// skyabs thugs rje can gyi bla ma dang*// mgon yi dam dkyil 'khor ma lus dang*// bstan srung ba'i dam can rgya mtsho rnams// deng mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// sngon byang chub snying po'i smon lam gyis// ma brgal dang ma grol gdul bya rnams// yang dag gi sa la 'god pa'i phyir// gnas 'dir byon byin rlabs dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī mān gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ ces brjod la dam tshig dang ye shes dbyer med du gyur par mos la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig ye shes dbyer med gcig 'dres gyur// slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang lha rnams// rang bzhin gnas nas ma lus spyan drangs te// mchod pa'i sprin gyi rang bzhin spro bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhupe/ di pe/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ bde gshegs rigs lnga sems dpa' sems ma dang*// khro bo khro mo la sogs dbang gi lhas// dgongs pa mdzad dang bkra shis me tog 'thor// srung ba'i las mdzad lha mo rnams kyis ni// rin chen bum bzang 'chi med bdud rtsi yi// rgyun gyis mngon par dbang bskur khrus gsol bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣa ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ lha rdzas dbang po'i gzhu can gos zung 'bul// oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐// dbang bskur chu zhabs gyen du 'khyil bas ni// gtso bor bcom ldan mi bskyod rgyas gdab cing*/ 'khor rnams rigs bdag so sos dbu brgyan gyur// rgyal ba'i sku la sgrib pa mi 'tshal yang*// bdag sogs 'gro ba sems can kun don phyir// nyon mongs bag chags dri ma dag gyur cig / ces dbang bskur rgyas gdab la/ rang lus zhing gi rdul snyed kyi phra rab tu sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ e ma ho lha rnams kun gyi lha// e ma ho rgyal dang rgyal ba'i mchog

/e ma sangs rgyas kun 'byung gnas// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// bla med go 'phang sbyin pa yi// yid bzhin rin chen gter chen po// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan yon tan bsam yas kyi// 'od zer 'bum phrag brdal ba yi// ma rig mun pa rab bsal ba// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// byams dang snying rje'i rang gzugs kyis// 'gro la bdud rtsi'i bsil sbyin nas// nges don 'od dkar spro ba can// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gting mtha' bral ba'i blo gros kyi// drang nges chos tshul rgya mtsho'i bdag /smin grol chu bo kun 'dus pa'i// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gsol ba 'debs so ye shes kyi// spyan gyis gzigs la byin gyis rlobs// bdag sogs sems can thams cad la// dngos grub don gnyis char chen stsol// ces phyag 'tshal nas/ phyi yi mchod pa 'bul pa ni/ dngos dang yid sprul mchod pa'i rdzas// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid rnams// tshogs gnyis bsod nams spel ba'i phyir// rab 'byams zhing gang spro bar gyur// ces brjod la/ rnam par dag cing gtsang byed kyi// yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ shrī mān ga ru de wa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ dri med tshangs ral las 'ongs pa'i// lam gsum rgyun gyi zhal bsil 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ badz+ra pād+yaṃ= chu dang thang las skyes pa yi// 'dab stong ge sar lo 'dab rgyas// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// badz+ra puṣ+pe= tsan+dan la sogs dri bsung ljon// bdug spos rnam pa ji snyed rnams// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// badz+ra dhū pe=

nyi zla rin chen 'od zer sogs// snang zhing gsal byed sgron me 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// badz+ra ā lo ke= sna tshogs sman gyi sbyor ba las// dri chab ngad ldan byugs pa'i tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// badz+ra gan+dhe= ro brgya ldan pa bcud kyi mchog /lha yi zhal zas dam pa 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// badz+ra nai wid+ye= snyan cing dbyangs ldan rgyud mangs dang*// rol mo'i bye brag ji snyed pa// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// badz+ra shab+da= so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te mchod rol sna tshogs pa bya'o// de nas 'dod yon rnam lnga 'bul ba ni/

phyogs bcu'i rab 'byams zhing rnams la// gzugs dang sgra snyan dri yi byugs// ro bcud lha yi zhal zas rnams// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas thugs rjes bdag byin rlobs// oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she ka ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de nas rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba ni/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan// bsam 'phel nor bu dgos 'dod 'byung*// khyim bdag 'byor ba'i dpal gyis phyug /shes rab bde stong lang tsho can// cang shes thar pa'i lam gyi stegs// khyu mchog stobs bcu'i rtsal rdzogs shing*// bdud bzhi mthar byed dpa' po ste// rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun 'bul// oṃ sap+ta rat+na pra tī ts+tsha ye āḥhūm̐/ de nas bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni/ rin chen gdugs bzang gser nya 'khyugs// bum pa dpal be'u rgyal mtshan bsgrengs// dung dkar pad+ma 'khor lo ste// bkra shis rtags kyi mchod pa 'bul// oṃ aṣ+ṭa mad+gal he tu pra tī ts+tsha ye āḥhūm̐/ de nas rdzas brgyad 'bul ba ni/ kun tu gsal dang skye ba lnga// gi'u wam̐ li khri zho mchog dang*// yungs kar dur+wa bil ba ste// bkra shis rdzas kyi mchod pa 'bul// oṃ aṣ+ṭa mad+gal dra bya pra tī ts+tsha ye āḥhūm̐/ de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhā mi āḥhūm̐/ gser gyi sa gzhi mtha' dbus brdal ba'o// oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje'i ri yis khor yug bskor ba'i dbus// ri dbang rgyal po mchog rab lhun po'o// shar lho nub byang rim bzhin gling chen bzhi// lus 'phags po dang dzam bu chos kyi gling*// ba lang spyod dang byang gi sgra mi snyan// gling phran brgyad dang rin chen sa 'dzin dang*// dpag bsam rkang 'thung 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba// ma rmos snye ma rgyal srid sna bdun dang*// gter chen bum pa sgeg phreng glu gar ma// me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri'i lha mo// nyi zla gdugs bzang rgyal mtshan srid rtser g.yo// gzhan yang gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya yi// lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod sna tshogs pa// rab 'byams zhing gi rdul snyed grangs 'das kun// rdo rje'i maṇ+ḍal gcig tu bsdus nas ni// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// chos skyong srung mar bcas la dbul bar bgyi// bzhes nas smin grol byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

zhes phyi'i mchod pa rnams 'bul zhing*/ nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi 'bul bzhin pas/ chos sku mtha' yas longs sku spyan ras gzigs// sprul sku rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas la// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi mchod pa 'bul// rje btsun bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje 'chang*// chos grub rgya mtsho phrin las shing rta dang*// bstan pa'i nyin byed gtsug lag dga' ba'i dbang*// thugs kyi rdo rje 'chi med dpal dar rje// chos skyong rnam rgyal nor bu bsam 'phel la// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi mchod pa 'bul// ma mgon lcam dral chos skyong srung ma la// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi mchod pa 'bul// zag med bde ba chen po'i ngang du rol// sarba pañca a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces phul nas gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje rol pa'i lha mo bcu drug po// pi waṃ gling bu rnga chen rdza rnga dang*// bzhad ma sgeg mdzes glu gar me tog spos// snang gsal dri chab gzugs ro bcud reg bya// chos dbyings bde stong lha mo la sogs pas// gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa chen po 'bul// oṃ badz+ra wi ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thog mtha' 'dra bar/ waṃ she/ mri daṃ ge/ mu rañje/ ha s+ya/ la s+ya/ girti/ nirti/ dhū pe/ puṣ+pe/ dā+e pe/ gan+dhe/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ra sa= spar+she= dharma dhā tu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces phul nas/ mchod bya mchod byed thams cad kyang*// dran rig gsal ba'i ngang du stong*// 'dus ma byas pa'i mchod pa che// ka nas dag pa'i klong du bzhes// oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta pū dza hoḥ ces de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa chen po ste phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams grub nas sdom pa gsum dang 'gal pa'i dam tshig rtsa ltung gi nyes pa thams cad bshags pa ni/ ho dgongs su gsol lo// dpal ldan bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la gsan du gsol/

bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med dus ring nas tha ma da lta'i bar du 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis bskyed pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyid pa dang*/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang*/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ste sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i rtsa ba yan lag gi nyes par gyur pa'i ltung pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad rab tu gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol lo bshags so// dag tshangs sgrib par mi 'gyur pa'i dbugs dbyung dam pa stsal du gsol/ ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ kye ma rje btsun bla ma dam pa// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang chen// sna tshogs phrin las 'od stong zer gyis// bcom ldan thugs mchog rnam thar ji bzhin// 'gro kun ngan song mun pa gzhom nas// rnam grol yang dag thar pa'i lam mchog /gsal bar ston pa'i bka' drin gsum ldan// yongs su 'dzin pa'i slob dpon dran byung*// mkha' khyab ye shes rol pa 'byams klas// zhing khams yongs kyi mnga' bdag chen po// rmad byung byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas// sangs rgyas dngos su snang ba dran byung*// gtan gyi 'dun ma'i skyabs gnas gcig chog /skal ldan rgyud la ye shes 'pho ba'i// byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun stsol ba'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed rang dran byung*// dpal ldan dwags po bka' yi brgyud pa'i// nges pa don gyi sgrub brgyud gcig bsdus// 'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma dran byung*// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol cig / ces bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi tshul du snang ba 'gyur nges su mos gus kyi dag pa'i snang ba dang ldan pas bton la/ de nas bsnyen pa la 'jug pa ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ye shes chos skyong srung ma'i byin rlabs thugs rje nus rtsal thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par mdun bskyed bla ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la thim/

gnyis med du 'dres/ thugs rgyud bskul/ slar 'od zer steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'phros pas bdag gzhan 'brel tshad nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung byang zhing dag nas/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi skye sgo chod nas kun kyang dag pa ye shes kyi sku thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam la/ de yi ngang nas/ dang po chos sku snang mtha' yas la dmigs te/ oṃ a mi dhā+e wa hrīḥ ci nus bzlas/ de nas longs sku spyan ras gzigs la dmigs te/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ci nus dang*/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ ci nus dang dbus phyogs bla ma kun 'dus kyi gtso bor dmigs la/ oṃ āḥmā ra da ma ka badz+ra hūm̐/ bzlas pa 'di nyid bungs bskyed nas mtshan sngags gzhan rnams ma bton kyang rung*/ spro na bton pa sogs gang bder bya zhing*/ 'og phyogs ma mgon lcam dral la dmigs te/ oṃ ma hā kā la ma hā kā lī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'ang bzlas la/ de nas thabs shes kyi rdzas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar brjod la/ na mo/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po 'di byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba/ dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas/ phrin las kyi dbang phyug /rtsa gsum rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ lan gsum brjod/ tshogs la spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐/ zag med ye nas stong pa'i dbyings// klong yangs mtha' bral zhing khams nas// chos sku snang ba mtha' yas kyang*// 'dir gshegs tshogs la gshegs su gsol// rang byung 'gyur med lhun rdzogs pa// rnam dag bde chen zhing khams nas// longs sku thugs rje chen po yang*// 'dir gshegs= 'gags med thugs rje'i rang rtsal mdangs// dpal ri pad+ma 'od zhing nas// sprul sku rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// 'dir gshegs=

dus gsum rgyal kun ye shes kyi// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rang bzhin can// thabs mkhas zab mo 'gro ba'i gnyen// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bka' brgyud kyi// rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho rnams// 'dir gshegs= bya spyod rnal 'byor bla na med// rgyud sde bzhi 'brel rab 'byams kyi// yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams// 'dir gshegs tshogs la gshegs su gsol// mkha' spyod sa spyod dag pa'i zhing*// gnas gsum skyong ba'i dpa' bo dang*// ma sring mkha' 'gro dam tshig can// 'dir gshegs= byang shang chos dbyings pho brang nas// ma hā kā la rdo rje ber// rang byung rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs= /dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi'i gnas// rang rang so so'i gnas mchog nas// chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud rnams// 'dir gshegs tshogs la gshegs su gsol// hūm̐/ tshogs khang gzhal yas nyams re dga'// sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor byin re che// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dam re gtsang*// tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcud re che// dam rdzas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs// rmad byung mchod pa bzhes su gsol// ces brjod la/ tshogs phud spros nas gtor mar bran la nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi byin rlabs bsangs sbyangs sngar bzhin du byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar brjod/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ pad kor dang bcas rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ badz+ra ā rall̥ hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dri sh+ya ho/ lan gsum/ na mo rat+na gu ru i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ bka' grub thob brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje/ 'khor lo'i mgon po mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho/ bka' drin mnyam med phrin las shing rta/

kun mkhyen 'jam mgon chos kyi 'byung gnas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug gtsug lag dga' ba/ rtsa ba'i bla ma shrī tsit+ta badz+ra/ sngags kyi rig 'dzin shrī'i mtshan can/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chos skyong rnam rgyal/ grub pa'i sar gnas nor bu bsam 'phel la sogs pa drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ yi dam bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po/ rdo rje ber nag po can/ las kyi mgon po/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po/ rang byung srid pa'i rgyal mo/ zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu/ skyes bu rdo rje legs pa la sogs pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ de ltar sku gsung thugs zag med bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du stsol ba dang*/ gzhan yang rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi nas phrin las rnam pa bzhi bsgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ ces pas 'bul/ de nas phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ kha kha khā hi sogs lan bzhi dang*/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ haṃ haṃ he he hi hi pheṃ pheṃ/ lan gsum gyis las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams la 'bul/ hūm̐/ gang dag bla med dkyil 'khor sogs nas/ phrin las thogs med bsgrub par mdzod// ces brjod de dbul bar bya'o// de nas sgrub po rnams tshogs la rol pa ni/ las kyi rdo rjes thabs kyi rdzas g.yas dang*/ shes rab kyi rdzas g.yon du 'dzin bzhin pas/

kye/ longs spyod 'dod yon bsam mi khyab// bde stong tshogs kyi 'khor lor rol// len pa pos/ hoḥ bla na med pa'i dam tshig rdzas// chos kun mnyam pa nyid der 'dud// a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod nas 'du shes gsum dang ldan pa'i ngang nas rol par bya'o// de nas phud lhag rnams phyogs gcig par bsdus la bdud rtsi bran/ a kā ros byin gyis brlabs la/ thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma rgya cher 'phro zhing zad med cir yang 'char bar gyur/ sngon tshe dpal chen po'i spyan sngar 'dud cing phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs pa'i las kyi mkha' 'gro/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro/ sha za mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro pho nya'i tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// tshim zhing dgyes par bzhes la dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor pa skyong ba dang*/ nyams pa can rnams tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing ci ltar bcol ba'i phrin las myur du bsgrub par mdzod cig /u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa si swā hā/ ces phyi rol du dor la/ bshal chu shin tu lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams gso bran legs par bya ba la/ gong ltar mchod pa byin rlabs rnams bya zhing*/ nyer spyod rnams dang 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa'i bar phul nas bstod pa ni/ e ma/ dpal ldan de bzhin gshegs kun thugs rje'i rang bzhin mtha' mi mngon// srid dang zhi ba'i 'ching ba grol mdzad brtse chen nyi ma yis// mya ngan 'das pa'i lam rab ston phyir 'gro blo'i dga' tshal du// byang chub myu gu skyed byed 'gro ba'i ded dpon khyod phyag 'tshal// ces bstod la/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bsgrub pa la// dug gsum dbang gis nongs pa'i tshogs// nyes bar gyur ba mthol zhing bshags// mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya

sogs yig brgya brjod la/ bzod bar gsol nas lhag chad bskang*/ de nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi len pa ni/ pha gcig grub thob chen po// skyabs gcig he ru ka dpal// sangs rgyas lag bcang gtod pa'i// ye shes skye bar byin rlobs// ces mos gus rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas lan gsum bskyar nas brjod la/ karma pa mkhyen no// zhes ci nus su bzlas la dran pa yengs med du mdun bskyed bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la sems 'dzin bzhag la/ gsal gdab pa ni/ oṃ/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// rdo rje sems dpar bdag sgrubs shig /

de nas mdun bskyed yas nas mar dang*/ mas nas yar 'od du zhu ste dbus kyi bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus karma pa'i sku la thim par bsgoms la 'od zer gyi dbang blang ba ni/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rin po che// dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo karma pa'i// dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros// rang gi smin mtshams thim pas spyi bo gang*// bum dbang thob cing lus kyi sgrib pa byang*// snang stong lha sku'i bskyed rim bsgom par dbang*// sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ba ldan par byas// mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros// rang gi zhal du thim pas mgrin pa gang*// gsung gi dbang thob ngag gi nyes ltung byang*// rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor bsgom par dbang*// longs spyod rdzogs sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros// rang gi yid la thim pas snying ga gang*// thugs kyi dbang thob sems kyi nyon mongs byang*// dga' bzhi ye shes snyoms 'jug bsgom par dbang*// sems nyid chos skur 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// slar yang gsang gsum 'od zer dkar dmar mthing*// 'phros pas lus ngag yid la thim pa yis// sgo gsum sgrib dag bzhi pa'i dbang mchog thob// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po bsgom par dbang*// ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// de nas bla ma dgyes pa'i mdangs dang bcas// 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas rang la thim// dbyer med rdo rje bzhi yi byin rlabs zhugs// snang grag rtog pa'i chos rnams thams cad kyang*// dag pa ye shes bla ma'i dkyil 'khor shar// dar gcig phyag chen gyi nyams len ngo bo bskyang nas mnyam par bzhag /dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyar ba ni/ rgyal kun rdo rje'i gsung gi rang bzhin can// bden pa grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gcig chod zab lam bla ma bsgrub pa yi// dge rtsa mi zad 'dus pa gaṅgā'i rgyun// 'gro kun thar pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i phyir// rnam grol byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi// bdag gzhan dus gsum sems can thams cad pa// sku bzhi'i go 'phang dam pa thob gyur cig

/ ces brjod par bya'o// de nas me tog gi char phyogs kun tu 'thor zhing shis pa brjod pa ni/ phun tshogs don gnyis 'byung ba'i gnas// sku gsum bla ma'i bkra shis gang*// deng 'dir nyi ltar gsal gyur te// 'gro ba'i ma rig mun sel shog /ji snyed gzigs pa'i spyan mnga' ba// bka' brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis gang*// deng 'dir nya rgyas zla ltar 'char// rang byung ye shes gsal byed shog /snying rje'i dbyings las mngon spyod sku// chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis gang*// deng 'dir phrin las skar tshogs bkra// bar chad med pa'i bkra shis shog /sid+dhi dza ya dza ya/ gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o// de ltar mchog gi dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje can rnams dkyil 'khor tshul du bsgrubs pa 'di ni/ bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje drag po dngos kyi rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba rim gnyis zab don snying por mnga' dbang bsgyur ba bstan pa'i gsal byed dpal dga' sprul pa'i sku tshe dbang bstan 'dzin dpal bzang po'i dgongs bzhed ji lta bar gu ru rin po che'i mtshan gyi byin rlabs cha tsam thob pa si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos sa zla'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum ba'i tshes la bkod ba'i dge bas 'gro kun zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob ba'i rgyur bsngo'o// mad+ga laṃ kurban+tu/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor grub gnyis mchog stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru we/ byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab mo'i nye lam 'di ltar tshig don ya ma bral bar nyams su len par bya ste/ de'ang dang po skyabs sems ni/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum// gcig bsdus bla ma rdo rje 'dzin rnams la// skyabs su mchi'o mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// bla ma sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob shog /lan gsum dang*/ gnyis pa bskyed pa'i rim pa/

phyi snod nang bcud rang lus gzung 'dzin gyi// a 'thas spros pa kun bral gnyug ma'i ngang*// rang snang rnam dag 'og min chos kyi dbyings// thar pa chen po'i rgyan bkod tshad med pa'i// mdun mkhar dbus su sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa// 'jig rten dbang phyug theg mchog rdo rje 'chang*// phyag gnyis mchog sbyin chos 'chad pad dkar 'dzin// zhwa nag mthong grol gsol zhing lham mer bzhugs// g.yas su 'bri khung chos nyid nor bu'i dpal// sgom zhwa gsol zhing rab byung cha lugs can// g.yon tu byams mgon rnam 'phrul si tu pa// pad+ma nyin byed zhwa dmar gser mdangs gsol// mdun du dpal ldan dpa' bo sngags 'chang chas// pad zhu gsol zhing rdo rje thod chang bsnams// gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir rig pa 'dzin dbang po// rdo rje drag po'i sgyu 'phrul chos nyi ma// karma chags med mchog snang bstan phrin zhabs// ma hā su kha'i rnam par rol pa dang*// ye shes nyi ma'i sde sogs ston 'khor rnams// rang rtags rigs kyi cod pan gsol bzhin par// mtshan dpe'i cha rdzogs chos gos rnam gsum bklubs// phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung*// seng khri pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs// rtsa gsum lha tshogs sprin ltar gtib dbus gsal// dran tsam nyid la zag med bde chen bskyed// gshegs bzhud mi mnga' chu mtshor zla gzugs bzhin// bla ma'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum gsal bar gyur// gsum pa yan lag bdun 'bul pa ni/ na mo/ bdag lus zhing rdul grangs mnyam lus sprul nas// yon tan bsngags brjod sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal// lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba sogs// phyi nang mchod sprin rgya mtsho blos sprul 'bul// thog med dus nas nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// sgo gsum nongs pa'i las kun mthol zhing bshags// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rnam thar dang*// gzhan yang 'gro kun dge la rjes yi rangs// bstan pa ris med skyong ba'i gang zag rnams// gdul bya'i khams dbang 'tshams pa'i chos ston bskul// bdag sogs snyigs ma'i bstan 'gror rjes dgongs la// 'pho med rtag par 'tsho zhes bzhugs gsol 'debs// rang gzhan zag bcas zag med dge tshogs kun// bla med byang chub go 'phang thob phyir bsngo//

bzhi pa mos gus gsol 'debs ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// theg mchog rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// nā gā rdzu na 'jig rten gsum mgon po'i// brgyud 'dzin chos nyid nor bur gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan sangs rgyas mtsho skyes rdo rje yi// rnam rol nyin byed dbang por gsol ba 'debs// o rgyan lung zin gsang sngags ston pa'i bdag /gtsug lag chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs// lnga bdo'i dus 'dir thugs rje gzhan las myur// thugs kyi rdo rje gnyis par gsol ba 'debs// bka' gter zab chos yongs kyi mnga' bdag mchog /karma shā sa dha rar gsol ba 'debs// rang rig ye shes mngon gyur rtogs pa'i bdag /bde chen mchog gi sprul skur gsol ba 'debs// sgrub brgyud nges gsang bstan pa'i phrin las pa// dz+nya na sūr+ya gar la gsol ba 'debs// skyabs gnas dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo nyid// drin chen rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs// dus gsum sangs rgyas sras slob bcas rnams dang*/ dbyer med nges pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// skal ldan mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs// thugs rjes smin grol dngos grus bstsal du gsol// lnga pa mtshan sngags bzla ba/ karma pa mkhyen/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de nas/ oṃ āḥ yā na par ma badz+ra hūm̐/ sngags sham/ ma hā mu dra sid+dhi hūm̐/ drug pa 'dod gsol/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan dam pa'i chos// thos bsam sgom dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// thar pa'i ded dpon bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams// zhabs pad brtan cing rnam bzhi'i phrin las rgyas// ris med dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyang*// chos spyod bcu dang 'khor lo gnyis ldan cing*// rnal 'byor bdag cag byang chub bsgrub pa la// 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs// spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' ru phyin// gzhan phan tshad med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// de ma thob kyi tshe rabs thams cad du// ma nor lam ston bla mas rjes 'dzin cing*// zhabs tog dgu phrugs mchod pas mnyes byas te// tshe rabs kun tu 'bral ba med gyur cig

/mkha' khyab ma gyur rigs drug sems can rnams// byang chub go 'phang myur du thob par shog / ces dang*/ bdun pa byin rlabs dbang bzhi len pa ni/ rgyal kun 'dus pa bla ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi// gsang gsum ye shes rdo rjes byin brlabs nas// dbang bzhi rdzogs par deng 'dir bskur du gsol// lhan skyes bde bas lus la byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje'i bzlas pas ngag la byin gyis rlobs// phyag rgya chen pos yid la byin gyis rlobs// rtse gcig snying nas mos gus drag po yis// gsol ba btab pas 'khor rnams rim pa bzhin// 'od du zhu nas gtso bo'i sku la thim// de nyid dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bor gsal// dpal ldan rigs kun khyab bdag karma pa// gang de'i spyi mgrin thugs ka lte ba nas// 'od zer 'ja' tshon dkar dmar mthing ser rnams// 'phros nas rang gi gnas bzhi la thim pas// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yi// dbang bskur byin rlabs rgyud bzhi smin par gyur// kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nya na badz+ra sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ lan gsum/ chos kyi sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang*// gzugs sku bdag gi las nyon sgrib sbyang phyir// thugs rje chen pos dbyings nas dgongs su gsol// dgyes pa dang bcas 'od kyi rnam par zhu// chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin rang sems dang*// dbyer med ma bcos ngang du mnyam par bzhag / ces ci gnas su sems kyi ngo bo bskyang ba bya'o// brgyad pa rjes kyi bsngo smon bya ba ni/ dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags yod kyi// zag bcas zag med dge tshogs ji snyed pa// mtha' yas 'gro rnams bla med byang chub kyi// go 'phang dam pa myur du thob phyir bsngo// ces si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis/ lugs zung mngon par mtho ba rag shul be hu dpal ldan tshe brtan gyi bzhed ngor cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bco lnga bzang por bkod pa sarba thā mad+ga lam/// /

༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bde chen lam gyi snang ba rab gsal bzhugs so// mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan gyi steng*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul las// yongs grub skye dgu'i 'dren pa chen po pa// byang chub sems dpa' chos grub rgya mtsho mchog /dbang gi mdangs ldan cod pan dbu la gsol// phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag 'chi med tshe bum 'dzin// sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum gyis bklubs// zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// bde bar gshegs ba'i tshogs kun sprin ltar gtibs// bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho char ltar babs// zhi dang khro bo'i skur ston yi dam dang*// ḍā ki dam can srung ma rlung ltar 'tshubs// de mdun bdag dang bdag gi 'brel thogs pa'i// pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug kun// rtse gcig bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum la// dad gus drag pos snying nas phyag 'tshal zhing*// mchod pa'i sprin tshogs nam mkha' gang bar 'bul// dam tshig rtsa ltung thams cad mthol zhing bshags// gzhan phan spyod pa dag la rjes yi rang*// sems can don du bskal mang bzhugs gsol 'debs// bdag sogs 'gro kun thar pa'i lam mkhan mchog /bka' drin gsum ldan grub dbang bla ma mkhyen// 'gro ba'i mgon po mtshungs med chos kyi rje// rgyal ba mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho mkhyen// rje drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus mkhyen no// zhes snying thag pa nas ci nus brjod/ thabs mkhas gang 'dul phrin las zab mo'i bdag /brtse chen khyod kyi thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// byang chub sems kyi 'od dkar yongs su 'char// gdul bya'i mos blo'i ku mud rnam par bkra// gsang chen theg pa'i dam chos spyod pa dang*// nam zhig sgyu lus 'pho bar gyur ma thag /bde ba can zhes bya ba'i zhing khams su// pad+ma'i snying por brdzus te skye bar shog /de ma thag tu zhing de'i ston pa mchog

/'od dpag med mgon gar dbang sprul pa'i sku// mi pham dpal ldan chos grub rgya mtsho'i sde// zhal mthong gsung gi bdud rtsi myong bar shog /'khor rnams 'od zhu gtsor thim de nyid kyang*// dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rang gi lus la thim// dbang bzhi thob nas sku bzhi mngon du byas// mtsho la char babs lta bur gnyis med gyur// dar gcig lta ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas nyams len la gnas/ skye dang tshe rabs brgyud pa thams cad du// rtsa ba'i bla ma mi 'bral mchod par shog /dge 'dis 'gro kun myang 'das sar bkod nas// mgon po khyod kyi go 'phang thob gyur cig / ces rgyal mchog bcu gsum ba'i lung gis ras sprul shes rab rgya mtsho zhes pa gang nas lha rdzas dang bcas bskul bar brten/ sa brgyad sems dpa' srid pa'i lha chen gyi bsti gnas dang mi ring ba gang de'i 'khor du gtogs pa gang ba bzang po'i ri zhol gyi ngogs su karma si tus bris pa kun tu bkra shis kyi dpal la spyod par gyur cig /mad+ga lam/// / ༈ sngon 'gro gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi zhes sogs lan bzhi brjod/ zhing skyong brgyad dang mkha' 'gro so gnyis sogs// zhes sogs 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin/ las bzhi'i phrin las mdzod bar dang*/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor lta bar mi dbang pa'i// bdud bgegs log 'dren 'byung po phyir dengs shig gang dag bka' las 'das na ye shes kyi// rdo rjes brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za// sum+bha ni/ brjod la/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs las 'od zer 'phros// rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang*// rgya gram 'bar bas steng 'og bar med par// srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya ches gtams// dz+nyā na pañca badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes srung 'khor bsgoms la/ mdun bskyed la 'jug par bya/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char 'bebs bi dza ha ra/ na mo gu ru a mi ta bha ya/

'dir sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus ba'i bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla ma sgrub pa'i cho ga mthar chags su brjod par bya ste/ de yang*/ ji skad du/ mdzod las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsams// zhes sogs kyi dpe zlas dben ba'i yon tan du mas mdo rgyud kun nas bsngags brjod rgya cher gsungs shis nges pa don gyi yongs bcud du nges pa'i/ de la 'dir rten sku brnyan 'dra 'bag dngos sam/ yang na rje zhwa dmar pa'i sku 'dra gang byung bshams la/ mdun nu mchod pa rnam lnga/ nang mchod dang gtor ma tshogs kyi yo byad sna tshogs pa/ maṇ+ḍal sogs mchod pa ji snyed 'dus par byas te/ rang nyid yi dam lha gang rung bskyed la/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa ni/

mdun gyi nam mkhar dus gsum skyabs yul dkon mchog rgya mtsho gsal ba'i spyan sngar bdag sogs ma gyur mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad kyis sgo gsum dwangs pa'i blos/ skyabs mchog skyabs kyi mgon po thugs rje can// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs bcas la// deng bzung byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// ces skyabs sems 'di dag lan gsum dang*/ kye ma/ bdag gis 'gro phan lhag bsam drag po yi// byams dang snying rje'i go cha cher bgos nas// rigs drug 'khor ba dong nas sprug pa yi// tshad med thugs rjes 'gro don skyong bar shog /dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa yi// dpal ldan bla mar skyabs su mchi// bdag lus longs spyod dngos snang srid// dpal 'byor ma lus mchod par 'bul// las nyon sgrib pa'i smag rum gyi// 'thib po'i dbang gyur nyes kun bshags// chu zla'i gar gyi rol pa bzhin// mos ngor der snang rjes yi rang*// bla med yang dag snang ba yi// dam chos nyin byed kun gsal ston// theg chen byang sems spyod pa can// mgon rnams bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol 'debs// rab dkar dge tshogs chu rgyun rnams// thar ba'i rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig / ces yan lag bdun pa 'bul nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ 'gro rnams bde ldan sdug bsngal dang bral zhing*// dga' bde'i btang snyoms tshad med gnas gyur cig / nang mchod bdud rtsi/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān gyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs la/ chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las// yam̐ las rlung dkyil gzhu dbyibs can// ram̐ las med dkyil zur gsum pa// de steng hūm̐ gsum spros pa las// bhan+dha skam po bum ril gsum// ltag pa nang bstan de stengs su// āḥlas thod snod yangs pa ni// phyi dkar nang dmar dbus su mu// shar du bi dang lho ru ra// nub tu shu dang byang du ma// bdud rtsi lnga po yig 'brus mtshan// dbus su na dang shar lhor go

/lho nub ku dang nub byang da// byang shar ha ste sha lnga'o// yi ge so sos mtshan par gyur// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas// hūm̐ gi dbyibs can rlung 'phros pas// rlung gis me bskyod thod rdzas khol// ma dag dri ma dag gtsang sbyangs// de steng oṃ āḥhūm̐ yig las// 'od 'phros ye shes bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig bdud rtsi gnyis med par// dag pa ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// ces bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas 'di ltar bsgom par bya'o// oṃ shun+yā ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus ba'i chos thams cad don dam ye shes rdo rje'i dbyings su bsgyur nas/ phyi nang snang srid gnyis bsdus dngos po rnams// stong nyid chen po'i dbyings su sbyang byas nas// mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen gzhal yas khang*// mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs rgyan dang bkod pa rnams// zhing khams rab 'byams lhun grub de dbus su// gyad dang seng ge brgyad btegs rin chen khrir// dbyibs legs rmad byung de steng pad+ma dkar// dri med 'dab stong rgyas pa de stengs su// rab dkar lhun sdug zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mdzod// mi bzad rgyan 'khor lnga yi bdag po ste// rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i skur snang ba// dpal ldan mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar dmar mdangs// thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// spyan gnyis chos nyid 'gyur med don la gzigs// dbu la mthong grol pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /khyung gshog gser mdangs rin chen phra tshom can// rigs bdag pad+ma gar dbang tshul du gsol// chos gos rnam gsum za 'og ber chen bklubs// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ sngon mtshan// gzhan yang steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du// sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin grub thob tshogs// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*// zhing skyong bstan srung rgya mtsho ma lus pa// dpag med mtha' yas brjod bral ji snyed tshogs// bar mtshams med par bu yug 'tshubs bzhin bzhugs// gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros// rnam dag phyogs bcu'i zhing dang 'og min gnas// khyad par bde ldan pad+ma bkod zhing nas// rgyal ba 'od snang mtha' yas thugs rgyud bskul// mchog gi sprul sku gar gyi dbang po la// bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// dpa' bo ḍā ki chos skyong 'khor tshogs bcas// char sprin gtibs bzhin mdun bskyed lha rnams la// gnyis med du ma ro gcig ngang nyid du// dam tshig dang ni ye shes mnyam nyid gyur// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā la e h+ya hi badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ slar yang thugs las 'od zer dkar po 'phros// rigs lnga yum lnga la sogs dbang lha'i tshogs// rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs mdun mkhar bzhugs// de bzhin gshegs kun dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad// gshegs ma rnams kyis shis brjod me tog 'thor// rin chen bum pa bdud rtsis legs gtams pas// dbang bskur sku gang chu zhabs yar lud nas// rigs bdag pad+ma gar dbang dbu brgyan gyur// ces dbang bskur rgyas gdab dang*/ de nas mchod ba 'bul ba'i rim pa ni/ mchod pa rnams nang mchod bdud rtsis bsangs la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān sogs dang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i// snod mchog yid 'ong du ma'i nang*// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang*// sgra snyan la sogs gzhan yang ni// phyi nang mchod rdzas dpag med tshogs// zag med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// bde chen ye shes skyed byed gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ ni wi d+ya/ shab+da/ sogs dang*/ rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ rā sa/ spar+she/ bi shwa s+pha ra ṇa ā hūm̐ gis byin brlabs nas/ rab tu dag gtsang dri med gdung sel ba'i// rdo rje'i mchod yon 'bul gyi bdag byin rlobs// oṃ shrī mān gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ dwangs shing sim pa'i rgyur gyur dal 'babs kyi// zhabs bsil yid 'ong 'bul gyi bdag byin rlobs// sngags thog mtha' 'dra ba/ pā d+yaṃ/ skabs gsum me tog man+dā ra ba sogs// chu skyes thang skyes 'bul gyi bdag byin rlobs// puṣ+pe/ dri bsung phun tshogs sprin chen phyogs mthar dkrigs// bdug pa'i spos mchog 'bul gyi bdag byin rlobs// dhū pe/ nyi zla gza' skar 'phrul gyi gsal byed sogs// snang ba'i rigs kun 'bul gyi bdag byin rlobs// ā lo ke/

ji snyed sman spos sbyar ba las byung ba'i// byugs pa'i dri bzang 'bul gyi bdag byin rlobs// gan+dhe/ lha yi zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa// bcud kyis yongs gtams 'bul gyi bdag byin rlobs// naiwī d+ya/ grag stong sgra yi bye brag sna tshogs dang*// mi shigs nā da 'bul gyi bdag byin rlobs// shab+da/ rol mo ldir/ mtha' yas rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi// gzugs bzang dbyangs snyan dri ngad ldan// bshos gtsang reg 'jam du ku la// rnam mang mchod 'bul bdag byin rlobs// oṃ shrī mān gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra rū pa/ shab+da/ ghan+dhe/ rā sa/ spar+she pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang srid zhi'i longs spyod kyi// dpal 'byor rgya chen mi bzad pa// bskal par rgyun mi 'chad pa yi// mchod sprin mkha' dbyings gang gyur cig / de nas maṇ+ḍal ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod la/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la// mu khyud ra bas yongs bskor dbus su ri dbang po// lhun po mchog rab shin tu mngon mtho lham me ba// lus 'phags 'dzam gling ba lang spyod dang sgra mi snyan// shar lho nub byang gling chen bzhi ste gling g.yog dang*// rin chen ri bo dpag bsam rkang 'thung 'dod 'jo'i ba// ma rmos lo tog 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dang*// khyim bdag cang shes khyu mchog g.yul rgyal dpa' bo che// gter chen bum bzang sgeg pa phreng 'dzin glu dbyangs ma// gar mkhan me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri chab thogs// 'dod yon lha mo rab 'byams zhing bkang mchod pa spro// nyi zla rin chen gdugs bzang rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan bsgreng*// gzhan yang bar mtshams kun tu lha mi'i mchod pa'i rdzas// mtha' yas mu med phra rab rdul gyi grangs las 'das// bkod legs rmad byung phun tshogs yon tan brjid pa 'di// dpal ldan bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi// bdag gzhan 'gro la brtse bar dgongs mdzod dbyings nas rol// byin rlabs char gyi mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

phyag 'tshal mchod bshags yi rang bskul gsol 'debs// dus gsum dge rtsa chos dbyings chen por bsngo// ces maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ sku gsum ye shes lnga bdag rdo rje can// bka' brgyud rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho sogs// zhing khams rab 'byams bzhugs pa'i mchod 'os la// dag pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bul bzhes// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bul/ de nas skabs 'dir bstod bshags 'bul ba ni/ chos dbyings kyi nam mkha' mtha' dbus brdal// bde chen rtsal ma 'gags sprin tshogs gtibs// sgyu 'phrul gar rtsed kyi char rgyun 'babs// sku gsum gyi bdag nyid khyod la bstod// sku mtshan dpe'i nyin byed 'od stong ldan// log rtog gi mun chen pha mthar gzhom// mthong tsam gyis grol ba'i lam mchog ston// mchog rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsung yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan// bka' brgyad khri bzhi stong chos 'khor bskor// thos tsam gyis yang dag bden pa rtogs// mchog rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs mtha' bral zab zhi spros dang bral// ting nge 'dzin brgya phrag stong mnga' ba// dran tsam gyis rnam grol lam la bkod// mchog rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa// kun 'dus pa bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// dpal mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs// bdag mgon med 'di nas byang chub bar// mi 'bral bar gcig tu smon lags na// rje khyed kyi thugs rjes bdag byin rlobs// dngos snang gi 'dzin pa'i zhen chags dang*// 'khrul snang la a 'thas re dogs sogs// chos brgyad kyi nyon mongs dgra bo 'di// rang sar yal bden med rtogs gyur cig /skye med kyi ngang du 'gags med pa// gnas med kyi rtogs pa'i rtsal rdzogs shog /dus snyigs ma lnga yi yang mtha' 'dir// skal med bdag skal bar ldan nam snyam// rje sangs rgyas bdud 'dul rdo rje dang*// mchog dbang gi cod pan 'dzin pa gnyis// mthong thos pas thugs rje'i zla snang gis// bdag blo yi dad ba'i ku mud rgyas// bcos min gyi mos gus drag po yis// lus bye snyed sprul nas phyag 'tshal zhing*// ngag lhang lhang gsol ba 'debs 'debs so// yid dung dung 'dun pa rtse gcig pas// pha mkhyen no dus gsum sangs rgyas mkhyen// pha mkhyen no sangs rgyas kun 'dus mkhyen// bdag las nyon khur gyis lci ba yis// dngos bka' yi gdams pa g.yel lags kyang*// gdung shugs kyi mos gus 'bar ba'i mthus// nyams gsal snang ngang du chos ston gsol// mchog kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan pa/
