gnad ma hā mu dra'i bdag nyid can// lam gcig chod zab mo myur brgal nas// sku bzhi yi rgyal sar drang du gsol// ces dang*/ de nas snying po bzlas pa ni/ mdun bskyed bla ma'i thugs kar zla steng hrīḥ /dmar po'i mtha' mar yig drug 'khor ba las// 'od zer 'phros pas bdag gzhan 'gro la thim// sdig sgrib kun dag snang stong mngon du gyur// oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ ci nus dang*/ oṃ āḥdharma sid+dha sā ga ra hūm̐/ mtshan sngags kyang bzla'o// bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dra'i dmu rgod sems can// las ngan g.yang sa brgal nas// khyod kyi zhing khams bde ldan// pad+mo bkod par skyes nas// rgyal ba'i zhal mthong lung thob// rtse gcig smon lam 'debs so// mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho// mkhyen no thugs rjes zungs shig / ces rgyang 'bod tshul du bya'o// yang*/ a hoḥ rang sems 'khrul pa zhes dang*/ ma 'ongs drug pa mtshan gnyis kyang spro na brjod/ de nas phyi nang dam tshig nyams chag bshags pa ni/ kyai/ bla ma rin po che dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag dpa' bo chen po dang*/ gzhan yang mkhyen cing gzigs pa mnga' ba thams cad dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i 'khor ba thog med nas da lta'i bar du nyon mongs pa'i dbang las gyur pa'i mi dge ba'i las kyi so thar dang gsang sngags byang sems kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung nongs pa thams cad deng ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi drung du mthol lo bshags so// de ltar nyes tshogs bshags pa'i bsod nams kyis// rgyal kun mgrin dbyangs gcig pas dbugs dbyung gyur// phyin chad nongs par bgyis pa'i las gang dag /srog la bab kyang mi 'dor dam bca' bzung*// zhes bshags sbyang stobs bzhi'i ya gyal rten bla ma'i stobs khyad 'phags gsungs phyir 'di yang 'bad pas zungs shig /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i phyir// tshogs 'khor byin rlabs myur 'bebs brjod par bya// nang mchod ltar tshogs byin gyis brlabs nas/

dag pa ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// bar dang*/ hūm̐/ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i// 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs 'khor lo// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan// zag med longs spyod char 'bebs gyur// pañca a mri ta la khā hi/ ga na tsakra la khā hi/ de nas tshogs rol gyi mgron rnams spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐ rang snang chos dbyings zhing khams nas// bka' brgyud bla ma sku bskyod 'tshal// rnam 'phrul klong yangs thibs se thib// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// nub phyogs bde chen zhing khams nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma sku bskyod 'tshal// byin rlabs sprin phung kyi li li// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas// sangs rgyas byang sems sku bskyod 'tshal// thugs rje'i char rgyun si li li// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dag pa mkha' spyod zhing khams nas// yi dam ḍā ki sku bskyod 'tshal// dngos grub dbyar rnga di ri ri// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// chos skyod srung ma sku bskyod 'tshal// phrin las glog 'od khyugs se khyug /'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// tsā ri ye shes 'khor lo nas// zhing skyong 'khor bcas sku bskyod 'tshal// myur mgyogs rlung ltar thogs med 'phyo// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gnas dang 'dod yon byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang chen bskur// rlung sems snang ba dbang sdud cing*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol//

de nas tshogs phud rim par spros la/ gtor mar bran nas/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong sogs la dmigs nas/ sngar bzhin bdud rtsi byin rlabs byas la/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍa ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ḍi sh+ya hoḥ chos sku gar dbang rdo rje 'chang chen dang*// longs sku tshe 'od snang ba dpag tu med// sprul sku 'chi med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// mthon mthing pad+ma rā ga'i cod pan can// rgyal bas lung zin rim par byon rnams dang*// bka' brgyud grub thob rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// ma mgon mgar gsum zhing skyong chen po sogs// chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul// dgyes bzhes dngos grub dam pa myur du stsol// de nas 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+sha rak+sha sogs dang*/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ ha ha sogs dang pheṃ bar brjod/ zhing skyong brgyad dang mkha' 'gro so gnyis sogs// 'khor bcas 'dir byon mchod sbyin 'dod yon gyi// gtor ma 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthun rkyen spel// 'gal rkyen phyir bzlog las bzhi'i phrin las mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ de nas khyad par sgos kyi bka' srung zhing skyong chen po'i gtor 'bul ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ mkha' spyod dpal gyi tsā ri tra// rab 'jigs dur khrod rol pa nas// 'khor lo sdom pa'i thugs las sprul// gha ya dha ra yab yum dang*// bdud dmag stong sde'i dpung tshogs bcas// dam tshig 'du 'bral med bzhin du// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'dir bshams ye shes lnga yi rdzas// ba ling gtor ma ri ltar spungs// sman raka gtan 'khyil mtsho ltar rgyas// gzhan yang bskang rten sgrub pa'i rdzas// longs spyod mi bzad sprin ltar gtibs// bstan srung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dpal ldan mkha' spyod dbang po yi// rdo rje'i bka' bsgos ma bsnyel bar// sangs rgyas bstan dang bstan 'dzin srung*// rnal 'byor tshe dpal chos 'phel zhing*// nad mtshon dal ka dgra la sgyur// pha rol byad dang rbod gtong zlog

/bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod// ces phul/ de nas dngos grub kyi rdzas tshogs la rol pa ni/ kye kun rtog mnyam nyid ngang nas 'dod yon rol// len pa pos/ hoḥ gzung 'dzin mtshan bral de bzhin nyid la 'dud// a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod la rol par bya'o/ phud lhag la bdud rtsis bran la/ a kā ro sa byin gyis brlabs nas/ phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma la dbang ba'i mkha' 'gro dang yang 'khor pho nya'i tshogs rnams la bsngo zhing 'bul bar bgyi'o// bstan pa srung la rnal 'byor skyong ba'i phrin las ma g.yel cig /uts+tshi ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ces phul/ de nas mchod pa gso bran byas la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ naiwi d+ya/ shab+da dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ rā sa/ spar+she āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod/ dran pa tsam gyis 'khor mtsho las// nges par sgrol ba'i thugs rje can// dkyil 'khor dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin// rigs kun bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ gang zhig sangs rgyas yid byed pa// de yi mdun na bzhugs gsungs bzhin// ji ltar dpal ldan bla ma mchog /bdag ngor nges par mngon sum shar// de yi ngang nas rtse gcig mos gus dar drag bskyed la/ bla ma'i zhal nas mngon sum rdo rje'i bka' yis gnang ba thob par bsam la/ kyai hoḥ sems nyid dngos med gdod nas rnam dag la// rang bzhin stong zhing bcos med bsgom bya dang*// sgom byed bral ba'i ngang la shigs se zhog /de kho na nyid sangs rgyas dgongs pa'o// zhes de'i ngang nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi blang ba'i mos gus kyis/ skyabs yul kun kyang mdun bskyed bla mar thim// de nyid dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs g.yo bzhin du// spyi bo mgrin pa thugs ka lte gsang nas// oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ sngon swā ser hā// ljang 'od zer 'phros rang gi gnas lngar thim// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las byin rlabs zhugs// nyon mongs lnga dag ye shes lnga thob gyur// de yi ngang nas brtse ba chen por bcas// 'od dkar ltem gyis gyur nas bdag lus dang*// dbyer med gcig 'dres phyag rgya chen po yi// nyams len lta ba'i ngang du dar gcig bzhag

/ de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni/ na mo/ bla ma sgrub pa'i dge ba gang*// bdag dang sems can thams cad kun/ bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsngo// phyam gcig sangs rgyas sar 'god shog / ces dang*/ ston mchog zhi ba chags bral dang*// rtsa gsum mthu stobs 'od stong can// deng 'dir kun nas kun gsal ba'i// bkra shis rab gsal rab rgyas shog ces shis pa'i me tog 'thor/ mchod sbyin gnas sogs brjod par bya'o// de ltar dbang gi cod pan 'dzin pa bcu pa mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho'i bla sgrub 'di bzhin 'og min karma'i grwa tshang bslab gsum ldan pa dge slong karma tshe brtan gyis dngos po'i maṇ+ḍal dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor rje de nyid kyi thugs rjes rjes 'dzin si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs kyi nya la spel ba/ bdag 'dra so skye'i brjod pa dpe chu shing dang mtshungs par gyur kyang*/ don bla ma sgrub pa mchog gi nye lam ste skal ldan rnams kyi thar pa'i them skas tsam du gyur pa'o// dge 'dis kun mkhyen byang grol myur thob shog /'di nyid rgyas bsdus gsum du dbye bas rgyas pa ni 'dir gsal gyi 'bring por skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa de nas mdun bskyed dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod pa byin rlabs nas maṇ+ḍal tshar rjes/ bstod phyag /bzlas pa/ bshags sdom mthar/ sngags mchod rnams dang*/ de nas gzhung ltar ro// rgyun khyer lta bur bsdu na/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun phul nas/ mdun bskyed dbang bskur rgyas gdab par// sngags mchod phul nas bsnyen par 'jug /rgyang 'bod bshags sdom mthar/ gang zhig sangs rgyas man/ bkra shis bar gyis 'grub/ ces yang dben du spel/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char 'bebs kyi dbang bzhi dngos grub sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rtsa ba'i bla ma skye med chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir bla sgrub byin rlabs char 'bebs las 'phros pa'i dbang chog zhig bkod pa ste/

bla med lugs kyi thun mong min pa'i smin byed rim pa la/ mdun bskyed mchod pa'i dbus su mañji'i steng rnam rgyal bum pa lnga phrag lnga yi rdzas kyis gtams par dri bzang gi chus sum gnyis bkang ba'i khar dung chos dang gzungs rdor kha rgyan sogs kyang bkod/ rigs lnga'i dbang rdzas bkram/ de yi steng du ka pā la mtshan nyid ldan pa myos byed dang bdud rtsi ril bus gang ba'i khar me long sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bshams/ gzhan yang nyer mkho'i yo byad 'du bar byas la/ thog mar mdun bskyed dkyus ltar gyi bshags pa'i bar bton la/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs pa ni/ oṃ ā bigh+nān sogs dang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs la/ stong las dal dbus mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pa'i// rin chen bum pa mchu 'phyang lto ba ldir// mgrin ring kha yangs zhabs zhum rgyan gyis spras// lam gsum 'babs kyi rgyun bzang mtsho 'khyil dbus// dri med pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab rgyas lter// bsil zer byed pa'i cha shas yongs gang steng*// gar dbang rigs kun bdag po rdo rje 'chang*// dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril// bsnol 'dzin rang 'od yum 'khyud mtshan dpe 'bar// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan dang cha lugs mdzes// rdor skyil gyis bzhugs bde stong ye shes rgyas// gnas gsum yig gsum sa bon mtshan par gyur// de las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros// khyad par nub phyogs bde chen pho brang nas// spyan drangs dbyer med bum lhar sib sib thim// gu ru badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur// de nas ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ dran pa tsam gyis 'khor mtsho las// nges par sgrol ba'i thugs rje can// dkyil 'khor dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin// rigs kun bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs yan lag bdun pa phul/ bum lha'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs rgyud bskul bar byas// de nyid tshur 'dus sku yi cha shas nas// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi char 'bebs gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru badz+ra dhṛ kra hūm̐ swā hā/

ces snying po gang 'grub bzla'o// bum lha 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur// ces brjod/ de nas sngar gyi mdun bskyed bla ma'i dkyil 'khor bkra lam mer slar yang mngon sum gsal btab nas/ gtso bo bum bskyed ltar longs spyod rdzogs sku gar dbang rdo rje 'chang rang 'od yum can du bskyed la dbang blang ba ni/ dang po gsal gdab ni/ oṃ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// rdo rje sems dpar bdag sgrubs shig / zhes gsol ba btab la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus dang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma byin rlabs dang bcas bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bar bton nas/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ mi phyed pa'i blos/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid bka' drin gyis// yang dag ye shes mchog thob ste// chos kyi bdud rtsi 'di 'thung phyir// bla ma che la gsol ba 'debs// ces lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje rgyal po dgongs su gsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// nges par bdag ni 'jug pa dang*// rigs lnga'i dam tshig so sor bzung*// lan gsum/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi/ lan gsum/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho/ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ ces sems bskyed la/ bla ma he ru ka dpal snying la bzhugs// rdo rje snying gar reg /ye shes dbab pa'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpal he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnams kyis bdag la de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bu bdud rtsi lta bu/ rin po che lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu yang smin par mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams kyi gsang gsum ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam par rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus sems bde ba chen po'i 'od kyis gang bar gyur/

oṃ gu ru badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza/ dz+nyā na ā be sha ya ā be sha ya a a/ drag tu brjod cing*/ spos dang rol mo bya'o// ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// bltas pas sems la grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid 'di// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// rang sems skye med chos kyi sku// chos kyi sku la skye 'jig med// skye med bde ba chen po'i sku// rang la yod pa ngo mtshar che// rang sems chos sku'i me long la// gnyis med ye shes 'od du shar// shar ba nyid nas grub med de// bde chen lhan cig skyes pa yin// tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par byas/ slob ma dbang rdzas rigs lnga yab yum gsal// 'od kyis lha yi dbang rdzas so sor thogs// dgongs pa mdzad dang mchod cing shis pa brjod// srung ba'i las dang bum pa bdud rtsi yis// ji ltar bltams tshe bcom ldan khrus gsol ltar// lha chu dag pas 'dir ni dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣañca hūm̐/ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣeñca tram̐/ badz+ra dhā ra ni a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ badz+ra na maḥ.a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ ces brjod la bum pa dang*/ dbu rgyan/ pad+ma/ dril bu/ ming dbang rnams so sor bskur nas/ oṃ badz+ro da ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ ā haṃḥ zhes chu dbang bskur/ de ltar dbang bskur dug lnga'i sgrib pa dag /phung lnga gnas gyur ye shes lnga thob nas// chu zhabs yar lud rigs lngas dbu rgyan gyur// de nas slob dpon dbang ni/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// lan gsum gsol ba btab/ rdo rje dang dril bu blangs ste/ hūm̐ byung rdo rje ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ āḥbyung dril bu badz+ra gan+ḍe āḥ 'khyud pa'i rgya dang bcas/ slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ rdo rje snye ma zung 'jug gsal// rdo rje dril bu che zung zhig /rdo rjer byin rlobs slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis//

dbang bskur ba ni/ rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// bum pa spyi bor bzhag chu btung*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ chu zhabs gyen 'khyil mi bskyod rgyas gdab gyur// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ 'dod yon rol zhing khams gsum don// rten cing 'brel 'byung nyid du spyod// de ltar lus kyi sgrib dag bum dbang thob// bskyed rim brtan thob sprul sku 'grub par gyur// de nas gsang dbang ni/ mgon po bdag sogs 'khor ba'i 'dam// bying ba skyabs med sgrol mdzod cig / lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ gtso bo yab yum snyoms 'jug gi// byang sems rgyun gyi dbang mchog bskur/ kā pa la mgrin par bzhag la/ a ho ma hā su kha/ bdud rtsi myong la/ de ltar sangs rgyas rnams las byung ba yi// dam tshig bcud kyi bde ba chen po myong*// ngag gi sgrib dag gsang dbang thob nas ni// rtsa rlung brtan thob longs sku 'grub par gyur// de nas shes rab ye shes dbang ni/ he ru ka dpal bdag drongs shig /gsang ba chen pos smin par mdzod// lan gsum gsol ba btab/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor yum du gsal bas/ rdo rje snye ma las spros pa'i// bde ster lha mo mchod par gyis// zhes gtad la/ mkha' gsang byin brlabs sbyor ba yis// dga' dang mchog dga' khyad par dga'// lhan skyes dga' bzhi nyams myong gyur// sin+dhū ras gnas bzhir thig le bya/ sems kyi sgrib dag bde stong bsgom par dbang*// chos sku 'grub pa'i skal ba ldan par gyur/ /bzhi pa tshig dbang ni/ rdo rje can zhabs bka' drin gyis// rin chen bzhi pa'ang deng 'dir stsol// lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ lus gnad ngo bo skyong la/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha//

zhes tshig gi brda sprad la/ don dam de bzhin nyid kyi dbang bskur thob// sgo gsum sgrib dag phyag chen bsgom par dbang*// ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// de nas rjes rim ni/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal bdag gis bgyi// lan gsum dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bya'o// deng nas brtsams te bdag bran sogs brjod la/ de nas dpa' bo'i dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor la rol pa sogs rnal 'byor gyi nyams bskyang bar bya'o// ces pa'ang bslab pa'i tshul khrims dang dad pa'i nor ldan sgrub chen pa bkra shis kyi bzhed ltar/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos yang dben du spel ba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ dbang bzhi dngos grub sprin phung gi mtshams sbyor pad dkar chun po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob ma khrus dang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ bgegs bskrad la/ dang po dbang gi spyi bshad ni/

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che la bkod snyam pa'i sems bskyed nas legs par gsan 'tshal/ gsan par bya ba'i chos de la yang bdag cag gi ston pas rgyu pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa gnyis su gsungs par 'dus shing*/ de yang rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba las/ nang gses gnyis su dbye ba/ gsum dang bzhir dbye ba/ lnga dang drug tu dbye ba grangs nges med du dbye ba mchis na'ang yongs su grags pa rgyud sde bzhir bstan cing*/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhi yi gdul bya'i khams dang dbang po'i bye brag gi gang zag la dgongs nas so sor gsal zhing ston par mdzad cing*/ de yang dbang rnon gyi rgyud la byin rlabs myur du smin pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob tu dam ye gnyis ka gdod nas rang chas su bzhugs pa de yi ngo bor gnas pa la gsal thebs pas dngos grub thams cad lhun gyis grub pas rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud ces grags pa 'di nyid yin gyi/ don dam par ni spros bral stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dbyer med 'od gsal chen po'i chos nyid kyi rang bzhin cir yang shar ba ste/ rtag pa phyi ma las/ rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pa// rdzun min bde min de bzhin du// thams cad chu yi zla ba ltar// 'dod pa rnal 'byor pas shes kyi// zhes pa ltar bstan cing*/ mchog gi rmad du byung ba'i rgyud la bsten nas lam gcig chod kyi zab mo bla ma sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas rjes su 'dzin pa ste/ de yang bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku ni dper na me long gi dngos po/ gdul bya ni de yi ngogs nas gzugs 'char ba/ 'dul byed gzugs kyi sku ni mi g.yo bar gzugs ji lta bar 'char ba'i gnyen po/ shar bzhin pa me long nyid la de yi nges pas gsal bar mtshon no// kun spyod kyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i mchod brjod/

gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid// ces pa'i tshig rkang ba bzhi po'i lung dang mthun par/ bla ma bsten pa la gus pa rnams smin lam dbang gi dus mtshon bya don dam pa'i ye shes skyed par byed de/ dgyes rdor las/ bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa la// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs shing*/ de lta bu'i bla ma rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu ste/ gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta bar rdzogs par byed nus pas so// des na de nyid rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ rdo rje can te/ ji skad du/ bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'dzin// tha dad par yang mi rtog go /zhes dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod pa bas// bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod lhag /ces dang*/ 'jam dpal las/ mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas// rtag tu ri mor bya ba'i 'os// bkur 'os brjed par bya ba'i mchog /phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab// ces sogs/ mdo rgyud gang nas kyang lung gi 'dren pa ches mang bar gsal zhing bsngags par mdzad la/ de ltar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma mchod cing byin rlabs rgyud la smin pa'i phyir rnal 'byor bsgom rim la brtson par byas na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'byung bar nges pa'i tshul la dwangs pa bskyed cing*/ de dag gi phan yon theg pa che chung so so nas gsung tshul dpag tu med pa spros kyis mi lang gi/ 'dir ni gtso bo byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bka' srol ma chad pa 'brel tshad don dang ldan zhing*/ khyad par skal ldan gyi rgyud la dngos su phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes skyed par mdzad cing phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang la bkod nus pa'i bla ma de nyid rdo rje 'chang dngos su snang bar byed pa rigs te/ de yang sangs rgyas drug pa seṅge'i rnam 'phrul mthon mthing gi cod pan 'chang ba dpal karma pa skyes rabs kyi phreng ba bcu gsum dang*/ dbang rtags pad+ma rā ga'i cod par 'chang ba zhwa dmar pa skyes rabs bcu pa 'dzin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i skur snang ba 'di dag ni rgyal ba bu ram shing pa dang*/

o rgyan chen po'i lung gis zin cing dbugs dbyung bar mdzad pa sogs ches gsal bar bstan pa gsar rnying gi chos sgo du mar bkral bar snang ba dang*/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings nges pa lnga ldan gyi zhing na gar dbang rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par rol pa dang*/ bde ba can pad+mo rnam par bkod par 'od snang mtha' yas kyi skur gsal ba dang*/ sngon 'das pa'i dus sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag tu mngon par byang chub nas bdud rtsi brnyes zin kyang*/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir yang snying rje dang*/ byams pa dang*/ brtse ba chen pos 'gro rnams yal ba ma dor ba'i phyir skye ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa ji srid du ston par mdzad cing*/ de yang rdo rje gur las/ gang phyir rdo rje sems dpa' ni// de nyid slob dpon gzugs bzung ste// sems can phan gdags dmigs nas ni// tha mal pa yi gzugs su gnas// ces gsungs pas bstan cing gdul bya rnams thabs dang rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas 'dul bar mdzad cing*/ yang dag pa'i sar nges par dkri ba'i 'phags pa mchog gi spyod pa dag nye bar spyad pa'i stobs kyis dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo/ rigs thams cad kyi dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dang mi gnyis par rdo rje bzhi yi ngo bor mngon du bsnyen pa'i sgo nas smin dbang 'di dag thob pa'i dgos khyad ni/ dkyil 'khor mthong zhing dbang bskur thob// phung po bdag nyid smin par 'gyur// sdig pa thams cad rnam par spangs// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas thob bo// zhes gsungs zhing*/ de yang snod 'di lta bur rung ba'i dal ba brgyad dang*/ 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'i mi lus thob pa shin tu rnyed par dka'/ de yi nang nas kyang rdo rje theg pa'i snying po gsang ba bla na med pa'i lam du 'jug pa ni de bas kyang khyad par du 'phags shing rmad du byung ba ste/ de la yang tshe gcig byang chub kyi 'bras bu smin par nus pa'i mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor rtsa ba dang gzhi ma ltar lam dang lam gyi stegs su gyur pas de dag gi sgo nas smin grol gyi dbang bskur zab mo bgyid pa la thog mar bdag slob dpon tu 'os pa'i bya ba/

dkyil 'khor mchod cing bstod bskul bsnyen// 'jug sogs rang smin gzhan grol ston// zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi sbyor dngos rnams ji ltar bar grub cing*/ khyed rang skal ldan slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs par zhu ba'i don du dngos dang yid sprul gyis dmigs te maṇ+ḍal gnang bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob dpon gyis/ khyed rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub 'dod pa ni shin tu legs/ de yang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor chen pos khyed rnams kyi rgyud smin par byed pa la bdag bla mar 'os pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid bka' drin gyi sogs brjod du gzhug khyed rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can las nges par 'byung ba'i blos/ chos brgyad rnam g.yeng 'jig rten gyi 'du 'dzi spangs te thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'dod pa'i phyir mgon pos 'dren par gsol zhes rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi sdom pa rnams 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje rgyal po sogs brjod/ de nas sems bskyed pa'i phyir khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob dang don dam gyi mtshon byed zla ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsgom la 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta sogs/ de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen pos byin dbab pa'i phyir gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor gyi sogs brjod du gzhug nas byin 'bebs par bya'o// de ltar phabs pa'i ye shes de ngo sprad pa'i phyir rdo rje glu blang ba ni/ ltos shig sogs/ de ltar ye shes de nyid brtan par mos shig /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ de ltar ye shes dbab pa dang rgyas btab zin gyi/ de nas rigs pa'i dbang lnga bskur pa ni sdom 'byung las/ chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming gi dbang bskur te// dbang lnga de bzhin gshegs bdag nyid// ces gsungs pas dang po mi bskyod pa chu yi dbang*/

rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang*/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang*/ don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang*/ rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang ste rigs pa'i dbang lnga'o// de yang gzhi phung po lnga gdod ma nas rgyal ba rigs lngar bzhugs pa la/ de ltar ma rig pa'i gdul bya rnams la gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin ston pa ste/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces brjod la/ slob ma dbang rdzas sogs brjod/ chu dbang gi rjes su/ de dag ni thugs rdo rje'i dbang ngo*// dbu rgyan/ de dag ni yon tan gyi dbang ngo*// rdo rje/ de dag ni gsung rdo rje'i dbang ngo*// dril bu/ de dag ni phrin las kyi dbang ngo*// ming dbang*/ de dag ni sku rdo rje'i dbang ngo*// de ltar dbang bskur dug lnga'i sgrib pa dag sogs brjod/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpa' bo chen po sogs/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ byung sogs nas/ nyid du gyis bar brjod la/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ye shes rgyun gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ rdo rje chen po sogs/ de nas gsang dbang gi don du 'di'i rjes zlos/ mgon po sogs/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum bde ba chen pos bskul ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ rjes chags kyi byang sems zhu/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhir khyab par mos shig /de ltar sangs rgyas rnams sogs/ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi don du 'di'i rjes zlos/ he ru ka dpal sogs/ me long sin+dhu ra chos kyi 'byung gnas rdo rje btsun mo'i gsang ba nas 'phros pa'i shes rab ma spyin pa ni/ rdo rje snye ma sogs/ sems kyi sgrib dag sogs/ bzhi pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang gi don du rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje can sogs/ de yang dpe yi lhan skyes las don gyi ye shes mtshon par bya ste/

khyed rnams lus gnad dang ldan pa'i sems kyi rdo rje gang shar de yi ngo bo la mnyam par zhog cig /ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing sogs brjod/ don dam de bzhin nyid kyi sogs brjod/ de ltar rdo rje'i gsang ba chen pos dbang bskur rdzogs par grub pa yin gyi/ de yang de lta bu thob pa'i dgos khyad ni/ slob dpon a bhā yas/ sngar mi dbang ba la dbang bas dbang zhes bya ste/ dbul po'i sgyed pu gser du yod pa ngo shes pa lta bu'o zhes gsungs pa ltar dga' ba dang spro ba rgya chen po gyis la rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag gi man+ḍal dang*/ lus dang longs spyod ltos pa med par 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du sogs kyang brjod par bya'o// de nas ma dan dang ba la tshogs kyi yo byad gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dod yon rnams la dpa' bo'i dga' ston gyis rol par bya zhing*/ rnam par rtog pa med par nang gi sbyin sreg gi nges pas longs spyad/ de'i tshe rdo rje'i glu dang gar dang*/ ye shes kyi kun tu ru'i spyod pa sogs bya'o// de ltar khyab bdag rdo rje sems// he ru ka dpal bla ma yi// dkyil 'khor chen por smin byed kyi// dbang bskur ye shes rgyun bzang 'di// tshul 'dir mos pa'i skal pa can// sgrub chen maṅga'i ming can gyi// rnam dpyod blo gros pad tshal bzhad// gdul bya'i ra yig gnyis pa rnams// chos kyi zil mngar thob pa'i phyir// nyin mor byed pa'i dbang po yis// kun dga'i 'od stong spro bar byas// dge des skye dgu rgyal gyur cig /shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char 'bebs kyi zin bris rab gsal me long bzhugs// dpal ldan mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po de nyid kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor mdor bsdus zhig skal ba dang ldan pa'i chos skal du sbyin pa byin rlabs char 'bebs kyi zin tho zhig dgos zhes bya btang maṅga la'i ming can gyis rnam par dag pa'i blo yis bskul te/

des na tho tsam brjod par bya ste/ 'di nyid kyi sgrub pa dbang dang 'brel ba'i tshe lta bur spro na/ thog mar gdod nas rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas sa spyod dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas sam/ rgyal ba gong mas byin gyis brlabs shing zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas sam/ dben zhing nyams dga' la bsam gtan gyi tsher ma med pa'i sar gnas 'cha' zhing*/ sa gzhi byi dor dang*/ gtsang sbra gang che'i bshams bkod sogs byas la/ dmigs pa'i rten rje zhwa dmar pa'i sku brnyan 'dra zhal lam/ na rim gang yin gyi sku 'am ras bris bshams la stegs kyi khar lha mtshan maṇ+ḍal dbus dang phyogs bzhir 'bru dkar dri bzang sbags pa'i tshom bu bkod/ de steng mañji'i khar bum pa mgul chings kha rgyan dung chos gzungs rdor yang bshams/ bum pa'i sum gnyis chu gtsang gis bkang ba dang*/ bum rdzas nyer lnga dri bzang sogs btab/ de steng mañji'i rim gcig steng rab tu thod pa mtshan ldan/ min kyang skyon med kyi thod par chang dang*/ 'dzoms na rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi chos sman btab/ de yi khar me long sin+dhū ra byugs pa'i dbus su chos 'byung bsnol ma khug drug la dga' 'khyil g.yon bskor/ lte bar hrīḥ de mthar yig ngos nang bstan gyis/ oṃ badz+ra dh+rikra dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni sa ma ya ā be sha ya ā be sha ya a aḥzhes bris la dar dmar gyis dgab/ phyogs bzhir dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming dbang rnams dngos sam tsakli sogs gang bde bshams la mdun du mchod pa phreng tshar bshams/ nang mchod ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba thod rdzas dang bcas pa/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma lnga tshom tshogs dang*/ sha chang gzhan yang zas sna'i rigs dang*/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma'i bkod pa can dang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ ḍā dril/ spos snod/ yungs kar gu gul la sogs pa nyer mkho'i yo byad 'du bar bgyid la/ stan bde bar lus gnad gang bdes 'khod la/

rang nyid rtsa ba'i yi dam gang yin de gsal btab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams 'don sgom sbrags nas/ skyabs sems/ yan lag bdun pa/ tshad med bzhi sogs bsgom/ nang mchod bdud rtsi bsang sbyangs byin rlabs dang po nyin par bya/ sngon 'gro yang de bzhin/ byin rlabs nyin bstar chags dang*/ srung 'khor bar/ de nas mdun mkhar bla ma'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sogs gzhung tshig dang dmigs pa mthun par lha sku ngo bo gsal ba/ rnam pa stong pa/ 'ja' tshon lta bu/ gzhan yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ nye sras brgyad/ nyan thos gnas brtan sogs byang 'phags kyi sems dpa' rnams dang*/ gu ru pad+ma sogs rgya bod kyi rig 'dzin grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*/ bde dgyes gsang gsum sogs rgyud sde bzhi yi lha rab 'byams/ ye shes mgon po ber dang*/ lha mo/ dam can/ zhing skyong sogs chos skyong rgya mtshos bskor ba bar mtshams med par bzhugs pa/ bkra lam mer me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin gsal bar bskyed nas spyan 'dren sogs gzhung tshig ltar dmigs par bya'o// mdun bskyed thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul ba'i dbang lha spyan drangs sogs dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ bstod phyag rnams dkyus ltar bya'o// sngags 'khor gsal ltar hrīḥyi mdun nas yig drug ngo phyir bstan g.yon du bkod g.yas su bskor bzlas pa'i sngags dag cha dang bcas/ dang po rim bzhin gsal btab/ de nas bar med lta bur 'khor ba dang*/ de nas 'od kyi rigs drug gi zhing du phog /sdig sgrib sbyangs/ snang grag snod bcud lha yi ngo bor gsal bar bsam/ mtshan sngags kyang skabs su bzla'o// de ltar yig drug gtso bor ston pa ni gsung gi dbang phyug snang mtha' dang ngo bo gcig bzhin de yi dgos khyad bstan pa'o// de nas rgyang 'bod bya ba ni/ mi rtag skyo shas kyis blo bskul nas chos brgyad gnyis 'dzin la zhen pa ldog

/sems can rnams la snying rje dung nge ba bskyed nas grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar rjes su dran bzhin de yi rjes su slob pa'i mos 'dun gting nas skyes par byas la gdung ba'i dbyangs dang ldan pas snang ba 'gyur nges su bya'o// de ni mos gus sgom gyi mgo bo dang*/ zhen log sgom gyi rkang par gsungs bzhin mos gus dang dag snang snying rje dam tshig sogs lam chod byin rlabs 'jug phul che ba rgyal ba dag gi gsung las byung bas nan tar 'bad pas zung zhig de nas sdom gsum bshags sdom sogs kyang snying khung rus pa'i gting nas 'gyod pa dran bzhin du rtse gcig pas bya'o//de nas bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ dngos grub sprin phung du gsal ltar rnam rgyal bum pa skyed chog dang thugs kar zla steng hrīḥdamar mthar sngags phreng bkod pa mdun bskyed ltar sngags kyi dbye ba las gzhan du ma mchis/ 'di skabs rdor 'chang gtso bor ston pa ni gar dbang rdo rje 'chang nyid nges pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub pa'i rtsa ba mthar thug pa'o// de nas bdag 'jug dbang bzhi blang ba sogs gzhung du bkod pa ltar dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la rim pa bzhin bstim pa sogs 'don sgom dang bstun par gsal bar dmigs pa'o// des rang rgyud smin par byas nas gzhan skal pa dang ldan pa snying po'i bstan pa la 'jug pa'i slob ma byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa la rgyud byin gyis brlabs phyir smin byed bskur bar rung gi/ de yang bdag 'jug zin nas tshogs phul ba gtor bsngos mtshams slob ma rjes 'dzin bya la/ de min rgyud ma dul ba'i gti mug can rnams la ni gsang ba gdams pa mi bya'o// rjes kyi bya ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ spyan 'dren gtor bsngos tshogs rol lhag ma dang*/ mchod bstod rnams dkyus ltar 'don sgom dang*/ bsdu rim gsol gdab mi byed pa'i 'dun pa dang bcas/

bla ma'i zhal nas dngos su gdams pa'i don tshigs rkang bzhi lhang lhang gsungs bar mos la ma yengs par byas nas de yi don yid la chub par byas la/ mthar byin rlabs bsdu ba'i dbang ni/ skyabs yul thams cad gtso bor thim/ de yi spyi bo nas oṃ dkar po 'od zer dang bcas pa rang gi dpral bar thim/ sku yi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa gti mug dag /chos dbyings ye shes mngon du gyur/ de yi rigs 'gres kyi/ āḥdamar po/ mgrin par thim/ gsung gi dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag /sor rtog ye shes thob/ hūm̐ sngon po snying gar thim/ thugs dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag /me long ye shes thob/ swā ser po lte bar thim/ yon tan dbang thob/ nga rgyal dag mnyam nyid ye shes thob/ hā ljang gu gsang bar thim/ phrin dbang thob/ phrag dog dag /bya grub ye shes thob par mos la mthar bla ma 'od du zhu rang nyid dang dbyer med chu la chu bzhag pa ltar gyur par mos la sems kyi gnas lugs skyong*/ bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis sogs bya'o//

de ni cung zad rgyas pa spro ba yin gyi/ de las khyer bde ba'i rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dbye ba ni byin rlabs char 'bebs kyi mthar gsal lo// de ltar 'jug pa de'i zin bris tho tsam zhig bkod pa dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig// / ༈ swasti/ 'dir bla ma mchod pa mdor bsdus zhig spro na/ dang po skyabs sems/ mkha' khyab dngos kun bdag nyid can// bde chen ye shes thugs rje'i 'phrul// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// bdag sogs 'gro kun skyabs su mchi// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// de nas mchod rdzas rnams a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las rlung me thod sgyed steng*// thod pa mtshan ldan ka pā lar// sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lnga po// sa bon dang bcas gsal ba las// 'od 'phros ye shes bdud rtsi bkug /dam ye dbyer med mchod sprin spel// oṃ ā hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs nas/ gnas 'og min nges pa lnga ldan zhing*// 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// rgyal ba dang rgya mtsho'i gtso bo mchog /dpal sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon// rje blo gros rin chen dam pa dang*// bka' babs kyi chos bdag grub pa'i dbang*// nges don gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i phreng*// sras slob dang gdan rabs brgyud par bcas// thugs chos dbyings klong nas 'dir dgongs la// tshogs mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// byin rlabs kyi sprin phung thibs se thib// dngos grub kyi char rgyun sha ra ra// bdag mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol// 'dir bshams kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i rdzas// sha lnga dang bdud rtsi rnam lnga yi// 'od zer las kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// rab 'byams zhing yongs bkang blos blangs te// dad mos pas 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol// gā ṇa tsakra pañca a mṛ ta sarba pū dza khā hi/

ces 'bul la/ de ltar tshogs kyi 'khor lo yi// mchod pa zab mo phul ba'i mthus// bdag gzhan tshogs gsum yongs rdzogs nas// gdod nas lhan skyes rang byung gi// mtha' bral bla med snying po'i don// mngon gyur rdo rje 'chang thob shog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas// de 'dzin phrin las 'gro don 'phel// sngon byon rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed 'od// gang 'dir gsal ba'i bkra shis kyis// rnam kun don gnyis yongs grub shog / ces pa'ang karma sbyin pa'i ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ drung rma se blo gros rin chen bla sgrub dang rjes 'brel tshogs mchod 'bul bar spro na/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams/ oṃ khan+ḍa ro he sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ hrīḥ bde chen dbyings kyi kā pa lar// 'bru gsum 'od zhu'i thabs shes kyi// 'chi med ra sa ya na ste// tshogs kyi 'khor lor byin brlabs gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ bde gsal chos dbyings zhing khams nas// bde gshegs kun 'dus he ru ka /bde chen drwa ba sdom pa nyid// bde stong tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs// chos dbyings lhun rdzogs klong yangs nas// longs spyod rdzogs pa he ru ka /grub mchog tai lo 'gro ba'i mgon// rang gsal tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs// kun khyab thugs rje'i gnas mchog nas// dmigs med snying rje'i gar rol pa// grub brnyes ma ti rat+na'i mtshan// shar grol tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs// gzhan yang thabs dang shes rab kyi// snang cha las shar dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyang*// bde chen tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs// bag dro bkod legs tshogs khang 'dir// dur khrod gnas su byin gyis rlobs// 'dir tshogs mos pa'i bu slob rnams// dpa' bo ḍā kir byin gyis rlobs// thabs shes tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// ma dag phung lnga khams lnga rnams// ye shes lnga yi klong du bzhes// ye nas gnas pa'i chos sku la// rang ngo shes bzhin so mar bzhag

/re dogs gnyis 'dzin las grol ba'i// tshogs mchod dam pa dang re spro// rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i lha tshogs kyi// thugs dam dbyings su bskang ba dang*// kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i nyams chag rnams// ye dag kun bzang dbyings su bshags// nyag gcig chos sku'i rang zhal la// 'dzin rtog spros pas sgrib gyur pa// spros bral bde chen klong yangs su// rang gsal rang grol ngang du zlog /kun khyab dbyings kyi mkha' klong du// sgrib byed dri ma gang mchis kun// skye 'gags gnas med chen po ru// lhag med chos sku mngon mthong nas// 'khrul grol mtshan ma rnam dag pa'i// chos dbyings mchog gi bkra shis shog / ces don dam tshogs kyi mchod pa tshig don mthun pa'i sgo nas 'bul zhing de nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi blang bar bya'o// zhes si tu pas dbon karma bstan pa'i bzhed ngor spel ba dza yan+tu/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub yongs 'du bzhugs so// swa sti/ 'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod kyi rim pa khyer bder byed pa spro na/ yo byad mchod rdzas rnams 'du bgyis la rang lhar gsal ba'i ngang nas/ amṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las a yig yongs gyur thod pa'i snod// rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ yig tshogs 'od zhu// de las mchod pa'i bye brag phyi nang rdzas// 'dod yon zag med mchod sprin rgya mtshor spel// a kā ro sa lan gsum byin brlabs/ rang mdun nam mkhar gyad dang seng ge bzhis// btegs pa'i rin chen khri steng pad+ma dkar// 'dab stong ge sar rab rgyas nyi zla'i dbus// hrīḥyig 'od kyis don gnyis byas yongs gyur// dpal ldan bla ma chos skyong 'gyur med mchog /dkar gsal zhi 'dzum spyan gnyis lta stangs gzigs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'khyud stabs 'dzin// dbu la sgom zhu dang ni zhabs skyil krung*// chos gos rnam gsum na bzas mdzes par bklubs// gnas gsum 'bru gsum yi ges mtshan par gyur// 'ja' zer 'od skud 'khrugs pa'i klong du gsal// gsol btab tsam gyis bzod med gdung shugs 'bar// 'bar tsam nyid nas byin rlabs thugs rje myur// myur ba'i stobs kyis mchog dang thun mong gi// dngos grub sprin 'khrigs char rgyun sha ra ra// steng 'og bar mtshams bka' brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// kun kyang skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i ngo bor gsal// gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams nas// rtsa gsum lha tshogs spyan drangs dam tshig dang*// ye shes dbyer med dbang lhas dbang bskur zhing*// rigs bdag rdor sems rgyas gdab mchod pa'i tshogs// nam mkha' gang bas dgyes bskyed mchod par gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/

pād+yaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ thugs kar zla steng hrīḥdakar po'i// mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba las// 'od 'phros rgyal mchod 'gro don byas// tshur 'dus 'phags pa'i thugs rje dang*// byin rlabs bdag rgyud la smin nas// sgo gsum rdo rje gsum brnyes gyur// oṃ āḥdharma pā la ak+ṣa ra hūm̐/ zhes bzlas la/ tshogs 'khor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las rlung me thod sgyed steng*// a las ye shes ka pā lar// sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba// sbyang rtogs sbar ba'i nus pa yi// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can// thabs shes gnyis med mchod pa'i sprin// rab 'byams mtha' yas kun khyab pa'i// 'dod yon tshogs kyi 'khor lor gyur// de nas spyan drangs pa ni/ gnas bde chen 'og min gzhal yas nas// pha bka' brgyud bla ma tshogs la byon// gnas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo nas// rje chos skyong 'gyur med tshogs la byon// gnas dag pa mkha' spyod zhing khams nas// lha yi dam ḍā ki tshogs la byon// gnas bka' gsang dam tshig dkyil 'khor nas// chos skyong ba'i srung ma tshogs la byon// phyi nang gi dngos po'i gzung 'dzin kun// ye shes kyi rol pa chen por bsgyur// 'dod yon tshogs bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin spel// rnal 'byor rnams zag med bde stong gi// ting 'dzin gyi rtsal skyed mchog thun mong*// dngos grub kyi char chen dus 'dir stsol// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ zhes spyan drangs shing tshogs phud phul la/ rnal 'byor rnams kyang rol nas/ lhag ma a ka ro sa byin brlabs nas/ phud lhag bshal chur dbang ba'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// kun kyang 'dir spyon gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bstan pa srung dang rnal 'byor skyong ba sogs// gang bcol phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrubs//

zhes pas phul/ de nas rjes rim byin rlabs bsdu ba ni/ bla ma'i gsang gsum ye shes rdo rje bzhi'i// byin rlabs ngo bo 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros// rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob// sgrib bzhi dag nas sku bzhi mngon du gyur// skyabs yul thams cad dkyil 'khor gtso bor bsdus// de nyid dgyes pa dang bcas 'od zhu nas// rang thim dbyer med chos dbyings gnyug ma'i gshis// dus gsum spros pa bral ba'i ngang du bzhag / ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag la/ dge ba 'di yis sogs dang*/ bsngo smon dang bcas brjod/ ces dbon po bla ma karma bstan pa tshe ring gi dgyes skong phyir/ si tu pas spel ba sarba dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ gu ru sarba yo ga ma hā su kha dz+nyā na bi ha ra tisma/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis snang srid kyi chos thams cad stong par sbyangs nas/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma bsgom pa ni/ bdag nyid tha mal bde chen 'khor lo ru// pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du rgyal kun gyi// gsang gsum ye shes gcig bsdus rdo rje 'chang*// dran mchog mgon po chos skyong 'gyur ba med// sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pas skyabs sbyin g.yon pas tshe bum bsnams// rdo rje skyil krung chos gos rnam gsum bklubs// zab zhi spro bral ting 'dzin ngang nyid las// smin grol dam chos bdud rtsi'i sgra dbyangs sgrog /mchog thun las bzhi'i dngos grub sprin phung g.yo// dkon mchog 'dus pa'i ngo bor khyed shes kyi// mos blos yar gzhal ma yin bcos min gyi// dad gsum blo yis rab btud gus 'dud nas// phyag 'tshal mchod bshags yi rang bskul gsol 'debs// dge tshogs 'gro kun byang chub chen por bsngo// skyabs kun 'dus bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon// rigs dkyil 'khor khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin// drin chen rje chos skyong 'gyur med mkhyen// skal ldan bdag rjes 'dzin byin gyis rlobs//

tshar kha shas mos gus dang ldan pas snang ba 'gyur nges su bton/ mthar/ spyi bo'i bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// dbang bzhi thob cing sgo gsum sgrib dag nas// bla ma chos sku'i rang zhal legs mthong zhing*// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid chen por dbang bsgyur shog /dge des bdag sogs rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog / ces sgrub pa theg 'phel gyis shel dkar mā la/ bal tram bcas phul nas bskul ngor si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel/// / ༈ rang lus tha mal mdun mkhar dbus// 'od kyi thig le 'khyil pa'i dbus// rin chen seng khri dar zab steng*// gar dbang chos skyong 'gyur ba med// zhi 'dzum chos gos rnam gsum ldan// bkra gsal lham me de'i spyi bor// dri med pad+ma dkar po ni// 'dab stong rgyas steng rig pa 'dzin// rdo rje drag po zhi ma khro// pad zhwa phod kha rin chen brgyan// phyag gnyis rdo rje phur sdig 'dzin// rol stabs kyis bzhugs lham me ba// dus gsum rgyal ba kun spyi dpal// pad+ma 'byung gnas dbyer med pa'i// drin chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// bde chen ye shes don rtogs shog /drag rtsal 'od zhu bla mar thim// de nyid rang lus la thim pas// dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs sgrib bzhi dag /sku bzhi mngon du gyur par bsam// dar gcig ci gnas mnyam par bzhag / ces rjes bsngo ba bya'o// de ltar dbon po karma bstan pa'i ngor si tus dpal spungs yang dben du bris pa maṅga lam/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis yongs 'du dngos grub mchog stsol bzhugs/ na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra ya/ 'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor khyer bder bkod pa la/ de yang tshogs dang mchod pa 'brel pa phan yon byin rlabs kyi tshan kha lhag par thob pa ste/ rim lnga las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsams// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// ces gsungs pa ltar/

rten gyi drung du/ mchod pa'i bye brag thams cad 'du bgyis la/ bde ba'i stan la 'khod nas/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ na mo/ dus gsum ston mchog chags bral dam pa'i chos// rig grol tshogs dang rtsa gsum rab 'byams lha// kun 'dus dbyer med bla mar skyabs su mchi// 'gro rnams byang chub thob par sems bskyed do// lan gsum dang*/ gnyis pa mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ las rin chen snod rnams su// hūm̐ yig 'od zhu lha yi rdzas// rdo rje'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho// kun bzang smon lam ji bzhin gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā// de bzhin/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang*/ gsum pa rang lhar gsal ba'i mdun mkhar bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun mkhar 'od lnga'i klong*// bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal med khang chen po// gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs// de dbus gyad dang seng chen bzhis btegs khrir// lha mi'i dpal 'byor bkod legs phun tshogs steng*// pam̐ las pad dkar 'dab stong ge sar rgyas// a las nya gang chu shel dbang pos mtshan// de steng rgyal kun gsung gi ngo bo hrīḥ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis sbyang*// tshur 'dus yongs gyur 'jig rten dbang phyug mgon// sa ra ha yi rnam rol sprul pa'i sku// dpal ldan grub mchog dge legs rab rgyas ni// bde chen gzi byin rab 'bar brjid bag can// zhal gcig zhal 'dzum dbu la sgom zhu gsol// spyan zung lta stangs chos nyid dbyings la gzigs// phyag gnyis ḍā dril grag stong sgra sgrog cing*// le brgan dar gyi chos gos rnam gsum dang*// za 'og ber chen zlum 'khyil lhab ma lhub// zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung dang bcas bzhugs// ye shes rang 'od 'phro ba'i klong du gsal// dpral mgrin thugs kar 'bru gsum mtshan par gyur// gzhan yang steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar med du// bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong la sogs skyabs yul rnams// sprin phung gtibs bzhin gsal stong 'dzin med pa// rnam dag dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun gyis rdzogs// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros po ṭa la// bde ldan zhing dang dpal gyi ri bo nas// 'gro ba'i don du snying rjes brtser dgongs la// 'khor bcas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī mān gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ

bzhi pa byin 'bebs cing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ skye med spros bral klong yangs nas// rgyal ba rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i dbus// spyan ras gzigs dbang sku bskyod 'tshal// dbang bzhi bskur la byin chen phob// rang byung thugs rje'i rol pa las// brtul zhugs spyod pa 'chang rnams dang*// bram ze chen po 'dir gshegs la// smin cing grol ba'i byin chen phob// 'gro ba'i don du gzugs skur bstan// rig 'dzin rnal 'byor 'khor tshogs bcas// grub mchog bla ma gnas 'dir byon// dbang bskur byin rlabs dngos grub stsol// dz+nyā na badz+ra ā we sha ya ā we sha ya a aḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes dam ye dbyer med du mos la/ lnga pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ slar yang thugs las 'od 'phros te// rang bzhin gnas nas dbang gi lha// spyan drangs dbang bskur khrus gsol nas// rigs bdag snang mthas dbu brgyan gyur// drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dri med rnam dag rab dkar mos pa'i blos// drangs pa'i legs byas rang gzugs lha lam khyon// dog por gyur pa'i rdo rje'i mchod pa'i sprin// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang*/ gzhan yang lha mi'i bdog pa mchis so cog /yid sprul dngos 'byor longs spyod dpag med rnams// maṇ+ḍal gcig tu bsdus nas 'bul lags na// bzhes nas bla med grub gnyis stsal du gsol// gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ bdun pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed thugs kar zla steng hrīḥmathar sngags// 'khor ba'i 'od kyis rgyal mchod dngos grub thob// 'gro drug sgrib sbyang kun kyang ye shes kyi// rol pa chen po'i rang bzhin nyid du gyur// oṃ āḥsid+dha pa ra ma swa sti hūm̐/ ces mtshan sngags ci 'grub bzlas la/ brgyad pa tshogs gnyis spel phyir dpa' bo'i dga' ston ni/

amṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod sgyed steng*// a las mtshan ldan bde skyong ka pā la// yangs shing rgya che'i nang du sha lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga po sa bon mtshan pa las// 'od 'phros dam ye gnyis med rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ ā hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum byin brlabs la/ gnas gru 'dzin po ṭa la zhing dang*// bde ba can dpal ri pad 'od sogs// rang bzhin gyi dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// lha nor bu pad+ma can nyid dang*// dbyer med pa'i mda' bsnun chen po mchog /sku rnam 'phrul gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin// gang mi mngon ye shes klong yangs nas// thugs bde stong dbyings nas dgongs mdzod la// deng skal ldan rdo rje'i dam tshig can// dad mos kyis mchod pa'i zhing 'di ru// rgyal ba dang rgyal sras thu bo rnams// rtsa gsum lha sprin ltar 'dus pa'i dbus// gnas 'dir spyon tshogs la gshegs su gsol// bla med kyi mchod pa'i khyad par mchog /thabs shes rab gnyis med tshogs 'khor lo// bdag gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes// mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ ces tshogs phud phul nas sgrub po rnams kyang dngos grub la rol nas/ dgu pa lhag ma ni/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' gter srung ma gnyan// mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro la sogs sprul 'khor rnams// phud dang lhag ma'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// bstan skyong rnal 'byor bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzod// uts+tshiṭa ba ling+ta khā hi/ de nas bcu pa nongs bshags ni/ kyai/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma mchog /dkyil 'khor khyab bdag he ru ka /'khor bcas deng 'dir dgongs su gsol// mi shes rmongs par gyur pa yis// sdom gsum 'gal nyams ci mchis rnams// mthol bshags mi sgrib tshangs par stsol// yi ge brgya pa brjod/

bcu gcig pa byin rlabs bsdu ba ni/ skyabs yul kun kyang rim bzhin 'od zer gyi// rnam par gtso mchog dpal ldan bla mar thim// de yang dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs dang bcas te// byin rlabs dbang gi dgongs gtad mod nyid las// rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs dang ye shes bzhi'i// ngo bo 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang 'phros// rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas sgrib bzhi dag /dbang bzhi mchog thob sku bzhi mngon du gyur// bla ma 'od zhu rang dang dbyer med ngang*// gsal stong 'dzin bral ma bcos mnyam par bzhag / dar gcig mi rtog pa'i ngang du bzhag la/ slar yang rig rtsal lha yi rol par gsal// bcu gnyis pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'dir 'bad dge ba dang*// dus gsum zag bcas zag med legs byas bcas// rmad byung smon lam zab mos mtshams sbyar mthus// bdag gzhan tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog / bcu gsum pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ rgyal kun yongs 'du bkra shis rgya mtsho'i klong*// don gnyis 'bras ster dgos 'byung yid bzhin dbang*// srid zhi'i gdung sel 'bad med 'dod dgu'i char// phan bde'i dpyid du 'bab pa'i bkra shis shog / de ltar don tshan bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa yi grangs ldan zab mo'i rnal 'byor 'di dag zur mang bla ma bstan 'dzin pa de nyid zag med thugs kyi dgongs pa bde chen chos dbyings klong du bskang ba'i phyir/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba 'gro rnams zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge'o// maṅga lam/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes gzi 'bar byin rlabs mchog stsol bzhugs/ swasti/ gcod yul grub brnyes bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod kyi rim pa spro na/ mchod rdzas rnams 'du bgyid la/ rang lhar gsal ba'i ngang nas/ swa bhā wa sa dngos 'dzin gyi chos thams cad stong par sbyangs la/

stong las mdun mkhar 'od lnga'i thig le'i klong*// pad dkar zla steng hrīḥyig yongs gyur las// rgyal dbang karma'i phrin las rang gzugs rtsal// yongs grub gu ru dz+nyā na bgres nyams can// dbu la sgom zhu phyag gnyis chos 'chad rgya// chos gos rnam gsum zhabs gnyis rdor skyil bzhugs// chos dbyings skye med ngang la lta stangs can// gsol btab tsam gyis byin rlabs char rgyun 'bebs// 'bebs tsam nyid nas mos gus myu gu skye// skyes pa'i mod la brjod med ye shes 'char// gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od kyis 'og min zhing*// dag pa mkha' spyod gnas nas o rgyan rje// bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho'i 'khor tshogs bcas// spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med nyid du gsal// thugs las 'od 'phros dbang lhas dbang bskur nas// 'dod yon lha mos phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul// thugs kar zla steng hrīḥmathar sngags kyis bskor// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs gyur// oṃ āḥgu ru dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes gang 'grub bzlas la/ bsdus ba ni dbang bzhi len par 'jug /spro na tshogs kyi mchod pa dpa' bo'i dga' ston ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros tshogs rdzas kyi// gzung 'dzin kun rtog bag chags sbyangs// dag pa ye shes bdud rtsir spel// rgya chen rgyun mi chad par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ gnas mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od kyi zhing*// lha zhi khro rab 'byams 'dus pa'i dbus// rgyal yongs kyi spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung*// dbyer med kyi rje btsun karma ka /gnas 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// rgyud smin grol mchog thun dngos grub stsol// gnas rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i zhing*// dngos snang srid lha yi dkyil 'khor dbus// bka' brgyud pa'i grub thob rgya mtsho dang*// gcod yul gyi gu ru dz+nyā na mchog

/gnas 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// rgyud smin grol mchog thun dngos grub stsol// gnas thabs shes bde stong dbyer med zhing*// rgyud sde bzhir 'brel ba'i yi dam dang*// ma gnas gsum dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs// legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin g.yar dam can// gnas 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// rgyud smin grol mchog thun dngos grub stsol// bka' gsang dang dam tshig gnyan po'i zhing*// chos skyong ba'i ma hā kā la dang*// dpal lha mo ye shes las 'jig rten// dregs can gyi srung ma dam can rnams// gnas 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// phrin las kyi sdong grogs ma g.yel mdzod// phyi snod kyi gzhal yas khang byin rlobs// nang bcud kyi mchod rdzas bdud rtsir bsgyur// bdag rgyud la zag med ye shes kyi// bde stong gi ting 'dzin bskyed du gsol// ga ṇa tsakra pañca amṛ ta khā hi/ ces pas phul/ ho/ thog med nas da lta'i lus 'di bar// rtsa ba dang yan lag dam nyams pa// 'dod yon tshogs mchod pas bskang zhing bshags// bshags bya dang bshags byed gnyis med par// rang rig pa rang byung ka dag klong*// blo 'das kyi mnyam nyid chen por bshags// oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya brjod/ tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐/ bka' yi lhag gtor dbang ba yi// ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs phud lhag bshal chu bzhes// bstan pa srung dang rnal 'byor skyong*// dam tshig rjes gcod mel tshe dang*// nad yams dal kha bsgyur du gsol// u3lt;?>ྀ ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi/ rjes rim byin rlabs bsdu ba ni/ mdun bskyed bla ma'i sku yi gnas bzhi nas// 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang 'phros pa las// rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob// sgrib bzhi dag nas sku bzhi mngon du gyur// de nyid dgyes pa dang bcas 'od zhu nas// rang thim dbyer med bde chen ngang du bzhag

/ ces ma bcos so ma'i ngang du ci gnas su ngo bo bskyangs la/ dge des bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// kun bzang rdor 'chang go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa'ang dad dam tshul ldan dbu mdzad karma dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba dge/ sarba maṅga lam/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur sher phyin ma// stan pa'i mnga' bdag bcom ldan shākya thub// smra ba'i seng ge 'phags ma sgrol dkar yum// gsol 'debs dngos grub gnyis rtsol bdag byin rlobs// su kha sid+dhi ār+ya de wa dang*// pha cig dam pa ma cig lab kyi sgron// kham bu ya le dz+nyā na dz+wa la rje// gsol 'debs= /gnam mtsho dol ba rang byung rgyal ba'i zhabs// seng ge dpal ba dbang rdor rin chen shrī// byams pa dpal dang 'od zer bla ma la// gsol 'debs= /sangs rgyas rin chen kun dga' rnam par rgyal// karma bstan skyong 'gyur med snying po'i sde// dkon mchog bstan 'dzin bstan pa rnam rgyal la// gsol 'debs= karma rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtsho dang*// dran mchog dwangs ma'i mgon po thams cad mkhyen// bstan pa'i nyin byed rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol 'debs= snang srid chos kun sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la// blo 'das mi rtog ye shes 'od gsal che'i// gnas lugs ji bzhin 'khrul med gdeng thob nas// kun bzang khyab brdal dbyings su grol gyur cig / ces karma dar rgyas ngor spel/// / ༈ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i bla sgrub bzhugs/ rang nyid lhar gsal spyi bor 'od lnga'i klong*// pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du hrīḥyig las// 'od 'phros don gnyis byas nas he ru ka /rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu zhi ma khro// spyan gsum lta stangs dbu la pad zhu gsol// phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas ka pā la// bdud rtsis bkang dbus tshe bum shing los brgyan// me ga li ljang bla gos ngur smrig bklubs// zhabs gnyis rol stabs bde chen ye shes kyi// rang 'od rab 'bar gzi byin ldan par gsal// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs kar hrīḥmathar sngags// de las 'od 'phros 'phags mchod byin rlabs bsdus// rang gzhan sgrib sbyong snod bcud snang srid kun// bla ma'i dkyil 'khor ngo bor lhun gyis grub// oṃ āḥ.ā yuḥ.in+d+ra ma ṇi hūm̐/

ci nus bzlas la/ skyabs yul sku las 'od 'phros dbang bzhi thob// sgrib bzhi dag nas sku bzhi mngon du gyur// bla ma rang thim dbyer med ma bcos ngang*// spros bral bde ba chen po'i klong du bzhag / ces pa'ang rje drung mchog sprul rin po karma chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi bzhed ltar si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba sarba dza ga taṃ/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab lam mthar thug mchog dngos bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bzhugs/ na mo gu ru pra wā ka ra ye/ 'dir lung zin skyes mchog rig 'dzin bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i tshogs skong spro ba dag gis tshogs gnyis spel phyir mchod pa rnams gang 'byor 'du bar byas la/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ rnying lugs ltar gyi skyabs sems spyi mthun sngon du 'gro bas/ shūn+ya ta 'i sngags kyis gzung 'dzin chos rnams stong par sbyangs nas/ stong las mdun mkhar 'ja' tshon lnga ldan gyi// thig le thig phran 'od dang 'od zer 'phro// de dbus sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// bud+dha thod phreng ngo bor yongs grub pa// rnam pa thugs kyi rig 'dzin 'khor los sgyur// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs spyod pa 'chang*// karma rnam rgyal rdo rje rab brtan rtsal// zhal gcig g.yu ral lcang lo sprin ltar gtibs// spyan gnyis lta stangs don dam chos nyid gzigs// dbang zhu pad+ma mthong grol cod pan gsol// phyag g.yas cang te'u g.yon pas thod chang 'dzin// shes rab snyems tshul kha ṭāṃ gru mor bcug /rab brjid sku ni ri rgyal lhun po bzhin// mdo sngags gnyis ldan cha lugs yongs rdzogs pa'i// phod ka stag sham chos gos zab ber bklubs// zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stangs stabs kyis// snang srid zil gnon gar nyams dgu dang ldan// gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing mtshan// rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor ye nas grub// gnam sa bar snang chu 'dzin phreng bres dbus// bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam dpa' bo dang*// rnal 'byor ma tshogs ḍā ki chos srung rnams// bu yug 'tshubs bzhin byin rlabs char rgyun 'bebs// kun kyang gsal stong 'dzin med lham mer gsal// e ma ho/

kun khyab spros bral ye shes lnga klong du// longs spyod yongs rdzogs gang 'dul sprul par shar// skal ldan rjes 'dzin skal med tshar gcod 'dren// phrin las bzhi rdzogs mthu stobs dbang phyug mkhyen// chos dang mthun pa'i bsam don yid bzhin 'grub// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel byin rlobs// de ltar lan gsum mam lnga bdun brjod la/ thugs ka'i sa bon mthar sngags phreng*// spro sdus pad+ma 'od zhing nas// o rgyan rje 'bangs 'khor tshogs bcas// bdag mdun la thim dbyer med ngang*// ye shes rdo rje'i go 'phang mchog /dngos grub rgyun smin grol thob gyur// oṃ āḥbi dza ya badz+ra hūm̐/ gang 'grub bzlas la mchod tshogs byin rlabs ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod tshogs rnam dag bde chen gyur// gdod nas lhun rdzogs grub pa'i gnas// o rgyan rang byung dur khrod che// tshogs khang gzhal yas byin re chags// bla med phyi nang gsang mchod rdzas// tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po// ye shes bdud rtsi'i zer ma las// 'dod yon lha mos gar bsgyur zhing*// zag med 'dod dgu'i longs spyod spel// nam mkha' mdzod bzhin dang re spro// grub pa'i rnal 'byor mched rnams kyang*// lta spyod tshul ldan dam re gtsang*// dngos su 'byor dang yid sprul pa// kun bzang rnam thar 'byams klas bzhin// snang srid 'khor 'das yongs bkang nas// phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi// mchod sprin rab 'byams rgya mtsho 'dis// rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// lung zin skyes mchog rdo rje 'dzin// sgrub pa'i srol gtod bstan pa skyong*// zab gter mnga' bdag rig sngags 'chang*// theg mchog 'od gsal a ti'i chos// 'gro rgyud mun sel lam bzang ston// rnam rgyal rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*// gzhan yang bka' babs chos kyi bdag /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// bka' nyan gter bdag chos srung rnams// bskang ngo bskal pa thugs dam bskang*// g.yar dam gnyan po bskang gyur nas// dbang dang dngos grub stsol byin rlobs// bdag ni nyon mongs dug lnga yi// sgrib pas ma rig dbang gis ni// dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul sogs// nongs gyur thams cad gnong 'gyod bshags// chos kun ye nas mnyam nyid ngang*// bskang dang bshags bya brjod las 'das// ma bcos rang byung lhun grub rtsal// don dam ka dag dbyings su bskang*// 'khor gsum dmigs med mtha' bral klong*// kun bzang rol par sor chud shog

ces tshogs kyi mchod pas bskangs nas/ dngos grub kyi rdzas la rol zhing*/ lhag ma btang ba/ sngags kyi bka' srung dam tshig can// ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro sogs// lhag gtor bzhes la bcol pa'i las// ma g.yel ma 'da' phrin las mdzod// ces 'bul/ de nas rjes rim byin rlabs bsdu ba ni/ na mo gu ru/ spros bral chos dbyings nam mkha' yangs pa las// bde ba chen po mi phyed rdo rje'i bdag /e waṃ zung 'jug mtshor 'khrungs pad+ma skyes// rigs kun khyab bdag mgon der gsol ba 'debs// lnga brgya tha mar snyigs dus sems can rnams// nyon mongs rags pa'i mi bsrun 'chol spyod ngor// rgyal rnams phrin las 'jug sgo'i gnas dben kyang*// o rgyan thugs bskyed lhag par rjes skyong ba'i/ sprul dang yang sprul gar bsgyur rnam rol ni// sna tshogs bkod pa cir yang 'char ba las// gang 'dir sngags rig grub pa'i spyod 'chang tshul// bla med gsang mchog ston der gsol ba 'debs// mi phyed 'dun dang dam tshig rnam dag gi/ gzhi brtan mos gus ltem rkyang bral ba'i ngang*// bcos min gsol 'debs bdag la brtser dgongs kyai// dbang bzhi bskur zhing rgyud bzhi smin par mdzod// lam bzhi 'byongs nas sku bzhi thob byin rlobs// de nas skyed pa'i dkyil 'khor rang la thim// blo 'das byar med kun bzang gnyug ma'i gshis// khyab gdal klong yangs skye med sa ma dhi// a a āḥ de'i ngang du gnas lugs kyi ngo bo skyong*/ mthar bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs dkyus mthun gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// de ltar ka nyin lung chos grwa'i sgrub sde'i spong ba pa sbas pa'i rnal 'byor snying po'i don la gzhol ba bla ma karma 'phags mchog dang 'phel rgyas mched kyi bzhed ltar/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa 'gro rnams kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen pad 'byung gi go 'phang la 'god par gyur cig

/dge'o// bkra shis/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bde chen mchog stsol bzhugs/ mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma la// bdag sogs 'di nas byang chub bar// skyabs gsol 'gro kun bde gyur ldan// sdug bsngal dang bral sangs rgyas shog /swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las phyi nang mchod pa'i rdzas// rgya chen rgyun mi chad pa yi// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyi// zag med bde chen dgyes skyed gyur// a kā ro sa byin brlabs nas/ bdag nyid lhar gsal mdun gyi mkha' dbyings su// rin chen gzhal yas gru bzhi mu khyud rdzogs// dbus su pad+ma phyogs mdog 'dab bzhir ldan// ge sar dbus su chos dbyings ye shes kyi// ngo bo he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rdo rje gtsug lag dga' ba'i rdo rje 'chang*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis ḍā dril zhabs rol stabs// phod ka chos gos pad zhwa rus rgyan spras// shar gyi 'dab mar me long ye shes kyi// ngo bo rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog /h+ya ghṛ wa na thā lam mer gsal// lho yi 'dab mar mnyam nyid ye shes kyi// ngo bo khrag 'thung dpal chen rdo rje 'dzin// shrī tsit+ta badz+ra lam mer gsal// nub kyi 'dab mar sor rtog ye shes kyi// ngo bo gsang sngags grub pa'i skyes bu mchog /rje btsun pad+ma kun nas rab tu gsal// byang gi 'dab mar bya grub ye shes kyi// ngo bo mngon spyod phrin las sna tshogs la// dbang bsgyur tshe dbang 'chi med dpal dar gsal// rgyan dang cha lugs phyag mtshan gtso bo ltar// 'od dang 'od zer 'bar ba'i klong du gsal// de ltar so so'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas// 'og min dag pa mkha' spyod zhing khams nas// bsgom pa dang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs te// mtsho la char bzhin dbyer med ro gcig gyur// zhes spyan drangs te mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ ho phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon rdzas// tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ldan gyi// longs spyod zad med 'di dag kun// mchod yul dam pa'i lha tshogs mchod// bzhes shig rol cig pū dza ho// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun// dug gsum dug lnga'i dbang gyur pa'i// rtsa ba yan lag nyams pa bshags// rang rig ka dag don rtogs nas// ye shes sku lnga mchog thob cing*// gnyis 'dzin log rtog g.yul rgyal te// dam pa'i go 'phang reg gyur cig

/bkra shis dge legs yongs 'du'i ljon// 'bad med lhun grub dpal thob nas// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog /srid pa'i rtse mor mtho gyur cig / ces pa'ang bla ma phrin las rab rgyas kyi bzhed ltar/ si tus spel ba maṅga lam/// / ༈ snang srid ye dag bde chen pad 'od zhing*// rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor 'khor lo'i mgon// ngo bo pad 'byung rnam pa dpal 'brug pa// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mtshan dpe mthong grol sku// thos dang dran reg ye shes mngon gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog kun 'dus pa// dran mchog dwangs ma'i mgon gyur skyabs gnas rje// dus 'dir dran no ci mdzad khyed shes kyi// bcos min mos gus ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// rje btsun khyed bzhin bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de nas gsol 'debs dang*/ mchod pa/ bkra shis sogs zhal bsgyur 'di'ang 'don/ bde chen 'gyur med 'od gsal kun khyab klong*// rang byung ye shes lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs// rigs dkyil 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang*// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// lan gsum mam bdun/ mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ āḥshā sa na dh+wa dza hūm̐/ ci nus bzla zhing*/ dpal ldan 'brug pa mkhyen/ dad pa'i blo yis gang grub dang*/ mthar ni/ byin rlabs dbang bzhis smin cing grol ba yi// mi 'gyur zag med bde stong phyag rgya che// rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin chos kyi sku// mngon byang chub pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis dad ldan se bo 'tsho byed karma bkra shis ngor bkod pa'o// dza yan+tu/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor yid bzhin re skong thar 'dod gru rdzing zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ra we/ 'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i tshogs bskang bshags pa'i rim pa spro na 'di lta ste/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ rgyal ba rab 'byams kun 'dus pa'i// bla med ston pa rdo rje 'dzin// dkyil 'khor gtso mchog dam pa la// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can rnams// rnam grol thar mchog la 'god phyir// deng nas sangs rgyas thob kyi bar// bdag gis bla ma bsgrub par bgyi//

de nas mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las mchod rdzas phyi nang gsang ba yi// sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs rnams zag med kyi// ye shes bdud rtsi 'od rlabs rab 'phro ba// kun bzang smon lam las grub dgyes skyed gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sa byin brlabs te/ bskyed rim bsgom pa ni/ phyi nang snod bcud mi dmigs stong nyid gyur// rang nyid lhar gsal mdun gyi mkha' dbyings su// ye shes lnga yi 'ja' 'od 'thibs pa'i klong*// rin chen dar dang seng ges btegs pa'i khri// de steng pad+ma dkar po 'dab stong rgyas// nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gsal la 'tsher ba'i dbus// sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan rigs kun dbang phyug he ru ka /mtha' klas zhing gi bdag po dpa' bo che// rdo rje drag po phrin las 'dus pa rtsal// sku mdog dkar smug zhi ma khro yi tshul// dbu la pad+ma mthong grol rab mdzes gsol// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu dang*// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub gnam lcags phur bu bsnams// sku la phod ka chos gos rnam gsum bklubs// zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs// gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing gsal// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'og min zhing rab 'byams// khyad par o rgyan dpal gyi mkha' spyod nas// rdo rje slob dpon rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal// ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin bye ba 'bum// chos kyi srung ma rgya mtsho 'khor bcas rnams// deng 'dir dad dang dam tshig mos blo yis// sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs te gdan 'bul/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+wam̐/ hrīḥ sangs rgyas kun 'dus sku mchog mtshan dpes brgyan// dam pa'i gsung mchog tshangs dbyangs drug cu ldan// thugs mchog rdo rje ting 'dzin brgya phrag mnga'// rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo//

de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*// puṇ+ḍa ri ka la sogs me tog tshal// tshul khrims dri bsung bdug spos sprin bzhin gtibs// rab gsal snang ba'i sgron me nyi ltar 'tsher// tshangs ral las 'ongs dag byed dri chab dang*// lha yi zhal zas sna tshogs ro brgyar ldan// pi waṃ glu dbyangs grag stong sgra yis mchod// dbang lnga'i chu skyes gsur chen spos zhun me// dri chab zhal zas thod rnga rkang gling sgra// bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta ba liṃ ta// sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin bla na med pa'i rdzas// phyi nang gsang mchod sna tshogs bzhes su gsol// bstod pa bya ba ni/ hrīḥ gdod nas rnam dag chos kyi sku brnyes kyang*// byams pas 'gro la rjes su brtse ba yi// gang 'dul der ston sgyu 'phrul gar rol pa// shrī thugs kyi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// grub gnyis stsol zhing sa lam bar chad sel// rig 'dzin rgya mtsho bye ba 'bum sde dang*// dz+nyā na ḍā ki dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// chos kyi srung ma rnams la bstod par bgyi// bshags pa ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// bskal dus sngon nas da lta'i bar 'di ru// ma rtogs dbang gis nongs par gyur pa rnams// snying nas bshags so dag tshangs dngos grub stsol// yi ge brgya pa brjod/ de nas bzlas ba'i rim pa ni/ mdun bskyed bla ma'i thugs kar zla steng hūm̐// mthing gsal 'bar ba de mthar sngags phreng 'khor// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis sbyangs// tshur 'dus ye shes bdag rgyud la smin gyur// oṃ āḥshrī tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes ci cus bzlas/ de nas tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dir bshams zhal zas tshogs gtor gyi// ma dag gnyis 'dzin bsreg sbyang bkrus// ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlab nas// zag med mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur// gnas 'og min chos dbyings zhing rab 'byams// dpal o rgyan mkha' spyod gzhal yas nas// mgon mtshungs med thugs kyi rdo rje mchog

/yid gdung bas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs// 'khor rig 'dzin grub ba'i dbang phyug che// ma gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong ba'i mgon po lcam dral rnams// tshogs mchod pa bzhes phyir gshegs su gsol// ho tshogs rdzas 'dod yon sna tshogs pa// ro bcud ldan longs spyod bsam yas 'di// dpal rdo rje can dngos zhal du 'bul// 'khor dang bcas dgyes par da rol cig /gha na tsakra pū dza hoḥ zhes tshogs phud phul nas bskang ba bya ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'chi med grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur// pad 'byung sgyu 'phrul gar rol pa// tshangs pa lha yi me tog dang*// dbyer med rdo rje drag bo rtsal// bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// rig 'dzin bye ba 'bum gyi sde// ma tshogs ḍā ki dpa' bo dang*// dam can chos srung thugs dam bskang*// g.yar dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas// mkha' dbyings kun khyab mchod pa'i sprin// nyer spyod lnga dang 'dod yon drug /rdo rje lha mo bcu drug po// rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis brgyad// mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' klas pas// thugs dam bskang ngo byin gyis rlobs// don gnyis mthar phyin dngos grub stsol// de nas bshags pa ni/ ho rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag slob dpon dgongs su gsol// bdag cag ma rig 'khrul ba'i las dbang gis// so thar byang sems gsang sngags dam 'gal ba// bshags so bshags so gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags// bzod par bzhes la dag tshangs dbugs dbyung gsol// gnyis 'dzin log rtog g.yul ngo las rgyal nas// sku bzhi mngon gyur bla med sangs rgyas shog / bsgral ba ni/ na mo rtsa gsum lha yi bden pa'i mthus// bstan dgra dam nyams ma lus 'dir khug cig /ye shes phur bus rab bsgral dbyings su bstim// zhal du bstab bo bzhes shig dgyes par rol// de nas lhag ma phul ba ni/

hūm̐ gsang sngags dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i lhag sdud rnams// thams cad 'dir spyon tshogs lhag gtor ma bzhes// gang bcol las kun thogs med bsgrub pa dang*// mi mthun rkyen rnams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// chad tho dang brtan skyong ni/ sngon tshe bar dang tha dus bskal pa la// rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng rgyal po dang*// dbyer med dpal chen thugs kyi rdo rje'i drung*// ye shes las kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs// 'jig rten dregs byed dam can srung ma yis// so so'i khas blangs dam tshig dran mdzod la// gsang sngags dkyil 'khor gnyen po skyong ba dang*/ mchod gtor bzhes la gang bcol phrin las sgrubs// bod khams skyong ba'i ma sring brtan ma'i tshogs// tha tshig ma 'da' bka' yi gtor ma bzhes// bstan pa srung dang 'gro la phan bde spel// rnal 'byor 'khor srung bar chad bzlog tu gsol// de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rig 'dzin lha tshogs mchod cing bsgrub lags na// thugs rjes dgongs te bdag gzhan smin grol gyi// lam la 'god phyir dbang dang dngos grub stsol// sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// de ltar sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi// 'od zer dkar dmar sngo ljang ser 'phros nas// bdag gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi rdzogs// bla ma 'od zhu dbyer med gcig 'dres gyur// de'i ngang la dar cig ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag / dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags yod kyi// dge tshogs thams cad gcig tu bzlums byas nas// dge kun sems can sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// dge des tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs thob shog / ces bslab gsum rgyan ldan bla ma nor bu nas rten dang bcas 'di ltar dgos zhes bskul ba ltar si tus spel ba maṅga lam/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshogs mchod dang 'brel bar spro na/ skyabs sems ni/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum ngo bo nyid// rdo rje 'dzin dbang bla ma la// skyabs su mchi zhing 'gro ba rnams// 'khor mtsho las grol sems bskyed do//

lan gsum/ mdun rten bskyed pa ni/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sa stong bar sbyangs/ chos rnams ma skyes mi 'gags pa// gsal stong rig pa'i snang cha las// rang lhar gsal ba'i mdun gyi mkhar// ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' 'od klong*// sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan ldan pa// rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsal// 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro// gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras 'khor bcas// bla ma'i ye shes rol pa ru// spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med gyur// shrī mān gu ru de wa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+wam̐/

spyan drangs bzhugs gsol dang*/ bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs dang*// rang byung 'dod yon nang mchod 'bul// gsang mchod bde chen lha mo'i tshogs// 'khor 'das ro mnyam de bzhin nyid// dus gsum mnyam nyid rtogs pas mchod// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ pā d+yaṃ/ shab+da 'i bar dang*/ ma hā pañca rak+ta/ ba ling ta/ ma hā su kha pū dza ho/ zhes mchod/ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i dpyid// snyigs dus 'gro la rjes brtse ba'i// thugs rje rmad byung rigs kun bdag /rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ thugs kar zla steng hrīḥyig mthar// sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyang*// mchog thun dngos grub thob par gyur// oṃ āḥdharma sur+yā ma hā mu dra sid+dhi hūm̐/ ces sngags bzla'o// de nas tshogs rdzas rnams/ amṛ ta sa bsangs/ oṃ snang ba snod kyi gtor gzhong du/ āḥstong pa bcud kyi bdud rtsis gtams// hūm̐ 'dod yon sna tshogs sprin spror gyur// hrīḥbade chen mnyam nyid tshogs mchod bzhes// zhes tshogs spro/ bdag cag 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas// bskyed rdzogs mi gsal mos gus la// ltems rkyang tshod yod gyur pa sogs// sdom gsum 'gal nyams sdig sgrib bshags// gnyis 'dzin ma rig dgra dang bgegs// bdag med phur pas bsgral nas kyang*// dug gsum sku gsum bdud rtsir gyur// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du bstab// ga na tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhes phul/ a hoḥm hā su khaḥ/ dngos grub rol/ lhag ma ni/ hūm̐/ dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med ngang*// rol rtsal las shar srung ma bran// dregs byed ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod// de nas byin rlabs dbang len ni/ hrīḥ mdun bskyed bla ma'i gnas bzhi las// rdo rje bzhi yi ngo bo ru// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdakar dmar mthing*// ljang 'phros rang gi gnas bzhir thim// dbang bzhi ye shes mchog thob nas/

sku bzhi'i go 'phang rgyud smin gyur// gu ru sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// dbyer med chu la chu bzhag ltar// dus gsum rtog pa'i rgyun bcad nas// ma bcos gang shar ngo bo bskyang*// zhes ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag dge 'dis 'gro drug sems can rnams// bla med go 'phang thob par shog / ces si tu pad+ma'i ming gis dad gsum ldan pa dge legs chos 'phel ngor rdo rje drag po'i mchog sprul de nyid kyi bla sgrub ste/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gzhan la'ang sbyar rung du spel ba dge/ maṅga lam/// / ༈ swasti/ 'dir dpal dga' sprul sku'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor la mos pa dag gis/ ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa o rgyan chen po bskyed bzlas sprul gzhi nyid du nges pas rten dang mchod pa tshar du dngar ba 'du byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// bdag dang 'gro kun ma gyur sems can rnams// sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par sems bskyed do// lan gsum/ oṃ shūn+ya ta sogs/ gnyis su 'dzin pa'i dri ma kun bral ngang*// mdun mkhar pad sdong nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng*// stong dang snying rje zung 'jug rig rtsal las// hrīḥyig yongs gyur rgyal kun 'dus pa'i dpyid// gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas lam mer gsal// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs ka'i sa bon las// 'od 'phros bde chen pad+ma 'od zhing nas// rgyal ba sras 'khor rtsa gsum lha yi tshogs// sprin phung gtib bzhin spyan drangs sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi sogs tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngags dang bcas lan gsum gyis byin phabs/ hoḥ rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma mi dmigs kyang*// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rtog pa zhi ba'i phyir// gnyis med bde ba chen por bzhugs su gsol// ye nas gnas pa chos sku'i rol pa la// de bzhin nyid du rtogs pas gus phyag 'tshal// phyi mchod tshogs drug yul snang mchod lhar sprul// nang mchod sku gsum bdud rtsi ra sa yan// gsang ba bde ba chen po rdo rje'i dngos// 'khor gsum dmigs bral de bzhin nyid dang bcas// lha la lha thim dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rol// gang gi gsang gsum rgyal ba kun ye shes// dbyer med gcig tu nges par bsngags 'os stobs// srid 'dir ma mchis 'on kyang rang rig pa// gdod ma'i mgon por ro gcig mos pas bstod// bshags dang bshags bya bshags mkhan mi dmigs pa// sgyu ma lta bur nongs gyur ma lus 'chags// dngos grub stsol dang stsol ba mi dmigs kyang*// thun mong spyi dang rang rig ye shes che// mngon mthong phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub dang*// tshig dang yi ger mi ltos rdo rje bzhis// byin rlabs 'pho dbang bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs//

zhes dang*/ gsol 'debs snying po badz+ra gu ru bzlas/ rgyun khyer bsdus pa'i skabs 'di nas byin rlabs bsdu ba phyin bton/ rgyas par spro na de nas tshogs rdzas bshams la byin rlabs ni/ oṃ snang ba snod kyi gtor gzhong du// āḥstong pa'i rang mdangs tshogs kyi rdzas// hūm̐ kun bzang rol pa chen por gyur// hrīḥzag med bde skyed ye shes kyi// bcud chen 'di dpal mchog he ru ka /don stong nyid rol pa'i yum dang 'khor// dpal rtsa gsum lha yi spro bsdu bcas// skyabs dam par gyur kun dgyes par bzhes// gshis kun khyab 'gyur ba med pa'i dngos// don mnyam nyid dbyings su bsgral bar mdzod// dgra gnyis 'dzin 'khrul rtog las nyon bdud// 'phral glo bur dri mas bsgribs pa rnams// thabs rang rig gcer mthong ngang du bshags// oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya brjod/ dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje'i gar// dbyings gsum gyi mkha' ru bsgyur ba dang*// lha sngags dang ye shes chen po ru// 'du shes pa'i bdud rtsi e ma ho// zhes tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma bsngo ba/ hoḥ don bde chen thig le nyag gcig las// thabs snang tshul gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi// phyi mu ran skyong ba'i lhag sdud rnams// bcud ro ldan lhag ma'i gtor ma longs// 'phral byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad dang*// gtan rnal 'byor bzhi yi gol shor gyi// sa lam la bar gcod 'bras 'byin pa'i// 'khrul rtog gi bdud bzhi'i dgra dpung zlog /uts+tshiṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi/ byin rlabs bsdu ba ni/ bla ma'i sku yi gnas bzhir rdo rje bzhi'i// yi ge gsal las 'od 'phros gnas bzhir thim// dbang dang byin rlabs kun thob 'od du zhu// rang rig gdod ma'i dbyings su ro gcig 'dres// dge 'dis 'gro ba= rtag bde'i= nang gis lam= sangs rgyas nyid kyi= zhes si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis zur mang bstan 'dzin mchog sprul bzhed ngor/

'dzi sgar chos skyong sprul sku dpal dga'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor du spel ba dge/ gzhan spyi khyab tu gu ru rin po che kho na'i bla sgrub tu dmigs nas nyams len bgyis na chog 'dug ste legs bar sems so/// / ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ rang snang gdod nas rnam dag stong nyid las// thabs mchog snying rje'i rol gar yi dam lha// gdan gsum tshang ba'i skur gsal spyi gtsug tu// rgyal kun ye shes dbyings su ro gcig kyang*// gang 'dul sku gsum chu zla'i rol rtsed tshul// chos kyi snang ba mtha' yas chos sku'i klong*// 'gro 'dul longs spyod yongs rdzogs nyin mor byed// chags med gang 'dul skur ston sprul pa'i sku// sku dang ye shes tha dad bral ba yi// dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i 'od klong gsal// oṃ/ chos dbyings mtha' bral kun tu khyab pa'i dngos// dus gsum skye 'gags spros pa'i mtshan ma las// yongs grol bde gshegs snying po dam pa'i bdag /bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs// aḥ lhun 'grub ye shes lnga ldan 'pho bral khams// rigs rnams kun gyi zlos gar mi 'gog par// rang rtsal sku dang zhing khams 'du 'bral med// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs skur gsol ba 'debs// hūm̐/ skye med rtsal las gang 'dul 'gags med kyi// sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab rol ba yis// 'khor ba srid du 'khor ba'i don mdzad pa// bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// hrīḥ rang sems bde stong dbyer med phyag rgya che'i// ngo bor bcos min rtse gcig mnyam bzhag pas// bsgom bya sgom byed bral ba'i ye shes te// bla ma ngo bo nyid sku mngon du gyur// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// sogs brjod/ ces skyabs rje 'brug pa rin po che'i zhal slob bstan 'dzin chos dbang gi ngor si tus spel/// /
